Minutes of 9 Oct: "Amit Handa noted that Greg Smith circulated an availability poll for bonus technical council deep dive sessions scheduled for Wednesday and Thursday." - Milestone `2026-12-08` today [P]: 6 open items: #735, #738, #668, #634, #584, #482 ("feat: add approaching discounts to discount extension."). #929 is not on it.

# V-G5 - Adversarial verification of G5-builders-and-allies

Verification date: 13 Oct 2026. Verifier's notes on `/Users/mustafatokmak/.herdr-projects/offerad/threads/t-0006/work/people/G5-builders-and-allies.md`.

Method: every cited source was fetched again today (curl with a browser User-Agent for web pages; read-only GET and read-only GraphQL queries against the GitHub API for profiles, issues, discussions, pull requests and files). Nobody was contacted. No posts, comments, stars, follows, sign-ups or forms. LinkedIn and X pages were not opened; a LinkedIn or X handle is listed only when the person's own page or profile links to it. Raw copies of what I fetched: `/Users/mustafatokmak/.herdr-projects/offerad/threads/t-0006/work/docs/vg5/` (84 files).

Verdict key: confirmed = source re-fetched, quote present, nothing newer contradicts it. corrected = role or a fact the outreach note depends on is different from what the researcher wrote. unverified / drop = not used below; nobody on this list had to be dropped.

---

## 0. What changed, in short

1. **The Offer extension has moved further than the researcher reported.** UCP issue #738 was put on the `2026-12-08` milestone by Greg Smith (Google, Shopping Tech Council) on 25 Sep 2026 and assigned to him on 2 Oct 2026. The council discussed it on 2 Oct 2026; the public minutes record that "Ilya Grigorik questioned whether cart state binding is necessary and probed whether platforms and agent builders would trust or utilize merchant-recommended products" and that "Greg Smith will carry the topic into Monday's deep dive session to evaluate potential inclusion in the December milestone." Source: https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/meeting-minutes/blob/main/tc/shopping/2026/2026-10-02.md . The researcher wrote that no community call or minutes were found; a public `meeting-minutes` repository exists with weekly notes through 9 Oct 2026.
2. **Tomas Taylor is Co-Founder and CTO of Pennant, a Y Combinator Summer 2026 company that YC lists in New York City.** The researcher had "building Pennant" and "same city". His own site still says San Francisco; the company's pages say New York.
3. **StabileRewards' Shopify App Store listing gives the developer address as Dublin, CA, not San Francisco.** Only the founder's GitHub profile says San Francisco. Discussion #856 is not theirs (it is by `deangoodman`).
4. **Francesco Marinoni Moretto is not simply "independent with no employer".** His Sessionize speaker profile says "Lead AI Architect working on agent-native commerce" and "AI Practice and Community Leader at N1AI". The book is forthcoming ("Out October 2026"), published by Affero Press, Milan.
5. **Juan Fernández speaks for Shopware in the threads but does not write the quote extension.** The commits are by Sebastian Hölscher (`HoelShare`) and Lukas Rump (`lukasrump`); the plugin repository is MIT-licensed, which already answers most of the proposed ask.
6. **"The only concrete offer message proposal in UCP" is overstated** for Arjun Garg. Others open today: #929 Quote extension with an optional buyer `proposal` (Sparsh, Google London), #810/#811 per-seller offers on catalog variants (Provash Shoumma, Klarna), PR #482 approaching discounts (Scot DeDeo, Salesforce; also on the December milestone), #384 Provider and offer discovery.
7. All twelve recent-statement quotes are really on the cited pages. For five people a newer or more relevant statement exists (listed per person).

shopify/app/extensions/agent-offers/blocks/agent-offers.liquid
{%- comment -%}
  Loads the OfferAd storefront script through the app proxy, so it and its
  requests stay on the store's own domain. The script reads the data attributes
  below: where the offer endpoint is, which shop and product this page is, and
  which of its three parts the merchant switched on.
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- liquid
  # Merchants can move the app proxy per store, so the path is a setting.
  assign path = block.settings.proxy_path | default: '/apps/offerad' | strip
  assign first = path | slice: 0
  unless first == '/'
    assign path = path | prepend: '/'
  endunless
  assign last_index = path.size | minus: 1
  assign last = path | slice: last_index
  if last == '/' and last_index > 0
    assign path = path | slice: 0, last_index
  endif
  assign endpoint = request.origin | append: path
-%}
{%- if block.settings.webmcp or block.settings.show_box or block.settings.json_ld -%}
  <script
    src="{{ endpoint | escape }}/embed.js"
    data-endpoint="{{ endpoint | escape }}"
    data-shop="{{ shop.permanent_domain | escape }}"
    data-webmcp="{{ block.settings.webmcp }}"
    {%- if request.page_type == 'product' %} data-product="{{ product.handle | escape }}"{% endif %}
    {%- if block.settings.show_box %} data-box="true"{% endif %}
    {%- if block.settings.show_box and block.settings.box_target != blank %} data-box-target="{{ block.settings.box_target | strip | escape }}"{% endif %}
    {%- if block.settings.json_ld %} data-jsonld="true"{% endif %}
    defer
  ></script>
{%- endif -%}

{% schema %}
{
  "name": "Offers for AI agents",
  "target": "body",
  "settings": [
    {
      "type": "checkbox",
      "id": "webmcp",
      "label": "Offer tool for AI agents",
      "info": "Lets an AI agent that browses the store ask it for an offer (WebMCP). Shoppers see nothing.",
      "default": true
    },
    {
      "type": "checkbox",
      "id": "json_ld",
      "label": "Offer link in page data",
      "info": "Adds JSON-LD to product pages that says where an offer can be asked for. Shoppers see nothing.",
      "default": true
    },
    {
      "type": "checkbox",
      "id": "show_box",
      "label": "Offer box on product pages",
      "info": "Shows an \"Ask this store for an offer\" box on product pages.",
      "default": false
    },
    {
      "type": "text",
      "id": "box_target",
      "label": "Offer box position",
      "info": "Optional. CSS selector of the element the box goes after. Leave empty to put it under the price."
    },
    {
      "type": "text",
      "id": "proxy_path",
      "label": "App proxy path",
      "info": "Change this only if the app proxy URL was customized under Settings > Apps.",
      "default": "/apps/offerad"
    }
  ]
}

the shopping experience for customers in that region.
"""
type Country {
  """
  The ISO code of the country.
  """
  isoCode: CountryCode!
}

  during discount calculations. These settings are based on the store's configured
  [localization practices](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/functions/localization-practices-shopify-functions).

  setting and associated [metafields](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data).

  `cart.delivery-options.discounts.generate.run` extension targets.

"""
The current time based on the
[store's timezone setting](https://help.shopify.com/manual/intro-to-shopify/initial-setup/setup-business-settings).
"""
type LocalTime {
  """
  The current date relative to the parent object.
  """
  date: Date!

  """
  Returns true if the current date and time is at or past the given date and time, and false otherwise.
  """
  dateTimeAfter(
    """
    The date and time to compare against, assumed to be in the timezone of the parent object.
    """
    dateTime: DateTimeWithoutTimezone!
  ): Boolean!

  """
  Returns true if the current date and time is before the given date and time, and false otherwise.
  """
  dateTimeBefore(
    """
    The date and time to compare against, assumed to be in the timezone of the parent timezone.
    """
    dateTime: DateTimeWithoutTimezone!
  ): Boolean!

  """
  Returns true if the current date and time is between the two given date and times, and false otherwise.
  """
  dateTimeBetween(
    """
    The upper bound time to compare against, assumed to be in the timezone of the parent timezone.
    """
    endDateTime: DateTimeWithoutTimezone!

    """
    The lower bound time to compare against, assumed to be in the timezone of the parent timezone.
    """
    startDateTime: DateTimeWithoutTimezone!
  ): Boolean!

  """
  Returns true if the current time is at or past the given time, and false otherwise.
  """
  timeAfter(
    """
    The time to compare against, assumed to be in the timezone of the parent timezone.
    """
    time: TimeWithoutTimezone!
  ): Boolean!

  """
  Returns true if the current time is at or past the given time, and false otherwise.
  """
  timeBefore(
    """
    The time to compare against, assumed to be in the timezone of the parent timezone.
    """
    time: TimeWithoutTimezone!
  ): Boolean!

  """
  Returns true if the current time is between the two given times, and false otherwise.
  """
  timeBetween(
    """
    The upper bound time to compare against, assumed to be in the timezone of the parent timezone.
    """
    endTime: TimeWithoutTimezone!

    """
    The lower bound time to compare against, assumed to be in the timezone of the parent timezone.
    """
    startTime: TimeWithoutTimezone!
  ): Boolean!
}

"""
Represents the location where the inventory resides.
"""
type Location implements HasMetafields {
  """
  The address of this location.
  """
  address: LocationAddress!

  """
  The location handle.
  """
  handle: Handle!

  """
  The location id.
  """
  id: ID!

  """
  A [custom field](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data) that stores additional information
  about a Shopify resource, such as products, orders, and
  [many more](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/enums/MetafieldOwnerType).
  Using [metafields with Shopify Functions](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/functions/input-output/metafields-for-input-queries)
  enables you to customize the checkout experience.
  """
  metafield(
    """
    The unique identifier for the metafield within its namespace. A metafield is composed of a
    namespace and a key, in the format `namespace.key`.
    """
    key: String!

    """
    A category that organizes a group of metafields. Namespaces are used to prevent naming conflicts
    between different apps or different parts of the same app. If omitted, then the
    [app-reserved namespace](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data/ownership)
    is used.
    """
    namespace: String
  ): Metafield

  """
  The name of the location.
  """
  name: String!
}

"""
Represents the address of a location.
"""
type LocationAddress {
  """
  The first line of the address for the location.
  """
  address1: String

  """
  The second line of the address for the location.
  """
  address2: String

  """
  The city of the location.
  """
  city: String

  """
  The country of the location.
  """
  country: String

  """
  The country code of the location.
  """
  countryCode: String

  """
  A formatted version of the address for the location.
  """
  formatted: [String!]!

  """
  The approximate latitude coordinates of the location.
  """
  latitude: Float

  """
  The approximate longitude coordinates of the location.
  """
  longitude: Float

  """
  The phone number of the location.
  """
  phone: String

  """
  The province of the location.
  """
  province: String

  """
  The code for the province, state, or district of the address of the location.
  """
  provinceCode: String

  """
  The ZIP code of the location.
  """
  zip: String
}

"""
Represents a mailing address.
"""
type MailingAddress {
  """
  The first line of the address. Typically the street address or PO Box number.
  """
  address1: String

  """
  The second line of the address. Typically the number of the apartment, suite, or unit.
  """
  address2: String

  """
  The name of the city, district, village, or town.
  """
  city: String

  """
  The name of the customer's company or organization.
  """
  company: String

  """
  The two-letter code for the country of the address. For example, US.
  """
  countryCode: CountryCode

  """
  The first name of the customer.
  """
  firstName: String

  """
  The last name of the customer.
  """
  lastName: String

  """
  The approximate latitude of the address.
  """
  latitude: Float

  """
  The approximate longitude of the address.
  """
  longitude: Float

  """
  The market of the address.
  """
  market: Market @deprecated(reason: "This `market` field will be removed in a future version of the API.")

  """
  The full name of the customer, based on firstName and lastName.
  """
  name: String

  """
  A unique phone number for the customer. Formatted using E.164 standard. For example, +16135551111.
  """
  phone: String

  """
  The alphanumeric code for the region. For example, ON.
  """
  provinceCode: String

  """
  The zip or postal code of the address.
  """
  zip: String
}

"""
A market is a group of one or more regions that you want to target for international sales.
By creating a market, you can configure a distinct, localized shopping experience for
customers from a specific area of the world. For example, you can
[change currency](https://shopify.dev/api/admin-graphql/current/mutations/marketCurrencySettingsUpdate),
[configure international pricing](https://shopify.dev/api/examples/product-price-lists),
or [add market-specific domains or subfolders](https://shopify.dev/api/admin-graphql/current/objects/MarketWebPresence).
"""
type Market implements HasMetafields {
  """
  A human-readable unique string for the market automatically generated from its title.
  """
  handle: Handle!

  """
  A globally-unique identifier.
  """
  id: ID!

  """
  A [custom field](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data) that stores additional information
  about a Shopify resource, such as products, orders, and
  [many more](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/enums/MetafieldOwnerType).
  Using [metafields with Shopify Functions](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/functions/input-output/metafields-for-input-queries)
  enables you to customize the checkout experience.
  """
  metafield(
    """
    The unique identifier for the metafield within its namespace. A metafield is composed of a
    namespace and a key, in the format `namespace.key`.
    """
    key: String!

    """
    A category that organizes a group of metafields. Namespaces are used to prevent naming conflicts
    between different apps or different parts of the same app. If omitted, then the
    [app-reserved namespace](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data/ownership)
    is used.
    """
    namespace: String
  ): Metafield

  """
  A geographic region which comprises a market.
  """
  regions: [MarketRegion!]!
}

"""
Represents a region.
"""
interface MarketRegion {
  """
  The name of the region in the language of the current localization.
  """
  name: String
}

"""
A country which comprises a market.
"""
type MarketRegionCountry implements MarketRegion {
  """
  The two-letter code for the country.
  """
  code: CountryCode!

  """
  The country name in the language of the current localization.
  """
  name: String!
}

"""
The item that a customer intends to purchase. Merchandise can be a product variant or a custom
product.

A product variant is a specific version of a product that comes in more than one option, such as size or color.
For example, if a merchant sells t-shirts with options for size and color, then a small, blue t-shirt would be
one product variant and a large, blue t-shirt would be another.

A custom product represents a product that doesn't map to Shopify's
[standard product categories](https://help.shopify.com/manual/products/details/product-type).
For example, you can use a custom product to manage gift cards, shipping requirements, localized product
information, or weight measurements and conversions.
"""
union Merchandise = CustomProduct | ProductVariant

"""
[Custom fields](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data) that store additional information
about a Shopify resource, such as products, orders, and
[many more](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/enums/MetafieldOwnerType).
Using [metafields with Shopify Functions](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/functions/input-output/metafields-for-input-queries)
enables you to customize the checkout experience.
"""
type Metafield {
  """
  The data that's stored in the metafield, using JSON format.
  """
  jsonValue: JSON!

  """
  The [type of data](https://shopify.dev/apps/metafields/types) that the metafield stores in
  the `value` field.
  """

# Discount Function: one discount code stands for one composite offer.
# Layout and keys follow what `shopify app generate extension --template discount`
# writes for JavaScript. schema.graphql belongs to this api_version; after a
# bump, refresh it with `shopify app function schema`.
# No uid here: the CLI derives one from the handle when the toml has none.

[[extensions]]
name = "t:name"
# The functionHandle the service passes to discountCodeAppCreate.
handle = "offer-discount"
type = "function"
description = "t:description"

  [[extensions.targeting]]

  input_query = "src/cart_lines_discounts_generate_run.graphql"
  export = "cart-lines-discounts-generate-run"

  input_query = "src/cart_delivery_options_discounts_generate_run.graphql"

  [extensions.build]
  command = ""
  path = "dist/function.wasm"

// Delivery target: the free standard shipping and the express upgrade of an offer.
import { cents, decimal, entitled, numericId, readOffer } from './offer.js';

const rate = option => cents(option.cost?.amount);

/**
 * @param {import('../generated/api').DeliveryInput} input
 * @returns {import('../generated/api').CartDeliveryOptionsDiscountsGenerateRunResult}
 */
export function cartDeliveryOptionsDiscountsGenerateRun(input) {
  const offer = readOffer(input);
  if (!offer || !(offer.freeShipping || offer.express)) return { operations: [] };
  if (!input.discount.discountClasses.includes('SHIPPING')) return { operations: [] };
  if (!entitled(offer, input.cart?.lines)) return { operations: [] };

  const isExpress = o => offer.expressPattern.test(o.title ?? '') || offer.expressPattern.test(String(o.handle ?? ''));
  const freeStandard = new Set();
  const freeExpress = new Set();
  const candidates = [];
  // A cart can ship in several groups, each with its own options and rates.
  for (const group of input.cart?.deliveryGroups ?? []) {
    // The offer covers the shipment that carries its product, not every parcel of the order.
    if (!(group.cartLines ?? []).some(l => numericId(l.merchandise?.id) === offer.variant)) continue;
    // Pickup and local delivery are not what the offer calls shipping.
    const options = (group.deliveryOptions ?? []).filter(o => o.deliveryMethodType === 'SHIPPING');
    const express = options.filter(isExpress);
    const standard = options.filter(o => !isExpress(o));
    if (offer.freeShipping) {
      for (const o of standard) if (rate(o) > 0) freeStandard.add(o.handle);
      // With both, the standard rate is zero, so express at the standard rate is free too.
      if (offer.express) for (const o of express) if (rate(o) > 0) freeExpress.add(o.handle);
      continue;
    }
    for (const o of express) {
      // The standard rate: the dearest option that is not express and still costs less than this one.
      const below = standard.map(rate).filter(r => r < rate(o));
      if (!below.length) continue;
      candidates.push({ message: offer.express.label, targets: [{ deliveryOption: { handle: o.handle } }], value: { fixedAmount: { amount: decimal(rate(o) - Math.max(...below)) } } });
    }
  }
  const free = (message, handles) => ({ message, targets: [...handles].map(handle => ({ deliveryOption: { handle } })), value: { percentage: { value: '100.0' } } });
  if (freeStandard.size) candidates.push(free(offer.freeShipping.label, freeStandard));
  if (freeExpress.size) candidates.push(free(offer.express.label, freeExpress));
  if (!candidates.length) return { operations: [] };
  // One operation for all groups: a result may hold only one deliveryDiscountsAdd.
  return { operations: [{ deliveryDiscountsAdd: { candidates, selectionStrategy: 'ALL' } }] };
}

// Cart target: the lower price and the free add-on of an offer.
// Enum values are written as strings so this file runs in plain Node too,
// without the types the CLI generates into ../generated.
import { cents, decimal, entitled, numericId, readOffer } from './offer.js';

// What to take off the offered units, in cents. The offer is a price as well
// as an amount: if the shelf price has dropped since the offer was made, take
// off less, so the buyer pays what was agreed and the seller never less.
function priceOff(offer, picks) {
  if (!offer.priceOff) return 0;
  const costs = picks.map(p => p.line.cost?.amountPerQuantity);
  // A fixed amount is read in the cart's currency. In another currency it would be a different offer.
  if (offer.currency && costs.some(c => c?.currencyCode !== offer.currency)) return 0;
  if (offer.itemsTotal == null) return offer.priceOff;
  const shelf = picks.reduce((sum, p, i) => sum + cents(costs[i]?.amount) * p.quantity, 0);
  return Math.min(offer.priceOff, shelf - offer.itemsTotal);
}

/**
 * @param {import('../generated/api').CartInput} input
 * @returns {import('../generated/api').CartLinesDiscountsGenerateRunResult}
 */
export function cartLinesDiscountsGenerateRun(input) {
  const offer = readOffer(input);
  if (!offer || !input.discount.discountClasses.includes('PRODUCT')) return { operations: [] };
  const lines = input.cart?.lines ?? [];
  const picks = entitled(offer, lines);
  if (!picks) return { operations: [] };

  const candidates = [];
  const off = priceOff(offer, picks);
  if (off > 0) {
    candidates.push({
      message: offer.priceLabel,
      targets: picks.map(p => ({ cartLine: { id: p.line.id, quantity: p.quantity } })),
      // One amount across the offered units, not one per unit: nothing to round.
      value: { fixedAmount: { amount: decimal(off), appliesToEachItem: false } },
    });
  }
  for (const gift of offer.gifts) {
    // One line cannot be both the product bought and the add-on given.
    if (gift.variant === offer.variant) continue;
    // A Function cannot add a line: the cart link or the agent puts the add-on in the cart.
    const line = lines.find(l => numericId(l.merchandise?.id) === gift.variant);
    if (line) candidates.push({ message: gift.label, targets: [{ cartLine: { id: line.id, quantity: 1 } }], value: { percentage: { value: '100.0' } } });
  }
  if (!candidates.length) return { operations: [] };
  // ALL, because the price and the add-on sit on different lines and both apply.
  return { operations: [{ productDiscountsAdd: { candidates, selectionStrategy: 'ALL' } }] };
}

shopify/app/extensions/offer-discount/src/offer.js
// The offer behind a discount code, read the same way by both targets.
// The service mints one code per accepted offer and puts the offer on the
// discount as a JSON metafield ($app:offer): the public offer from policy.js
// plus the variant it was made for.
//
//   { variant_id, quantity, currency, items_total, expires_at, code,
//     components: [{ type, label, amount_off, variant_id }], express_pattern }
//
// Only variant_id and components are required. Components that money cannot
// express at checkout (extended_returns, delivery_guarantee, next_order_credit)
// ride along and are ignored here: the service settles them after the order.

// Rate names differ per shop, so the offer may carry its own express_pattern.
const EXPRESS = /express|expedited|overnight|next[ -]?day|same[ -]?day/i;
const DAY_MS = 86400000;
const LABEL_MAX = 100;

const isObject = x => !!x && typeof x === 'object' && !Array.isArray(x);

// Money as whole cents. Shopify sends decimals as strings ("19.9").
export function cents(x) {
  const n = typeof x === 'number' ? x : typeof x === 'string' && x.trim() ? Number(x) : NaN;
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.round(n * 100) : NaN;
}

// Decimals go back to Shopify as strings.
export const decimal = c => (c / 100).toFixed(2);

// "gid://shopify/ProductVariant/123" and 123 name the same variant. Nothing else is one.
export const numericId = x => (String(x ?? '').match(/^(?:gid:\/\/shopify\/ProductVariant\/)?(\d+)$/) || [])[1] || null;

const label = (c, fallback) => (typeof c.label === 'string' && c.label.trim() ? c.label.trim().slice(0, LABEL_MAX) : fallback);

// A Function has no clock, only the shop's local date, so this is a backstop
// with a day of slack for time zones: the exact expiry is the discount's own
// endsAt. An expiry that cannot be read counts as expired.
function expired(expiresAt, today) {
  if (expiresAt == null) return false;
  let ms = typeof expiresAt === 'number' ? expiresAt : Date.parse(expiresAt);
  if (ms < 1e11) ms *= 1000; // epoch seconds
  if (!Number.isFinite(ms) || Math.abs(ms) > 8e15) return true;
  return typeof today === 'string' && today > new Date(ms + DAY_MS).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

// Null when there is nothing safe to apply: no code, no config, a config that
// does not parse or validate, or an offer that has run out.
export function readOffer(input) {
  // An offer belongs to its code. No code means the discount was set up as an
  // automatic one, and an offer must never apply by itself.
  const code = input?.triggeringDiscountCode;
  if (!code) return null;

  let cfg = input?.discount?.metafield?.jsonValue;
  if (typeof cfg === 'string') {
    try { cfg = JSON.parse(cfg); } catch { return null; }
  }
  if (!isObject(cfg)) return null;
  // Also accepted: the offer nested under "offer", the variant beside it.
  if (isObject(cfg.offer)) cfg = { ...cfg.offer, ...cfg };
  if (!Array.isArray(cfg.components)) return null;
  if (cfg.code != null && String(cfg.code).toUpperCase() !== String(code).toUpperCase()) return null;

  const variant = numericId(cfg.variant_id ?? cfg.product?.variant_id ?? cfg.variant_numeric_id ?? cfg.product?.variant_numeric_id);
  const quantity = cfg.quantity ?? 1;
  if (!variant || !Number.isInteger(quantity) || quantity < 1) return null;
  if (expired(cfg.expires_at, input?.shop?.localTime?.date)) return null;

  const offer = { variant, quantity, currency: cfg.currency ?? null, itemsTotal: null, priceOff: 0, priceLabel: '', gifts: [], freeShipping: null, express: null, expressPattern: EXPRESS };
  const priceLabels = [];
  // A known component that does not validate voids the whole offer: half an
  // offer is not what either side agreed to.
  for (const c of cfg.components) {
    if (!isObject(c)) return null;
    if (c.type === 'price') {
      const off = cents(c.amount_off);
      if (!(off > 0)) return null;
      offer.priceOff += off;
      priceLabels.push(label(c, ''));
    } else if (c.type === 'gift') {
      const gift = numericId(c.variant_id);
      if (!gift) return null;
      if (!offer.gifts.some(g => g.variant === gift)) offer.gifts.push({ variant: gift, label: label(c, 'Free add-on') });
    } else if (c.type === 'free_shipping') {
      offer.freeShipping = { label: label(c, 'Free standard shipping') };
    } else if (c.type === 'express_upgrade') {
      offer.express = { label: label(c, 'Express delivery at the standard rate') };
    }
  }
  offer.priceLabel = (priceLabels.filter(Boolean).join(' + ') || 'Offer price').slice(0, LABEL_MAX);

  if (cfg.items_total != null) {
    offer.itemsTotal = cents(cfg.items_total);
    if (!(offer.itemsTotal >= 0)) return null;
  }
  if (cfg.express_pattern != null) {
    if (typeof cfg.express_pattern !== 'string' || !cfg.express_pattern.trim()) return null;
    try { offer.expressPattern = new RegExp(cfg.express_pattern, 'i'); } catch { return null; }
  }
  return offer;
}

// The lines that hold the product the offer was made for, and how many units
// of each the offer covers. Null when the cart holds fewer units than the
// offer was priced for: then nothing of the offer applies.
export function entitled(offer, lines) {
  let left = offer.quantity;
  const picks = [];
  for (const line of lines ?? []) {
    if (left <= 0) break;
    if (numericId(line.merchandise?.id) !== offer.variant || !(line.quantity > 0)) continue;
    const quantity = Math.min(left, line.quantity);
    picks.push({ line, quantity });
    left -= quantity;
  }
  return left > 0 ? null : picks;
}

# OfferAd agent offers: the Shopify app, deployed with `shopify app deploy`.
# https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/cli-for-apps/app-configuration
#
# Lines marked PLACEHOLDER are filled when the app is linked and the
# offerad-offers worker has a public URL. The .invalid host never resolves, so
# an unfilled copy cannot send a store's requests or orders to a real server.

name = "OfferAd agent offers"
# PLACEHOLDER: `shopify app config link` writes the app's client id here.
client_id = ""
# PLACEHOLDER: the public origin of the offerad-offers worker.
application_url = "https://offerad-offers.invalid"
embedded = false

[build]
# The backend is a deployed worker, not a local server behind a dev tunnel.
automatically_update_urls_on_dev = false

[access_scopes]
# write_discounts mints the codes, read_products reads variants, read_orders and
# write_orders annotate the order an offer was used on. write_app_proxy is what
# Shopify requires for the [app_proxy] block below. write_draft_orders prepares
# full offers in invoice checkout when no Discount Function is deployed.
scopes = "write_discounts,read_products,read_orders,write_orders,write_app_proxy,write_draft_orders"

[auth]
# The config schema requires one. The worker gets its Admin token by client
# credentials, so nothing redirects here.
# PLACEHOLDER: same host as application_url.
redirect_urls = [ "https://offerad-offers.invalid/auth/callback" ]

[webhooks]
api_version = "2026-10"

  # Relative to application_url. The worker verifies the HMAC and annotates the order.
  [[webhooks.subscriptions]]
  topics = [ "orders/create" ]
  uri = "/webhooks/orders"

# https://{shop}/apps/offerad/... is proxied to {url}/..., and the worker serves
# every route under /apps/offerad as well, so paths are the same on both sides.
[app_proxy]
# PLACEHOLDER: same host as application_url.
url = "https://offerad-offers.invalid/apps/offerad"
prefix = "apps"
subpath = "offerad"

// Exact composite offers through Shopify's ordinary draft-invoice checkout.
// API 2026-10: DraftOrderInput, DraftOrderLineItemInput, ShippingLineInput.
// https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/mutations/draftOrderCreate
// Creation has no atomic idempotency key. The service MUST serialize acceptance,
// persist mint_intent before calling mint, and use reconcile_only after a crash.
import { checkOffer, unitFloor } from './policy.js';
import { offerTerms, SettleError, shopifyAdapter } from './settle.js';

const DEFERRED = ['extended_returns', 'delivery_guarantee', 'next_order_credit', 'warranty'];
const CHECKOUT = ['price', 'gift', 'free_shipping', 'express_upgrade'];
const GID = /^gid:\/\/shopify\/ProductVariant\/[1-9][0-9]*$/;
const MONEY = '{ presentmentMoney { amount currencyCode } }';
const FINANCIAL = `presentmentCurrencyCode acceptAutomaticDiscounts discountCodes appliedDiscount { value }
  lineItemsSubtotalPrice ${MONEY} totalShippingPriceSet ${MONEY} totalPriceSet ${MONEY} totalTaxSet ${MONEY}
  taxesIncluded warnings { __typename } shippingLine { title custom }`;
const FIELDS = `id status ready invoiceUrl reserveInventoryUntil allowDiscountCodesInCheckout
  customAttributes { key value } order { id } ${FINANCIAL}
  lineItems(first: 10) { nodes { variant { id } custom quantity priceOverride { amount currencyCode }
    discountedTotalSet ${MONEY} components { quantity } } pageInfo { hasNextPage } }`;
const FIND = `query draftOrders($query: String!) { draftOrders(first: 3, query: $query) { nodes { ${FIELDS} } pageInfo { hasNextPage } } }`;
const GET = `query draftOrder($id: ID!) { draftOrder(id: $id) { ${FIELDS} } }`;
const ORDER_LINK = `query draftOrder($id: ID!) { draftOrder(id: $id) { id customAttributes { key value } order { id } } }`;
const CALCULATE = `mutation draftOrderCalculate($input: DraftOrderInput!) { draftOrderCalculate(input: $input) { calculatedDraftOrder { ${FINANCIAL} } userErrors { field message } } }`;
const CREATE = `mutation draftOrderCreate($input: DraftOrderInput!) { draftOrderCreate(input: $input) { draftOrder { ${FIELDS} } userErrors { field message } } }`;

function prepare(offer, mandate) {
  if (!GID.test(mandate?.product?.variant_id || '') || !Number.isInteger(offer?.quantity) || offer.quantity < 1 || offer.quantity > 10000 || !Array.isArray(offer.components) || !offer.components.length) fail('The offer needs an exact catalog variant, quantity and components.');
  const seen = new Set();

    if (!c || ![...CHECKOUT, ...DEFERRED].includes(c.type)) fail('A component has no supported settlement route.', 'not_deliverable');
    if (c.type !== 'price' && seen.has(c.type)) fail('The offer repeats a benefit.');
    seen.add(c.type);

  if (problems.length) fail('The offer is outside the mandate.', 'policy', { problems });

  if (precision !== 2 || terms.currency !== mandate.product.currency) fail('This offer must use the mandate’s two-decimal currency.', 'not_deliverable');
  const priceOff = terms.components.filter(c => c.type === 'price').reduce((n, c) => n + cents(c.amount_off), 0);

  // variant can occupy two lines at adjacent prices; reject transformed results.
  const lower = Math.floor(items / terms.quantity), higherQty = items % terms.quantity;
  if (lower / 100 < unitFloor(mandate) - 1e-9) fail('The exact unit prices are outside the mandate.', 'policy');

  if (higherQty) lineItems.push({ variantId: terms.variant_id, quantity: higherQty, priceOverride: money(lower + 1, terms.currency) });

  if (gift) {
    if (!GID.test(gift.variant_id || '') || gift.variant_id !== mandate.concessions?.gift?.variant_id || gift.variant_id === terms.variant_id) fail('The gift needs its separately approved catalog variant.', 'not_deliverable');

  const shippingTitle = `OfferAd ${express ? 'Express' : 'Standard'} (${days}-day delivery)`;
  return { terms, items, shipping, gift, lineItems, shippingTitle, deferred: terms.components.filter(c => DEFERRED.includes(c.type)).map(c => ({ ...c, currency: terms.currency })) };
}

export function draftAdapter({ shop, token, apiVersion = '2026-10', fetchFn = fetch, now = () => Date.now(), timeoutMs = 15000, readyRetryMs = 100 } = {}) {

// Seller mandates: what each shop told OfferAd it may give, per product.
// In the app these come from the merchant's settings; here they are the two
// shops the prototype runs against. Costs, floors and budgets never leave the
// service: publicOffer() in policy.js strips them from every reply.

const gid = id => `gid://shopify/ProductVariant/${id}`;

// Concessions shared by a shop's products unless a product overrides them.
const SNOWBOARD_SHOP = {
  currency: 'USD',
  pace: 'balanced',
  shipping: { standard: { days: 6, price: 19.9, cost: 19.9 }, express: { days: 2, price: 39.9, cost: 34 } },
  concessions: {
    price: { on: true },
    free_shipping: { on: true },
    express_upgrade: { on: true },
    gift: { on: true, variant_id: gid('45900666142883'), handle: 'selling-plans-ski-wax', title: 'Ski wax (regular $24.95)', value: 24.95, cost: 8 },
    extended_returns: { on: true, days: 60, base_days: 30, cost: 6 },
    delivery_guarantee: { on: true, credit: 25, cost: 3 },
    next_order_credit: { on: true, amount: 40, cost: 18, valid_days: 90 },
    bulk: { on: true, tiers: [{ qty: 2, pct: 5 }, { qty: 4, pct: 8 }] },
  },
  price_match: {
    on: true,
    beat_by: 0,
    trusted_domains: ['rei.com', 'evo.com', 'backcountry.com', 'burton.com', 'tactics.com', 'peakboards.demo'],
    blocked_domains: ['ebay.', 'facebook.com', 'craigslist.org', 'aliexpress.', 'temu.com', 'mercari.com', 'poshmark.com'],
    untrusted_cap_pct: 5,
    title_match_cap_pct: 5,
    min_price_ratio: 0.5,
  },
};

const product = (shop, p) => ({
  ...shop,
  ...p.overrides,
  shop: shop.shop,
  product: { id: p.id, variant_id: gid(p.variant), variant_numeric_id: p.variant, handle: p.handle, title: p.title, brand: p.brand, gtin: p.gtin ?? null, mpn: p.mpn ?? null, sku: p.sku ?? null, list: p.list, currency: shop.currency },
  unit_cost: p.unit_cost,
  floor: p.floor,
  stock: p.stock,
  budget_per_order: p.budget_per_order,
});

// The catalog is the sample catalog of the development store, with identifiers
// and costs added by hand so price matching has something to compare.
const SNOWBOARDS = [
  { id: '8778500112547', variant: '45900666110115', handle: 'the-complete-snowboard', title: 'The Complete Snowboard', brand: 'Snowboard Vendor', gtin: '0840123456784', mpn: 'SV-COMPLETE-154', list: 699.95, unit_cost: 410, floor: 545, stock: 10, budget_per_order: 150 },
  { id: '8778500047011', variant: '45900666077347', handle: 'the-videographer-snowboard', title: 'The Videographer Snowboard', brand: 'Snowboard Vendor', gtin: '0840123456791', mpn: 'SV-VIDEO-158', list: 885.95, unit_cost: 520, floor: 690, stock: 6, budget_per_order: 190 },
  { id: '8778500014243', variant: '45900666011811', handle: 'the-collection-snowboard-hydrogen', title: 'The Collection Snowboard: Hydrogen', brand: 'Hydrogen Vendor', gtin: '0840123456807', mpn: 'HV-HYDRO-152', list: 600, unit_cost: 350, floor: 470, stock: 20, budget_per_order: 130 },
  { id: '8778499948707', variant: '45900666142883', handle: 'selling-plans-ski-wax', title: 'Selling Plans Ski Wax', brand: 'Snowboard Vendor', gtin: '0840123456814', mpn: 'SV-WAX-50', list: 24.95, unit_cost: 8, floor: 16, stock: 200, budget_per_order: 9,
    overrides: { concessions: { ...SNOWBOARD_SHOP.concessions, gift: { on: false }, express_upgrade: { on: false }, next_order_credit: { on: true, amount: 5, cost: 2, valid_days: 90 }, extended_returns: { on: false }, delivery_guarantee: { on: false } } } },
];

export const SHOPS = {
  // The owner's development store: codes are minted through the Admin API.
  'mustafa-test-dev.myshopify.com': { ...SNOWBOARD_SHOP, shop: 'mustafa-test-dev.myshopify.com', name: 'Mustafa Test Dev', storefront: 'https://mustafa-test-dev.myshopify.com', settle: 'shopify', price_match: { ...SNOWBOARD_SHOP.price_match, trusted_domains: SNOWBOARD_SHOP.price_match.trusted_domains.filter(host => host !== 'peakboards.demo') } },
  // The stand-in storefront this worker serves itself, for agent runs that need a public page.
  demo: { ...SNOWBOARD_SHOP, shop: 'demo', name: 'Powder Lab', storefront: null, settle: 'dry' },
};

export const shopConfig = shop => SHOPS[shop] || null;

export function listProducts(shop) {
  const s = SHOPS[shop];
  return s ? SNOWBOARDS.map(p => product(s, p)) : [];
}

const norm = x => String(x ?? '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim();

// Find a product from whatever the agent sent: a variant or product id (numeric
// or gid), a handle, a product URL, or words from the title.
export function mandateFor(shop, ref) {
  const all = listProducts(shop);
  const raw = String(ref ?? '').trim();
  if (!raw) return null;
  const digits = raw.match(/(\d{8,})/g) || [];
  for (const d of digits) {
    const hit = all.find(m => m.product.variant_numeric_id === d || m.product.id === d);
    if (hit) return hit;
  }
  const handle = (raw.match(/\/products\/([a-z0-9-]+)/i) || [])[1] || raw;
  const byHandle = all.find(m => m.product.handle === handle.toLowerCase());
  if (byHandle) return byHandle;
  const words = norm(raw).split(' ').filter(w => w.length > 2);
  if (!words.length) return null;
  const scored = all.map(m => ({ m, score: words.filter(w => norm(m.product.title).includes(w)).length / words.length })).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  return scored[0].score >= 0.6 ? scored[0].m : null;
}
shopify/offers/src/lib/mcp.js
// The MCP door: the store's offer desk as three tools a buyer's agent can call.
// Remote MCP over Streamable HTTP with plain JSON replies and nothing kept on
// the server between calls, so it works behind Shopify's app proxy (no cookies,
// no streaming). One endpoint answers both protocol eras, because agents ship
// with either: the handshake revisions (initialize; 2025-06-18 and its
// neighbours) and the per-request revision 2026-07-28 (no handshake; version
// and client travel in _meta on every request).
// https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-06-18/basic/transports
// https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/versioning

import { PRIORITIES } from './policy.js';
import { SHOPS } from './mandates.js';

export const PROTOCOL = '2025-06-18';
// The server uses nothing that differs between these, so it speaks all of them.
const HANDSHAKE = ['2025-11-25', PROTOCOL, '2025-03-26', '2024-11-05'];
const PER_REQUEST = ['2026-07-28'];
const SUPPORTED = [...PER_REQUEST, ...HANDSHAKE];
const SERVER = { name: 'offerad-offers', title: 'OfferAd offer desk', version: '0.1.0' };
const META = 'io.modelcontextprotocol/';

const TOOL_NAMES = ['get_offer_options', 'request_offer', 'accept_offer'];
// What the descriptions tell agents about lifetimes. Mirrors the service defaults.
const OFFER_MINUTES = 30;
const CODE_MINUTES = 60;
const LIST_TTL_MS = 300000;
export const MAX_BODY = 65536;
const MAX_BATCH = 20;
const SESSION_ID = /^[\x21-\x7e]{1,128}$/;
// Nothing is kept between calls, so the session id issued at the handshake
// carries the name the client gave there. Later calls can then be told apart
// in the merchant's log; nothing is decided on it.
const SESSION_NAME = /^([a-z0-9-]{1,24})\.[0-9a-f-]{36}$/;
const slug = name => (typeof name === 'string' ? name : '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 24).replace(/-+$/, '');
// Seller-only keys. The service strips them already; a door is the last place to notice a slip.
const PRIVATE = new Set(['seller_cost', 'unit_cost', 'cost', 'floor', 'budget', 'budget_per_order', 'room', 'pace']);

// Open to every origin on purpose: a public desk with no cookies and no
// credentials, called from agents' browsers as well as their servers. For the
// same reason the Origin header is not checked: there is nothing here that a
// page could reach only through the visitor's browser.
export const CORS = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': '*',
  'Access-Control-Expose-Headers': 'Mcp-Session-Id',
  'Access-Control-Max-Age': '86400',
};

// Own keys only: a shop named "constructor" is not a shop.
const shopOf = shop => (typeof shop === 'string' && Object.hasOwn(SHOPS, shop) ? SHOPS[shop] : null);
const priorityList = Object.keys(PRIORITIES).join(', ');
const priorityHelp = Object.entries(PRIORITIES).map(([id, label]) => `${id} (${label.toLowerCase()})`).join(', ');

// The tool descriptions are the product: an agent that has never heard of this
// service decides from them alone whether to ask. They say what happens, what
// it costs (nothing), who answers (the seller's side) and when asking helps,
// and leave the decision to the agent: no orders aimed at the model, nothing
// promotional. Each stays under 1024 characters, the smallest description
// limit among the clients that read tool lists, so none is cut or refused.
export function toolsFor(door = {}) {
  const connect = !!door.connect;
  const name = connect ? null : shopOf(door.shop)?.name;
  const store = connect ? 'an online store that uses OfferAd' : name && name.length <= 40 ? name : 'this store';
  const elsewhere = 'For other stores the reply is store_not_enrolled and nothing is sent to them.';
  // Who answers, said in full once and briefly after that.
  const who = connect
    ? `OfferAd is a service merchants install; it answers for the seller, within limits each merchant set. ${elsewhere}`
    : 'The answer comes from the seller\'s side: the store\'s own offer service (OfferAd, an app the merchant installed), within limits the merchant set.';
  const whoShort = connect
    ? `OfferAd answers for the seller, within limits each merchant set. ${elsewhere}`
    : 'The answer comes from the seller\'s side: the store\'s offer service (OfferAd), within limits the merchant set.';

  const storeField = connect
    ? { store: { type: 'string', description: 'The store: its domain (for example shop.example.com) or the URL of the product\'s page on it.' } }
    : {};
  const product = {
    type: 'string',
    description: `The product: its page URL on the store, its handle, a Shopify product or variant id, or its name.${connect ? ' Can be left out when store is the product page URL.' : ''}`,
  };
  const titles = [
    `See what ${connect ? 'a store' : store} can offer`,
    `Ask ${connect ? 'a store' : store} for an offer`,
    'Accept an offer and prepare checkout',
  ];

  return [
    {
      name: 'get_offer_options',
      title: titles[0],
      description: [
        `Shows what ${store} can offer on one of its products beyond the listed price and terms: a lower price, free or faster shipping, a free add-on, longer returns, an on-time delivery guarantee, or credit on a later order. The reply says which of these are available for the product, its list price and standard delivery, the priorities an offer can be built around, and whether the store checks links to lower prices elsewhere. It gives no amounts; request_offer returns actual offers.`,
        'This is a free, read-only lookup. Nothing is bought, reserved or added to a cart, and no account or personal detail is needed.',
        `Useful when a user is considering a product from ${connect ? 'such a store' : 'this store'} and it helps to know whether the listed price and terms are final.`,
        who,
      ].join('\n\n'),
      inputSchema: { type: 'object', properties: { ...storeField, product }, required: connect ? ['store'] : ['product'] },
      annotations: { title: titles[0], readOnlyHint: true, openWorldHint: false },
    },
    {
      name: 'request_offer',
      title: titles[1],
      description: [
        `Asks ${store} for a concrete offer on one of its products, built around what matters most to the user. It can take a link to the same product selling for less elsewhere, which the store checks itself.`,
        `The reply has one to three offers, each with an offer_id, what is included, exact totals, the delivery time and an expiry (${OFFER_MINUTES} minutes). An offer is not always a lower price: it can be free or faster shipping, a free add-on, longer returns or credit on a later order.`,
        'Asking is free and commits the user to nothing: nothing is bought, reserved or charged, and no name, email, address or payment detail is needed. The same request gets the same offers; only a different priority, quantity, deadline or a verified cheaper link changes them.',
        `Useful before buying at the listed price, or when the user has seen the product for less elsewhere. ${whoShort}`,
      ].join('\n\n'),
      inputSchema: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          ...storeField,
          product,
          quantity: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, description: 'How many the user wants. Defaults to 1.' },
          priority: { type: 'string', enum: Object.keys(PRIORITIES), description: `What matters most to the user for this purchase: ${priorityHelp}. Left out, the reply asks which one applies.` },
          need_by_days: { type: 'number', minimum: 0, description: 'Days from today by which the user needs delivery, when there is a deadline.' },
          competing_offer_url: { type: 'string', description: 'Public page of another shop selling the same product, new and in stock, for less. The store fetches the page itself and checks the product and the price. A page it cannot read, or one showing a different product, is declined with the reason. One link per product per hour is checked.' },
          note: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional short note about what the user is looking for, kept with the request for the merchant. It does not change the offer and is no place for personal details.' },
        },
        required: connect ? ['store'] : ['product'],
      },
      annotations: { title: titles[1], readOnlyHint: false, destructiveHint: false, idempotentHint: false, openWorldHint: true },
    },
    {
      name: 'accept_offer',
      title: titles[2],
      description: [
        `Turns one offer from request_offer into a checkout link with the approved terms applied for ${connect ? 'the store that made it' : store} and a cart link that already carries the code. It places no order and takes no payment: the purchase still happens in the store's own checkout, where the user or their agent completes it or walks away. A code that is never used simply expires, and accepting costs nothing.`,
        'A code is issued only when user_approved is true, meaning the user has seen this offer and agreed to it. Otherwise the reply is needs_approval and nothing is issued. No personal detail is needed.',
        `The reply gives the code or codes, what they do, when they expire (${CODE_MINUTES} minutes) and how to apply them: the discounts.codes field of the store's cart and checkout tools, the cart link, or the discount box at checkout. Parts that are not money at checkout (longer returns, a delivery guarantee, later credit) are added to the order after purchase and listed in the reply. Accepting the same offer again returns the same code.`,
      ].join('\n\n'),
      inputSchema: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          ...storeField,
          offer_id: { type: 'string', description: 'The offer_id of the chosen offer, from request_offer.' },
          user_approved: { type: 'boolean', description: 'true once the user has seen this offer (what is included and the total) and agreed to it. With false, or left out, the reply is needs_approval and no code is issued.' },
        },
        required: [...(connect ? ['store'] : []), 'offer_id', 'user_approved'],
      },
      annotations: { title: titles[2], readOnlyHint: false, destructiveHint: false, idempotentHint: true, openWorldHint: false },
    },
  ];
}

function instructions(door) {
  const steps = 'say what kinds of offer a store makes on a product (get_offer_options), make concrete offers with exact totals (request_offer), and turn an offer the user agreed to into a checkout link with the approved terms applied (accept_offer)';
  if (door.connect) return `OfferAd is an offer desk that online stores install. For a store that uses it, this server can ${steps}. It answers for the seller, never places an order or takes payment, and replies store_not_enrolled for stores that do not use it.`;
  const name = shopOf(door.shop)?.name;
  return `This is the offer desk of ${name || 'this store'}, run by OfferAd for the seller. It can ${steps}. It never places an order or takes payment: buying happens in the store's own checkout.`;
}

const parseUrl = x => { try { return new URL(x); } catch { return null; } };
const bareHost = url => url.hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, '');

// The cross-store door takes a domain or a product URL and finds the shop that
// runs the app. `hosted(url)` names the shop this worker serves on its own
// host, for the stand-in storefront; it gets the parsed URL and returns a shop or null.
export function resolveStore(store, hosted) {
  const raw = String(store ?? '').trim();
  if (!raw) return null;
  if (shopOf(raw.toLowerCase())) return { shop: raw.toLowerCase(), product: null };
  const url = parseUrl(/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//i.test(raw) ? raw : `https://${raw}`);
  if (!url || !/^https?:$/.test(url.protocol)) return null;
  const host = bareHost(url);
  const front = k => { const u = parseUrl(SHOPS[k].storefront); return u && bareHost(u); };
  const shop = Object.keys(SHOPS).find(k => k === host || k === `${host}.myshopify.com` || front(k) === host) || hosted?.(url) || null;
  if (!shopOf(shop)) return null;
  return { shop, product: /\/products\/[^/?#]+/i.test(url.pathname) ? raw : null };
}

const given = x => x !== undefined && x !== null && x !== '';
const text = (x, max) => (given(x) && String(x).trim() ? String(x).trim().slice(0, max) : undefined);

// One reading of the arguments for every door: tool calls send JSON types,
// query strings and forms send text, and models now and then quote a number.
export function offerArgs(raw) {
  const a = raw && typeof raw === 'object' && !Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : {};
  const problems = [];
  const args = {
    store: text(a.store, 500),
    product: text(a.product, 500),
    competing_offer_url: text(a.competing_offer_url, 2000),
    note: text(a.note, 500),
    offer_id: text(a.offer_id, 200),
    // Approval is never guessed: only true counts, so "yes" and 1 do not.
    user_approved: a.user_approved === true || a.user_approved === 'true',
  };
  if (given(a.quantity)) {
    const q = Number(a.quantity);
    if (Number.isInteger(q) && q >= 1) args.quantity = q;
    else problems.push('quantity is a whole number, 1 or more');
  }
  if (given(a.need_by_days)) {
    const d = Number(a.need_by_days);
    if (Number.isFinite(d) && d >= 0) args.need_by_days = d;
    else problems.push('need_by_days is a number of days, 0 or more');
  }
  if (given(a.priority)) {
    const p = String(a.priority).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[\s-]+/g, '_');
    if (Object.hasOwn(PRIORITIES, p)) args.priority = p;
    else problems.push(`priority is one of ${priorityList}, or left out`);
  }
  return { args, problems };
}

const invalid = problems => ({ status: 'invalid_request', error: `${problems.join('; ')}.` });

export const notEnrolled = store => ({
  status: 'store_not_enrolled',
  store: store ?? null,
  message: 'This store does not use OfferAd, so there is no offer desk to ask here. Nothing was sent to the store; its listed price and terms are what apply.',
});

// What leaves through a door: the service's reply minus any seller-only key.
export function publicReply(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(publicReply);
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return value;
  const out = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(value)) {
    if (PRIVATE.has(k)) { console.warn(JSON.stringify({ at: 'door', warning: `seller-only field "${k}" stopped at the door` })); continue; }
    out[k] = publicReply(v);
  }
  return out;
}

// A door that breaks answers in words the agent can use, with nothing internal
// in them; the cause goes to the log under the same reference.
function failure(e, where) {
  const ref = crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
  console.error(JSON.stringify({ at: 'door', ref, where, error: String(e?.stack || e) }));
  return { status: 'error', error: `The store could not answer just now (ref ${ref}). Nothing was bought or charged, and asking again is safe.` };
}

async function run(door, name, raw) {
  const { args, problems } = offerArgs(raw);
  let shop = door.shop;
  if (door.connect) {
    if (!args.store) return invalid(['store is needed: the store\'s domain or the product\'s page URL', ...problems]);
    const hit = resolveStore(args.store, door.hosted);
    if (!hit) return notEnrolled(args.store);
    shop = hit.shop;
    args.product ??= hit.product ?? undefined;
  } else if (!shopOf(shop)) {
    return notEnrolled(shop);
  }
  // With no session the service falls back to the caller's address, so none is made up here.
  const who = { session: door.session || undefined, client: door.client || null };
  if (name === 'accept_offer') {
    if (!args.offer_id) problems.unshift('offer_id is needed: the offer_id of one offer from request_offer');
    if (problems.length) return invalid(problems);
    return door.service.accept({ shop, offer_id: args.offer_id, user_approved: args.user_approved, ...who });
  }
  if (!args.product) problems.unshift('product is needed: its page URL, handle, id or name');
  if (problems.length) return invalid(problems);
  if (name === 'get_offer_options') return door.service.options({ shop, product: args.product, ...who });
  return door.service.request({
    shop, product: args.product, quantity: args.quantity, priority: args.priority, need_by_days: args.need_by_days,
    competing_offer_url: args.competing_offer_url, note: args.note, ...who,
  });
}

// One tool call, for this door and for the JSON door beside it. Returns only
// what may leave the service; throws only for a tool that does not exist.
// `door` = { service, shop, connect, hosted, session, client }, where client
// is { ip, name }: the address the rate limits count and a name for the log.
export async function callTool(door, name, raw) {
  if (!TOOL_NAMES.includes(name)) throw Object.assign(new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`), { code: -32602 });
  try {
    const out = await run(door, name, raw);
    if (!out || typeof out !== 'object') throw new Error(`${name} returned no reply`);
    return publicReply(out);
  } catch (e) {
    return failure(e, name);
  }
}

const fail = (id, code, message, data, status) => ({
  status,
  reply: { jsonrpc: '2.0', id, error: { code, message, ...(data === undefined ? {} : { data }) } },
});

// Header values that are not plain ASCII arrive as =?base64?...?= in the per-request revision.
function plain(value) {
  const m = /^=\?base64\?(.*)\?=$/.exec(value ?? '');
  if (!m) return value;
  try { return new TextDecoder().decode(Uint8Array.from(atob(m[1]), c => c.charCodeAt(0))); } catch { return value; }
}

// The per-request revision mirrors version, method and tool name into headers
// and has the server reject a request whose headers and body disagree.
// https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports/streamable-http#server-validation
function headerMismatch(door, http, version, method, params) {
  if (!http) return null;
  const pairs = [['MCP-Protocol-Version', http.version, version], ['Mcp-Method', http.method, method]];
  if (method === 'tools/call') pairs.push(['Mcp-Name', plain(http.name), typeof params.name === 'string' ? params.name : '']);
  for (const [header, got, want] of pairs) {
    if (got == null) {
      // A proxy in front may drop headers it does not know; then the body is all there is.
      if (!door.relaxHeaders) return `${header} header is missing`;
      continue;
    }
    if (got !== want) return `${header} header value '${got}' does not match body value '${want}'`;
  }
  return null;
}

// One message in, one answer out: { reply, status, headers }. reply is null
// for notifications. Same shape of switch as the first OfferAd connector.
async function answer(door, msg, http) {
  if (!msg || typeof msg !== 'object' || Array.isArray(msg) || msg.jsonrpc !== '2.0') {
    return fail(null, -32600, 'Invalid Request: not a JSON-RPC 2.0 message', undefined, 400);
  }
  const { id, method } = msg;
  const params = msg.params && typeof msg.params === 'object' && !Array.isArray(msg.params) ? msg.params : {};
  if (typeof method !== 'string') {
    // A reply to a request this server never made: taken and dropped.
    if ('result' in msg || 'error' in msg) return { reply: null };
    return fail(null, -32600, 'Invalid Request: method is missing', undefined, 400);
  }
  if (id === undefined) return { reply: null };
  if (typeof id !== 'string' && !Number.isFinite(id)) return fail(null, -32600, 'Invalid Request: id is a string or a number', undefined, 400);

  const meta = params._meta && typeof params._meta === 'object' ? params._meta : {};
  const asked = meta[`${META}protocolVersion`];
  const handshake = method === 'initialize';
  const requested = handshake ? undefined : asked ?? http?.version ?? undefined;
  if (requested !== undefined && !SUPPORTED.includes(requested)) {
    return fail(id, -32022, 'Unsupported protocol version', { supported: SUPPORTED, requested: String(requested) }, 400);
  }
  const modern = !handshake && (PER_REQUEST.includes(requested) || method === 'server/discover');
  if (modern) {
    if (!PER_REQUEST.includes(asked)) return fail(id, -32602, `Invalid params: _meta["${META}protocolVersion"] is needed on every request and is one of ${PER_REQUEST.join(', ')}`, undefined, 400);
    const caps = meta[`${META}clientCapabilities`];
    if (!caps || typeof caps !== 'object') return fail(id, -32602, `Invalid params: _meta["${META}clientCapabilities"] is needed on every request`, undefined, 400);
    const mismatch = headerMismatch(door, http, asked, method, params);
    if (mismatch) return fail(id, -32020, `Header mismatch: ${mismatch}`, undefined, 400);
  }

  const done = (result, headers) => ({
    headers,
    reply: { jsonrpc: '2.0', id, result: modern ? { resultType: 'complete', ...result, _meta: { [`${META}serverInfo`]: SERVER } } : result },
  });
  // The per-request revision wants a freshness hint on lists; the tools are the same for every caller.
  const cached = modern ? { ttlMs: LIST_TTL_MS, cacheScope: 'public' } : {};
  const notFound = () => fail(id, -32601, `Method not found: ${method}`, undefined, modern ? 404 : undefined);

  try {
    switch (method) {
      case 'initialize': {
        const want = params.protocolVersion;
        // A fresh id per handshake gives the service a stable session to count requests against.
        return done({
          protocolVersion: HANDSHAKE.includes(want) ? want : PROTOCOL,
          capabilities: { tools: { listChanged: false } },
          serverInfo: SERVER,
          instructions: instructions(door),
        }, { 'Mcp-Session-Id': `${slug(params.clientInfo?.name) || 'client'}.${crypto.randomUUID()}` });
      }
      case 'server/discover':
        return done({ supportedVersions: SUPPORTED, capabilities: { tools: { listChanged: false } }, instructions: instructions(door), ...cached });
      case 'tools/list':
        return done({ tools: toolsFor(door), ...cached });
      case 'tools/call': {
        if (typeof params.name !== 'string') throw Object.assign(new Error('Invalid params: name is the name of a tool'), { code: -32602 });
        const raw = params.arguments ?? {};
        if (typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) throw Object.assign(new Error('Invalid params: arguments is an object'), { code: -32602 });
        // Who the client says it is: on every request in the per-request revision, in the session id before it.
        const agent = slug(meta[`${META}clientInfo`]?.name) || door.agent;
        const client = agent ? { ...door.client, name: (door.client?.name ? `${door.client.name} (${agent})` : agent).slice(0, 80) } : door.client;
        const out = await callTool({ ...door, client }, params.name, raw);
        return done({
          content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(out, null, 2) }],
          structuredContent: out,
          isError: Boolean(out.error),
        });
      }
      // The handshake revisions had these; clients of that era call them without looking at capabilities.
      case 'ping': return modern ? notFound() : done({});
      case 'resources/list': return modern ? notFound() : done({ resources: [] });
      case 'resources/templates/list': return modern ? notFound() : done({ resourceTemplates: [] });
      case 'prompts/list': return modern ? notFound() : done({ prompts: [] });
      default: return notFound();
    }
  } catch (e) {
    if (e?.code) return fail(id, e.code, String(e.message || e));
    console.error(JSON.stringify({ at: 'mcp', method, error: String(e?.stack || e) }));
    return fail(id, -32603, 'Internal error');
  }
}

// One JSON-RPC message, for callers without HTTP around it. null for a notification.
export async function rpc(door, msg) {
  return (await answer(door, msg, null)).reply;
}

// A request body as bytes, or null when it is larger than `max`: these doors
// are open to anyone, so nothing is read without a limit. The bytes are kept as
// they arrived for the callers that check a signature over them.
export async function readBytes(request, max = MAX_BODY) {
  if (Number(request.headers.get('content-length')) > max) return null;
  if (!request.body) return new Uint8Array(0);
  const reader = request.body.getReader();
  const chunks = [];
  let size = 0;
  for (;;) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;
    size += value.byteLength;
    if (size > max) { await reader.cancel(); return null; }
    chunks.push(value);
  }
  const out = new Uint8Array(size);
  let at = 0;
  for (const c of chunks) { out.set(c, at); at += c.byteLength; }
  return out;
}

// The same body as text, or null when it is too large.
export async function readBody(request, max = MAX_BODY) {
  const bytes = await readBytes(request, max);
  return bytes && new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
}

const send = ({ reply, status, headers }) => (reply
  ? Response.json(reply, { status: status || 200, headers: { ...CORS, ...headers } })
  : new Response(null, { status: 202, headers: CORS }));

// The HTTP door. `door` = { service, shop, connect, hosted, session, client, relaxHeaders }:
// shop is fixed for a store's own endpoint; with connect every tool names its store.
export async function handleMcp(request, door) {
  if (request.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: CORS });
  // POST is the whole transport: there is no stream to open with GET and no session to end with DELETE.
  if (request.method !== 'POST') {
    return Response.json({ error: 'This is an MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP): send JSON-RPC 2.0 messages with POST.' }, { status: 405, headers: { ...CORS, Allow: 'POST, OPTIONS' } });
  }
  const body = await readBody(request);
  if (body === null) return send(fail(null, -32600, 'Invalid Request: body too large', undefined, 413));
  let msg;
  try { msg = JSON.parse(body); } catch { return send(fail(null, -32700, 'Parse error', undefined, 400)); }

  const header = name => request.headers.get(name);
  const sid = header('mcp-session-id');
  const held = sid && SESSION_ID.test(sid);
  const call = { ...door, session: held ? `mcp:${sid}` : door.session, agent: held ? SESSION_NAME.exec(sid)?.[1] : undefined };

  // Batches left the protocol with 2025-06-18; clients of the revision before it still send them.
  if (Array.isArray(msg)) {
    if (!msg.length || msg.length > MAX_BATCH) return send(fail(null, -32600, `Invalid Request: a batch holds 1 to ${MAX_BATCH} messages`, undefined, 400));
    const replies = [];
    for (const m of msg) {
      const { reply } = await answer(call, m, null);
      if (reply) replies.push(reply);
    }
    return replies.length ? Response.json(replies, { headers: CORS }) : new Response(null, { status: 202, headers: CORS });
  }
  return send(await answer(call, msg, { version: header('mcp-protocol-version'), method: header('mcp-method'), name: header('mcp-name') }));
}
shopify/offers/src/lib/pages.js
// The HTML doors. Every export takes ctx = { url, request, env, shop, service,
// hooks, origin, prefix } and returns a Response. Three kinds of page:
//   the offer desk as plain pages (/offer) that work with no script,
//   "Powder Lab" (/demo), the stand-in storefront agents are sent to shop in,
//   "Peak Boards" (/rival), a second shop whose pages serve as competing-offer links.
// Powder Lab is also the control arm of the experiment: with no discovery hook
// active its pages say nothing about the desk, so no shop markup, class name or
// style here may carry a word of it. scripts/check-pages.mjs holds that line.

import { PRIORITIES } from './policy.js';
import { shopConfig, listProducts, mandateFor } from './mandates.js';
import { dryAdapter } from './settle.js';
import { doStore } from './store.js';

const DEMO = 'demo';
const HOOKS = ['box', 'desc', 'jsonld', 'webmcp', 'policy'];
// Quoted in the documents below. They mirror the service defaults.
const LIMITS = { offer_minutes: 30, code_minutes: 60, requests_per_product_per_hour: 3, link_checks_per_product_per_hour: 1 };
// Seller-only keys, the same list the MCP door stops. The log page has a public address.
const PRIVATE = new Set(['seller_cost', 'unit_cost', 'cost', 'floor', 'budget', 'budget_per_order', 'room', 'pace']);

const r2 = x => Math.round(x * 100) / 100;
const num = x => (x === null || x === undefined || x === '' || !Number.isFinite(Number(x)) ? null : Number(x));
const arr = x => (Array.isArray(x) ? x : []);
const str = (x, max = 500) => (typeof x === 'string' || typeof x === 'number' ? String(x).trim().slice(0, max) : '');

// --- markup ----------------------------------------------------------------

const ESC = { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' };
const esc = x => String(x).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ESC[c]);

// Markup built in this file. Anything else that reaches a template is text and
// is escaped there, so a value from a request or from the service cannot turn
// into markup because someone forgot a call.
class Markup {
  constructor(s) { this.s = s; }
  toString() { return this.s; }
}
const flat = v => (v instanceof Markup ? v.s : Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(flat).join('') : v === null || v === undefined || v === false || v === true ? '' : esc(v));
const html = (strings, ...values) => new Markup(strings.reduce((out, s, i) => out + flat(values[i - 1]) + s));

// JSON inside a script element: nothing in it may end the element or open a comment.
const ld = data => new Markup(`<script type="application/ld+json">${JSON.stringify(data).replace(/[<>&\u2028\u2029]/g, c => `\\u${c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).padStart(4, '0')}`)}</script>\n`);

const SIGN = { USD: '$', GBP: '£', EUR: '€' };
function money(x, cur = 'USD') {
  const n = num(x);
  if (n === null) return '';
  const digits = Math.abs(n).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  return `${n < 0 ? '-' : ''}${SIGN[cur] ?? ''}${digits}${SIGN[cur] ? '' : ` ${cur}`}`;
}

// A moment the service named, as a <time> and how far away it is.
function until(x, now = Date.now()) {
  const d = new Date(typeof x === 'number' && x < 1e11 ? x * 1000 : x);
  if (x === null || x === undefined || x === '' || Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  const mins = Math.round((d.getTime() - now) / 60000);
  const away = mins > 1 ? ` (in about ${mins} minutes)` : mins >= 0 ? ' (in about a minute)' : ' (passed)';
  return html`<time datetime="${d.toISOString()}">${d.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ')} UTC</time>${away}`;
}

const days = n => `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'day' : 'days'}`;

// Whatever shape a piece of a reply has, as plain sentences. An object that
// names a thing (and perhaps how it comes about) is one sentence, or two.
function sentences(v) {
  if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return [];
  if (typeof v !== 'object') return [String(v)];
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.flatMap(sentences);
  const said = ['text', 'label', 'headline', 'what'].map(key => v[key]).find(x => typeof x === 'string' && x);
  if (said) return [typeof v.how === 'string' && v.how ? `${/[.!?]$/.test(said) ? said : `${said}.`} ${v.how}` : said];
  return Object.entries(v).flatMap(([k, x]) => sentences(x).map(s => `${k.replace(/_/g, ' ')}: ${s}`));
}

// A link the service handed over is shown as a link only when it is one. A
// path on this site gets the proxy prefix it was written without, and the
// hooks switch the request carried.
function safeUrl(ctx, u) {
  const s = str(u, 2000);
  if (/^\/(?![/\\])/.test(s)) {
    const p = prefixOf(ctx);
    const path = p && !s.startsWith(`${p}/`) ? p + s : s;
    const hooks = ctx.url.searchParams.get('hooks');
    return hooks === null || /[?&]hooks=/.test(path) ? path : `${path}${path.includes('?') ? '&' : '?'}hooks=${encodeURIComponent(hooks)}`;
  }
  try { return ['http:', 'https:'].includes(new URL(s).protocol) ? s : null; } catch { return null; }
}

// --- the request -----------------------------------------------------------

const originOf = ctx => String(ctx.origin || ctx.url.origin).replace(/\/+$/, '');
const prefixOf = ctx => String(ctx.prefix || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
const hooked = (ctx, name) => (Array.isArray(ctx.hooks) ? ctx.hooks.includes(name) : !!ctx.hooks?.has?.(name));
const anyHook = ctx => HOOKS.some(h => hooked(ctx, h));

// The path the route saw: the proxy prefix is not part of it.
function route(ctx) {
  const p = prefixOf(ctx);
  const path = ctx.url.pathname;
  return p && path.startsWith(p) ? path.slice(p.length) || '/' : path;
}

// The one path segment after a route's fixed part, or '' when there is none.
function tail(ctx, base) {
  const path = route(ctx);
  if (!path.startsWith(base)) return '';
  try { return decodeURIComponent(path.slice(base.length).split('/')[0]); } catch { return ''; }
}

const query = params => {
  const q = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params || {})) if (v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== '') q.set(k, String(v));
  const s = q.toString();
  return s ? `?${s}` : '';
};

// A link a person follows. It carries the proxy prefix always, and the hooks
// switch when the request set one, so an arm chosen in the URL survives a click.
function href(ctx, path, params) {
  const hooks = ctx.url.searchParams.get('hooks');
  const q = query(params);
  return `${prefixOf(ctx)}${path}${q}${hooks === null ? '' : `${q ? '&' : '?'}hooks=${encodeURIComponent(hooks)}`}`;
}
// GET forms replace the query of their action, so the switch rides along as a field.
const carry = ctx => (ctx.url.searchParams.has('hooks') ? html`<input type="hidden" name="hooks" value="${ctx.url.searchParams.get('hooks')}">` : '');
// An address written down for a program or quoted in text: absolute, nothing extra.
const address = (ctx, path, params) => `${originOf(ctx)}${prefixOf(ctx)}${path}${query(params)}`;

// Posted fields as a plain object. A worker that already read the body hands
// it over as ctx.body; otherwise it is read here from a copy of the request.
async function posted(ctx) {
  const given = ctx.body ?? ctx.form;
  if (given && typeof given === 'object') return typeof given.entries === 'function' ? Object.fromEntries(given.entries()) : given;
  const req = ctx.request;
  if (!req || req.bodyUsed || req.method === 'GET' || req.method === 'HEAD') return {};
  try {
    if ((req.headers.get('content-type') || '').includes('json')) {
      const v = await req.clone().json();
      return v && typeof v === 'object' ? v : {};
    }
    return Object.fromEntries((await req.clone().formData()).entries());
  } catch { return {}; }
}

// The worker's store, for the two pages that read it directly: handed over as
// ctx.store, or else the one Durable Object every shop shares.
const storeOf = ctx => (ctx.store && typeof ctx.store === 'object' ? ctx.store : ctx.env?.OFFERS ? doStore(ctx.env) : null);

// Who is asking, for the service's rate limits. The worker's own answer wins;
// without one the page door falls back to address plus browser, hashed.
async function who(ctx) {
  if (ctx.session) return { session: ctx.session, client: ctx.client ?? null };
  const h = ctx.request?.headers;
  const ip = h?.get('cf-connecting-ip') || (h?.get('x-forwarded-for') || '').split(',')[0].trim() || '';
  const ua = h?.get('user-agent') || '';
  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(`${ip}|${ua}`));
  const id = [...new Uint8Array(digest)].slice(0, 12).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
  return { session: `page:${id}`, client: ctx.client ?? { ip: ip || null, user_agent: ua.slice(0, 200) || null, door: 'page' } };
}

// --- responses and layout --------------------------------------------------

const HEADERS = {
  'content-type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8',
  'cache-control': 'no-store',
  'x-content-type-options': 'nosniff',
  'referrer-policy': 'same-origin',
  'content-security-policy': "base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; form-action 'self'",
};
// Documents for programs: readable from any origin, safe to keep for a while.
const OPEN = { 'access-control-allow-origin': '*', 'cache-control': 'public, max-age=300', 'x-content-type-options': 'nosniff' };
const send = (body, status = 200, headers = {}) => new Response(String(body), { status, headers: { ...HEADERS, ...headers } });
const sendJson = data => new Response(`${JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)}\n`, { headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', ...OPEN } });

// Light only: a page a person reads keeps its colours whatever the system theme is.
const CSS = `
:root{color-scheme:light only;--ink:#16222c;--soft:#566574;--line:#d8e0e7;--bg:#ffffff;--tint:#f2f6f9;--accent:#0a5ea8;--good:#10693d;--bad:#a12b1f}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}

a{color:var(--accent)}
h1{font-size:1.9rem;line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 .5rem}

.good{color:var(--good)}
.bad{color:var(--bad)}
.panel{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;background:#fff}
.panel h2,.panel h3{margin-top:0}
.stack{display:grid;gap:16px}
.inline{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap}

`;
const SHOP_CSS = `
.hero{background:var(--tint);border-radius:14px;padding:28px;margin-bottom:28px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:20px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
.card .text{padding:12px 14px 16px}

@media (max-width:800px){.product,.cols{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
