// two requests can never both read a counter before either writes it.
function operations(db, now) {
  let swept = 0;
  const sweep = t => {
    if (t - swept < SWEEP_EVERY_MS) return;
    swept = t;
    db.sweep(t, MAX_EVENTS);
  };
  const keepUntil = (rec, t) => (Date.parse(rec.expires_at) || t) + KEEP_MS;
  const put = (kind, id, rec) => {
    const t = now();
    sweep(t);
    db.put(kind, id, rec, keepUntil(rec, t));
  };
  const merge = (kind, id, patch) => {
    const cur = db.get(kind, id);
    if (!cur) return null;
    const next = { ...cur, ...patch };
    db.put(kind, id, next, keepUntil(next, now()));
    return next;
  };
  return {
    putOffer(rec) {
      if (rec?.id == null || rec.id === '') throw new TypeError('putOffer needs a record with an id');
      put('offer', String(rec.id), rec);
    },
    getOffer: id => db.get('offer', String(id)),
    updateOffer: (id, patch) => merge('offer', String(id), patch),
    putCode(rec) {
      if (!codeKey(rec?.code)) throw new TypeError('putCode needs a record with a code');
      put('code', codeKey(rec.code), rec);
    },
    getCode: code => db.get('code', codeKey(code)),
    updateCode: (code, patch) => merge('code', codeKey(code), patch),
    // A redemption belongs to one order. These read/write claims contain no
    // await, so another RPC cannot interleave between the decision and write.
    claimCode(code, order_id, opts = {}) {
      const key = codeKey(code);
      const rec = db.get('code', key);
      if (!rec) return { ok: false, reason: 'not_found' };
      if (!order_id) throw new TypeError('claimCode needs an order id');
      if (rec.used) return rec.order_id === order_id ? { ok: true, first: false } : { ok: false, reason: 'already_used' };
      if (!opts.observed_order && rec.revoked) return { ok: false, reason: 'revoked' };
      if (!opts.observed_order && Date.parse(rec.expires_at) <= now()) return { ok: false, reason: 'expired' };
      merge('code', key, { used: true, order_id, used_at: new Date(now()).toISOString() });
      return { ok: true, first: true };
    },
    claimOfferOrder(id, order_id) {
      const rec = db.get('offer', String(id));
      if (!rec) return { ok: false, reason: 'not_found' };
      if (!order_id) throw new TypeError('claimOfferOrder needs an order id');
      if (rec.order_id) return rec.order_id === order_id ? { ok: true, first: false } : { ok: false, reason: 'another_order' };
      merge('offer', String(id), { order_id });
      return { ok: true, first: true };
    },
    // A window opens with a key's first hit and closes windowSeconds later;
    // the first hit after that opens a new one. Hits over a limit still count.
    bump(key, windowSeconds) {
      const t = now();
      sweep(t);
      const cur = db.get('hits', String(key));
      const live = cur && cur.ends > t;
      const next = live ? { n: cur.n + 1, ends: cur.ends } : { n: 1, ends: Math.round(t + windowSeconds * 1000) };
      db.put('hits', String(key), next, next.ends);
      return next.n;
    },
    log(event) {
      db.append({ at: new Date(now()).toISOString(), ...event });
    },
    recent: (limit = 50) => db.tail(Math.min(Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(limit)) || 50), MAX_EVENTS)),
  };
}

// For Node scripts and checks. `now` lets a check move the clock.
export function memoryStore({ now = () => Date.now() } = {}) {
  const rows = new Map();
  let events = [];
  const ops = operations({
    get: (kind, id) => {
      const row = rows.get(`${kind} ${id}`);
      return row ? JSON.parse(row.data) : null;
    },
    put: (kind, id, value, expires) => { rows.set(`${kind} ${id}`, { data: JSON.stringify(value), expires }); },
    append: event => { events.push(JSON.stringify(event)); },
    tail: n => events.slice(-n).reverse().map(e => JSON.parse(e)),
    sweep: (t, keep) => {
      for (const [key, row] of rows) if (row.expires < t) rows.delete(key);
      events = events.slice(-keep);
    },
  }, now);
  return Object.fromEntries(OPS.map(op => [op, async (...args) => ops[op](...args)]));
}

// The same operations over the object's own SQLite database.
export class Offers extends DurableObject {
  constructor(ctx, env) {
    super(ctx, env);
    const sql = ctx.storage.sql;
    sql.exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS records (kind TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, expires INTEGER NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (kind, id));
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, data TEXT NOT NULL);`);
    this.ops = operations({
      get: (kind, id) => {
        const row = sql.exec('SELECT data FROM records WHERE kind = ? AND id = ?', kind, id).toArray()[0];
        return row ? JSON.parse(row.data) : null;
      },
      put: (kind, id, value, expires) => {
        sql.exec('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO records (kind, id, expires, data) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', kind, id, expires, JSON.stringify(value));
      },
      append: event => { sql.exec('INSERT INTO events (data) VALUES (?)', JSON.stringify(event)); },
      tail: n => sql.exec('SELECT data FROM events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?', n).toArray().map(row => JSON.parse(row.data)),
      sweep: (t, keep) => {
        sql.exec('DELETE FROM records WHERE expires < ?', t);
        sql.exec('DELETE FROM events WHERE id <= (SELECT MAX(id) FROM events) - ?', keep);
      },
    }, () => Date.now());
  }

  // Public methods are what the worker reaches over RPC.
  putOffer(rec) { return this.ops.putOffer(rec); }
  getOffer(id) { return this.ops.getOffer(id); }
  updateOffer(id, patch) { return this.ops.updateOffer(id, patch); }
  putCode(rec) { return this.ops.putCode(rec); }
  getCode(code) { return this.ops.getCode(code); }
  updateCode(code, patch) { return this.ops.updateCode(code, patch); }
  bump(key, windowSeconds) { return this.ops.bump(key, windowSeconds); }
  log(event) { return this.ops.log(event); }
  recent(limit) { return this.ops.recent(limit); }
  claimCode(code, order_id, opts = {}) { return this.ops.claimCode(code, order_id, opts); }
  claimOfferOrder(id, order_id) { return this.ops.claimOfferOrder(id, order_id); }
}

// One object holds every shop: an offer is found by its id alone, and the
// per-address limit has to count across shops. `name` is there to split it later.
export function doStore(env, name = 'main') {
  if (!env?.OFFERS) throw new Error('doStore needs the OFFERS Durable Object binding');
  const stub = env.OFFERS.get(env.OFFERS.idFromName(name));
  return Object.fromEntries(OPS.map(op => [op, async (...args) => stub[op](...args)]));
}
shopify/offers/src/lib/verify.js
// Competing-offer verifier. A buyer's agent hands the seller a link to a
// cheaper offer; the seller fetches that page itself and reads the price, the
// stock state and the product identity from it. Nothing the agent says about
// the page is trusted, and the page is hostile input too, so every step is
// bounded: which hosts, how many redirects, how many bytes, how long.
// Never throws: every failure is a result with ok:false and a reason code.

// Reason codes with the sentence shown to the buyer's agent. policy.js puts the
// sentence after "Competing offer not accepted: ", so no capital and no full stop.
const TEXT = {
  ok: 'the page shows the same product',
  bad_url: 'the link is not a public https address',
  blocked_domain: 'this store does not compare prices with that site',
  own_store: 'the link points to this store, not to another shop',
  fetch_failed: 'the page could not be loaded',
  no_price_found: 'no price could be read from that page',
  currency_mismatch: 'the price on that page is in a different currency',
  out_of_stock: 'that shop shows the item as out of stock',
  not_new: 'that offer is not for a new item',
  different_product: 'the page shows a different product',
  implausible_price: 'the price on that page is too far below the usual price to count as the same offer',
};
export const REASONS = Object.keys(TEXT);

const AFTER_REDIRECT = {
  bad_url: 'the link redirects to an address that cannot be checked',
  own_store: 'the link redirects to this store, not to another shop',
  blocked_domain: 'the link redirects to a site this store does not compare prices with',
};
const NOT_BUYABLE = new Map([
  ['out_of_stock', TEXT.out_of_stock],
  ['discontinued', 'that shop shows the item as discontinued'],
  ['preorder', 'that shop only takes pre-orders for the item'],
  ['backorder', 'that shop has the item on back order'],
]);

const MAX_URL = 2000;
const MAX_REDIRECTS = 3;
const REDIRECTS = new Set([301, 302, 303, 307, 308]);
const MAX_CHUNKS = 20000; // real pages arrive in a few hundred pieces; one sent in crumbs is cut off
const MAX_TAG = 4096; // longer tags are skipped, not parsed
const MAX_LD_BLOCKS = 60;
const MAX_NODES = 20000; // JSON-LD values walked per page
const MAX_CANDIDATES = 600;
const MAX_SCAN = 3000; // meta tags or itemprops read per page
const MIN_TITLE = 0.6;

// Says what it is: shops that turn robots away should be able to tell this one apart.
const HEADERS = {
  'user-agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; OfferAdVerifier/0.1; competing-offer price check)',
  accept: 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/json;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.5',
  'accept-language': 'en',
};

const r2 = x => Math.round(x * 100) / 100;
const arr = x => (x == null ? [] : Array.isArray(x) ? x : [x]);
const isObj = x => x !== null && typeof x === 'object' && !Array.isArray(x);
// Cleanup that must never turn into a failure of its own.
const quiet = fn => { try { Promise.resolve(fn()).catch(() => {}); } catch { /* nothing left to clean up */ } };

const ENTITIES = new Map([['amp', '&'], ['lt', '<'], ['gt', '>'], ['quot', '"'], ['apos', '\''], ['nbsp', ' ']]);
const decodeEntities = s => s.replace(/&(#x[0-9a-f]{1,6}|#\d{1,7}|[a-z]{2,6});/gi, (all, e) => {
  if (e[0] !== '#') return ENTITIES.get(e.toLowerCase()) ?? all;
  const cp = /^#x/i.test(e) ? parseInt(e.slice(2), 16) : parseInt(e.slice(1), 10);
  return cp > 0 && cp <= 0x10ffff ? String.fromCodePoint(cp) : all;
});

// A name, brand or identifier as one clean line of text, or null.
function str(x) {
  if (isObj(x)) x = x['@value'];
  if (typeof x !== 'string' && typeof x !== 'number') return null;
  return decodeEntities(String(x).slice(0, 600)).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 300) || null;
}

// "1,299.00", "1.299,00", "1 299,00 EUR", "$1,299", 699.95 -> a number; null when no amount can be read.
// When both marks appear the later one is the decimal mark. A lone comma groups thousands only
// in front of exactly three digits; a lone dot is a decimal point, as schema.org asks.
function amount(x) {
  if (typeof x === 'number') return Number.isFinite(x) && x >= 0 ? x : null;
  if (typeof x !== 'string') return null;
  const s = x.slice(0, 64).replace(/[\u00a0\u2009\u202f]/g, ' ');
  const m = /\d{1,3}(?:[ '\u2019]\d{3})+(?:[.,]\d+)?|\d+(?:[.,]\d+)*/.exec(s);
  if (!m || s[m.index - 1] === '-') return null;
  let n = m[0].replace(/[ '\u2019]/g, '');
  const dot = n.lastIndexOf('.');
  const comma = n.lastIndexOf(',');
  if (dot >= 0 && comma >= 0) {
    const dec = Math.max(dot, comma);
    n = `${n.slice(0, dec).replace(/[.,]/g, '')}.${n.slice(dec + 1)}`;
  } else if (/^\d{1,3}(,\d{3})+$/.test(n) || /^\d{1,3}(\.\d{3}){2,}$/.test(n)) {
    n = n.replace(/[.,]/g, '');
  } else if (comma >= 0) {
    n = n.replace(',', '.');
  }
  const v = Number(n);
  return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : null;
}
const price = x => { const v = amount(x); return v > 0 && v < 1e9 ? v : null; };
const code = x => (typeof x === 'string' && /^[A-Za-z]{3}$/.test(x.trim()) ? x.trim().toUpperCase() : null);

// The last word of a schema.org value: "https://schema.org/InStock", "InStock" and "in stock" all give "instock".
function word(x) {
  const v = arr(x)[0];
  return String((isObj(v) ? v['@id'] ?? v.name : v) ?? '').slice(0, 120).replace(/^.*[/#:]/, '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, '');
}
const AVAILABILITY = new Map([
  ['instock', 'in_stock'], ['onlineonly', 'in_stock'], ['instoreonly', 'in_stock'], ['limitedavailability', 'in_stock'],
  ['available', 'in_stock'], ['availablefororder', 'in_stock'], ['madetoorder', 'in_stock'],
  ['outofstock', 'out_of_stock'], ['soldout', 'out_of_stock'], ['oos', 'out_of_stock'], ['unavailable', 'out_of_stock'], ['reserved', 'out_of_stock'],
  ['discontinued', 'discontinued'], ['preorder', 'preorder'], ['presale', 'preorder'], ['pending', 'preorder'], ['backorder', 'backorder'],
]);
const availabilityOf = x => AVAILABILITY.get(word(x)) ?? null;
// 'new', or whatever else the page calls it; null when the page does not say.
function conditionOf(x) {
  const w = word(x).replace(/condition$/, '');
  return w === 'new' || w === 'brandnew' ? 'new' : w.slice(0, 30) || null;
}

// Words of a title or brand: lowercased, accents folded, punctuation dropped, single letters dropped, numbers kept.
function tokens(s) {
  const words = String(s ?? '').slice(0, 600).normalize('NFKD').replace(/\p{M}+/gu, '').toLowerCase().split(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/u);
  return new Set(words.filter(w => w.length > 1 || /^\p{N}$/u.test(w)));
}
function shared(a, b) {
  let n = 0;
  for (const w of a) if (b.has(w)) n++;
  return n;
}
const jaccard = (a, b) => { const both = shared(a, b); return both ? both / (a.size + b.size - both) : 0; };
const digits = x => (typeof x === 'string' || typeof x === 'number' ? String(x).replace(/\D/g, '') : '');
// GTIN-8, UPC, EAN and GTIN-14 name the same item once the padding zeros are gone.
function sameGtin(a, b) {
  const x = digits(a);
  const y = digits(b);
  return x.length >= 8 && x.length <= 14 && y.length >= 8 && y.length <= 14 && /[1-9]/.test(x) && x.replace(/^0+/, '') === y.replace(/^0+/, '');
}
const codeKey = x => (typeof x === 'string' || typeof x === 'number' ? String(x).trim().toLowerCase() : '');
const sameCode = (a, b) => codeKey(a).length >= 3 && codeKey(a) === codeKey(b);

// How sure we are that something found on the page is the seller's product: a shared
// identifier first; a similar title is the weakest proof and policy.js caps what it unlocks.
function identify(c, mine) {
  const hit = (by, rank) => ({ by, rank, score: 1, title: c.titles[0] ?? null });
  if (sameGtin(c.gtin, mine.gtin)) return hit('gtin', 3);
  // A part number or SKU means something only inside one brand.
  const brand = shared(tokens(c.brand), mine.brand) > 0;
  if (brand && sameCode(c.mpn, mine.mpn)) return hit('mpn', 2);
  if (brand && sameCode(c.sku, mine.sku)) return hit('sku', 1);
  // A variant is named after its product plus a size or a colour. The words it adds do not count
  // against it unless they are words of ours, so the sizes we did not ask for come out equal.
  const base = tokens(c.base);
  let score = 0;
  let title = c.titles[0] ?? null;
  c.titles.forEach((t, i) => {
    let words = tokens(t);
    if (i === 0 && base.size) words = new Set([...words].filter(w => base.has(w) || mine.title.has(w)));
    const s = jaccard(words, mine.title);
    if (s > score) { score = s; title = t; }
  });
  return { by: score >= MIN_TITLE ? 'title' : null, rank: 0, score: Math.floor(score * 100) / 100, title };
}

// A page often lists many offers: every size of a board, or other products beside the main one.
// Take the one that is most surely the seller's product: a shared identifier, then the variant
// the link names, then the closest title; among equals one that can be bought new today, then
// the first on the page.
function choose(candidates, mine, variant) {
  let best = null;
  for (const c of candidates) {
    const id = identify(c, mine);
    const key = [id.rank, variant && c.variant === variant ? 1 : 0, id.score, NOT_BUYABLE.has(c.availability) ? 0 : 1, c.condition && c.condition !== 'new' ? 0 : 1];
    if (!best || beats(key, best.key)) best = { c, id, key };
  }
  return best;
}
function beats(a, b) {
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if (a[i] !== b[i]) return a[i] > b[i];
  return false;
}

const hostOf = u => u.hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/\.+$/, '');
const bare = host => host.replace(/^www\./, '');
const names = list => arr(list).map(x => (typeof x === 'string' ? x.trim().toLowerCase() : '')).filter(Boolean);
const LOOPBACK = /^(localhost|[a-z0-9.-]+\.localhost|127\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+|\[::1\])$/;
// Names that only resolve inside somebody's own network.
const PRIVATE_TLD = new Set(['localhost', 'local', 'localdomain', 'internal', 'intranet', 'lan', 'home', 'corp', 'private', 'arpa']);

// An own-store entry: 'shop.example', 'https://shop.example', or 'host/path' for a storefront
// that shares its host with other shops (the demo storefront and its rival do).
function ownEntry(e) {
  const s = e.replace(/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//, '');
  const cut = s.search(/[/?#]/);
  const host = bare((cut < 0 ? s : s.slice(0, cut)).replace(/:\d+$/, '').replace(/\.+$/, ''));
  const path = cut < 0 ? '' : s.slice(cut).replace(/[?#].*$/, '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  return host ? { host, path } : null;
}

// One address against the URL rules. Runs on the link itself and again on every redirect target.
function urlProblem(u, cfg) {
  const host = hostOf(u);
  if (u.protocol !== 'https:' && !(cfg.allowLocal && u.protocol === 'http:')) return ['bad_url', 'only https links can be checked'];
  if (u.username || u.password) return ['bad_url', 'links that carry a login cannot be checked'];
  if (!(cfg.allowLocal && LOOPBACK.test(host))) {
    // Once the URL parser has normalised it, an IP address in any spelling ends in digits or sits in brackets.
    const tld = host.slice(host.lastIndexOf('.') + 1);
    const named = host.includes('.') && !host.startsWith('[') && /^(?:[a-z]{2,}|xn--[a-z0-9-]+)$/.test(tld) && !PRIVATE_TLD.has(tld);
    if (!named || u.port) return ['bad_url', 'the link must point to a public shop website'];
  }
  const path = u.pathname.toLowerCase();
  const own = cfg.own.some(o => (bare(host) === o.host || host.endsWith(`.${o.host}`)) && (!o.path || path === o.path || path.startsWith(`${o.path}/`)));
  if (own) return ['own_store', TEXT.own_store];
  if (cfg.blocked.some(b => host.includes(b))) return ['blocked_domain', TEXT.blocked_domain];
  return null;
}

// GET with the redirects followed by hand, so every hop is checked before it is fetched.
async function get(start, cfg) {
  // Called bare: a Workers fetch refuses to run as some object's method.
  const { fetchFn, race, signal } = cfg;
  let u = start;
  for (let hop = 0; ; hop++) {
    u.hash = '';
    const problem = urlProblem(u, cfg);
    if (problem) return { url: u, fail: hop ? [problem[0], AFTER_REDIRECT[problem[0]]] : problem };
    const failed = text => ({ url: u, fail: ['fetch_failed', signal.aborted ? 'the page took too long to load' : text] });
    let res;
    try {
      res = await race(fetchFn(u.href, { method: 'GET', redirect: 'manual', headers: HEADERS, signal }));
    } catch {
      return failed(TEXT.fetch_failed);
    }
    const status = Number(res?.status);
    if (REDIRECTS.has(status)) {
      const to = res.headers?.get?.('location');
      quiet(() => res.body?.cancel());
      if (hop >= MAX_REDIRECTS) return failed('the link redirects too many times');
      try {
        if (!to) throw new Error('no location');
        u = new URL(to, u);
      } catch {
        return failed('the link redirects to an address that cannot be read');
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (!(status >= 200 && status < 300)) {
      quiet(() => res?.body?.cancel());
      return failed(Number.isFinite(status) ? `the page could not be loaded (HTTP ${status})` : TEXT.fetch_failed);
    }
    // A fetchFn that followed redirects on its own still has to land on an allowed address.
    if (typeof res.url === 'string' && res.url && res.url !== u.href) {
      let landed = null;
      try { landed = new URL(res.url); } catch { /* keep the address we asked for */ }
      const off = landed && urlProblem(landed, cfg);
      if (off) {
        quiet(() => res.body?.cancel());
        return { url: landed, fail: [off[0], AFTER_REDIRECT[off[0]]] };
      }
      if (landed) u = landed;
    }
    const type = String(res.headers?.get?.('content-type') ?? '').toLowerCase();
    if (type && !/html|xml|json|javascript|text\/plain/.test(type)) {
      quiet(() => res.body?.cancel());
      return { url: u, fail: ['no_price_found', 'that link is not a product page'] };
    }
    try {
      return { url: u, ...(await readBody(res, type, cfg)) };
    } catch {
      return failed(TEXT.fetch_failed);
    }
  }
}

// The body as text, cut off at maxBytes: a page that has not named its price by then is not worth more memory.
async function readBody(res, type, cfg) {
  const reader = res.body?.getReader?.();
  if (!reader) {
    // A stand-in response without a stream.
    const text = String(await cfg.race(res.text()));
    return { text: text.slice(0, cfg.maxBytes), cut: text.length > cfg.maxBytes };
  }
  const chunks = [];
  let size = 0;
  let cut = false;
  try {
    while (!cut) {
      const { done, value } = await cfg.race(reader.read());
      if (done) break;
      const room = cfg.maxBytes - size;
      cut = value.byteLength > room || chunks.length >= MAX_CHUNKS;
      const part = value.byteLength > room ? value.subarray(0, room) : value;
      chunks.push(part);
      size += part.byteLength;
    }
  } finally {
    quiet(() => reader.cancel());
  }
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(size);
  let at = 0;
  for (const c of chunks) { bytes.set(c, at); at += c.byteLength; }
  const charset = /charset=["']?([\w-]+)/.exec(type)?.[1] ?? 'utf-8';
  try {
    return { text: new TextDecoder(charset).decode(bytes), cut };
  } catch {
    return { text: new TextDecoder().decode(bytes), cut };
  }
}

// The scanners below search with indexOf and always move forward, so markup written to make
// a parser retry from every position costs one pass and no more.

// A lowercase copy for case-blind searching. Its indexes must line up with the original, and a
// few non-ASCII letters grow when lowercased, so such a page gets an ASCII-only pass instead.
function lowerOf(s) {
  const low = s.toLowerCase();
  return low.length === s.length ? low : s.replace(/[A-Z]+/g, m => m.toLowerCase());
}

// Attributes of one tag. Stray quotes and slashes count as separators, so a broken tag is still read once.
const ATTR = /[\s"'<>/=]*([^\s"'<>/=]+)(?:\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)'|([^\s"'<>]*)))?/y;
function attrsOf(tag) {
  const out = Object.create(null);
  ATTR.lastIndex = 0;
  for (let m; (m = ATTR.exec(tag));) {
    const key = m[1].toLowerCase();
    if (!(key in out)) out[key] = decodeEntities(m[2] ?? m[3] ?? m[4] ?? '');
  }
  return out;
}

function parseJson(text) {
  const t = String(text ?? '').trim();
  if (!t) return null;
  try { return JSON.parse(t); } catch { /* one repair below */ }
  // Raw line breaks and tabs inside strings are the usual reason a shop's JSON-LD does not parse.
  try { return JSON.parse(t.replace(/[\u0000-\u001f]+/g, ' ')); } catch { return null; }
}

// JSON-LD, the format shops write for search engines and the most complete one.
function jsonLd(html, low) {
  const out = [];
  const budget = { left: MAX_NODES, items: 0 };
  let at = 0;
  for (let blocks = 0; blocks < MAX_LD_BLOCKS;) {
    const open = low.indexOf('<script', at);
    if (open < 0) break;
    const gt = low.indexOf('>', open);
    if (gt < 0) break;
    const close = low.indexOf('</script', gt);
    if (close < 0) break;
    at = close + 9;
    if (gt - open > MAX_TAG || !low.slice(open, gt).includes('ld+json')) continue;
    blocks++;
    walk(parseJson(html.slice(gt + 1, close)), 0, budget, out);
  }
  return { list: out, items: budget.items };
}

const typesOf = n => arr(n['@type']).slice(0, 8).map(t => String(t).replace(/^.*[/:#]/, '').toLowerCase());
const PRODUCT_TYPES = new Set(['product', 'productgroup', 'individualproduct', 'productmodel']);

// Every Product in a JSON-LD document, wherever it sits: top level, an array, @graph, mainEntity.
function walk(node, depth, budget, out) {
  if (depth > 8 || budget.left-- <= 0) return;
  if (Array.isArray(node)) {
    for (const n of node) walk(n, depth + 1, budget, out);
    return;
  }
  if (!isObj(node)) return;
  if (typesOf(node).some(t => PRODUCT_TYPES.has(t))) {
    budget.items++;
    fromProduct(node, null, out);
    return;
  }
  for (const v of Object.values(node)) if (v && typeof v === 'object') walk(v, depth + 1, budget, out);
}

const gtinOf = n => str(n.gtin ?? n.gtin14 ?? n.gtin13 ?? n.gtin12 ?? n.gtin8);
const brandOf = n => { const b = arr(n.brand ?? n.manufacturer)[0]; return str(isObj(b) ? b.name : b); };

// One Product, or one variant of a ProductGroup, gives one candidate per offer. A variant
// inherits what only the group states: usually the brand and the plain product name.
function fromProduct(node, group, out) {
  const item = {
    titles: [str(node.name), ...(group?.titles ?? [])].filter(Boolean),
    base: group?.titles[0] ?? null,
    brand: brandOf(node) ?? group?.brand ?? null,
    gtin: gtinOf(node),
    mpn: str(node.mpn) ?? group?.mpn ?? null,
    sku: str(node.sku),
    condition: node.itemCondition ?? group?.condition,
    refs: [node.url, node['@id']],
  };
  for (const offer of arr(node.offers).slice(0, 300)) fromOffer(offer, item, out, 0);
  if (!group) for (const v of arr(node.hasVariant).slice(0, 300)) if (isObj(v)) fromProduct(v, item, out);
}

function fromOffer(offer, item, out, depth) {
  if (!isObj(offer) || out.length >= MAX_CANDIDATES) return;
  const aggregate = typesOf(offer).includes('aggregateoffer');
  const priced = priceOf(offer, aggregate);
  if (priced) {
    const currency = code(priced.currency);
    out.push({
      price: priced.price,
      currency,
      shipping: shippingOf(offer, priced.price, currency),
      availability: availabilityOf(offer.availability),
      condition: conditionOf(offer.itemCondition ?? item.condition),
      titles: item.titles,
      base: item.base,
      brand: item.brand,
      gtin: gtinOf(offer) ?? item.gtin,
      mpn: str(offer.mpn) ?? item.mpn,
      sku: str(offer.sku) ?? item.sku,
      variant: variantIn([offer.url, offer['@id'], ...item.refs]),
    });
  }
  // An AggregateOffer counts with its lowPrice; the single offers inside it are more exact
  // and win when one of them carries our identifier or is the variant the link names.
  if (depth < 1) for (const o of arr(offer.offers).slice(0, 300)) fromOffer(o, item, out, depth + 1);
}

function variantIn(refs) {
  for (const r of refs) {
    const m = typeof r === 'string' && /[?&]variant=(\d{1,20})/.exec(r.slice(0, MAX_URL));
    if (m) return m[1];
  }
  return null;
}

// The price a buyer pays today. In priceSpecification a was-price carries a priceType and a
// member price a validForMemberTier; the active price carries neither.
// https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/merchant-listing
const REFERENCE_PRICE = /listprice|strikethroughprice|msrp|srp|minimumadvertisedprice|invoiceprice/i;
function priceOf(offer, aggregate) {
  const specs = arr(offer.priceSpecification).filter(isObj);
  // An AggregateOffer counts with its lowPrice. Shops mix the two types up, so each also reads the other's field.
  const direct = aggregate ? price(offer.lowPrice) ?? price(offer.price) : price(offer.price) ?? price(offer.lowPrice);
  if (direct != null) return { price: direct, currency: offer.priceCurrency ?? specs[0]?.priceCurrency };
  for (const s of specs) {
    if (s.validForMemberTier || REFERENCE_PRICE.test(String(s.priceType ?? ''))) continue;
    const p = price(s.price ?? s.minPrice);
    if (p != null) return { price: p, currency: s.priceCurrency ?? offer.priceCurrency };
  }
  return null;
}

// The delivery charge the page states for this offer, in the offer's own currency. Zero is a
// statement too (free shipping), but "free from" an amount above the item price is not.
function shippingOf(offer, itemPrice, currency) {
  for (const d of arr(offer.shippingDetails).slice(0, 50)) {
    const rate = d?.shippingRate;
    if (!isObj(rate)) continue;
    const cur = code(rate.currency);
    if (cur && currency && cur !== currency) continue;
    const value = amount(rate.value ?? rate.maxValue);
    if (value == null) continue;
    const freeFrom = amount(d.freeShippingThreshold?.price ?? d.freeShippingThreshold?.value);
    if (freeFrom == null) return r2(value);
    if (itemPrice >= freeFrom) return 0;
    if (value > 0) return r2(value);
  }
  return null;
}

// Shopify product JSON, served by every Shopify storefront next to its product pages. Prices
// are integer cents and the reply names no currency.
// https://shopify.dev/docs/api/ajax/reference/product
function shopifyVariants(p) {
  if (!isObj(p) || !Array.isArray(p.variants)) return [];
  const title = str(p.title);
  return p.variants.slice(0, 250).filter(v => isObj(v) && Number.isInteger(v.price) && v.price > 0).map(v => ({
    price: v.price / 100,
    currency: null,
    shipping: null,
    availability: v.available === true ? 'in_stock' : v.available === false ? 'out_of_stock' : null,
    condition: null,
    titles: [str(v.name) ?? (title && str(v.title) ? `${title} ${str(v.title)}` : null), title].filter(Boolean),
    base: title,
    brand: str(p.vendor),
    gtin: str(v.barcode),
    mpn: null,
    sku: str(v.sku),
    variant: v.id == null ? null : String(v.id),
  }));
}

// Where a Shopify storefront would serve that JSON for this page. A market prefix such as
// /en-ca is kept, because prices under it are in that market's currency.
function shopifyRoot(u) {
  const m = /^(.*?)\/products\/([^/.]+)/.exec(u.pathname.slice(0, MAX_URL));
  if (!m) return null;
  const before = m[1].replace(/\/collections\/[^/]+$/i, '');
  return { root: u.origin + (/^\/[a-z]{2,3}(-[a-z0-9]{2,4})?$/i.test(before) ? before : ''), handle: m[2] };
}

// <meta> tags by property, name or itemprop. The first value of a key wins.
function metaTags(html, low) {
  const meta = new Map();
  let at = 0;
  for (let n = 0; n < MAX_SCAN; n++) {
    const open = low.indexOf('<meta', at);
    if (open < 0) break;
    const gt = low.indexOf('>', open);
    if (gt < 0) break;
    at = gt + 1;
    if (gt - open > MAX_TAG || !/[\s/]/.test(low[open + 5])) continue;
    const a = attrsOf(html.slice(open + 5, gt));
    const key = String(a.property ?? a.name ?? a.itemprop ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (key && a.content != null && !meta.has(key)) meta.set(key, a.content);
  }
  return meta;
}

function titleTag(html, low) {
  const open = low.indexOf('<title');
  const gt = open < 0 ? -1 : low.indexOf('>', open);
  const close = gt < 0 ? -1 : low.indexOf('</title', gt);
  return close < 0 ? null : str(html.slice(gt + 1, Math.min(close, gt + 400)));
}

// OpenGraph product tags: a price and a title, and seldom more.
function openGraph(meta, pageTitle) {
  const p = price(meta.get('product:price:amount')) ?? price(meta.get('og:price:amount'));
  if (p == null) return [];
  return [{
    price: p,
    currency: code(meta.get('product:price:currency') ?? meta.get('og:price:currency')),
    shipping: null,
    availability: availabilityOf(meta.get('product:availability') ?? meta.get('og:availability')),
    condition: conditionOf(meta.get('product:condition')),
    titles: [str(meta.get('og:title')) ?? pageTitle].filter(Boolean),
    brand: str(meta.get('product:brand') ?? meta.get('og:brand')),
    gtin: null,
    mpn: null,
    sku: null,
    variant: null,
  }];
}

const MICRO = new Set(['price', 'lowprice', 'pricecurrency', 'availability', 'itemcondition', 'name', 'brand', 'sku', 'mpn', 'gtin', 'gtin8', 'gtin12', 'gtin13', 'gtin14']);
// Nested items whose own name must not be read as the product's.
const NAMED_SCOPES = new Set(['brand', 'manufacturer', 'author', 'seller', 'publisher', 'review', 'itemreviewed']);

// Microdata, the oldest of the formats: itemprop attributes on the visible markup. Read in
// document order from the first schema.org Product; the first value of each property wins.
function microdata(html, low, pageTitle) {
  const props = new Map();
  let scope = null;
  let at = Math.max(0, low.search(/itemtype\s*=\s*["']?https?:\/\/schema\.org\/product/));
  for (let n = 0; n < MAX_SCAN; n++) {
    const hit = low.indexOf('itemprop', at);
    if (hit < 0) break;
    at = hit + 8;
    // The tag around the hit, looked for in a bounded window on each side.
    const back = low.slice(Math.max(0, hit - MAX_TAG), hit);
    const lt = back.lastIndexOf('<');
    const gt = low.slice(hit, hit + MAX_TAG).indexOf('>');
    if (lt < 0 || gt < 0 || back.indexOf('>', lt) >= 0) continue;
    const end = hit + gt;
    // One tag is one property: the search goes on behind it, so no tag is parsed twice.
    at = end + 1;
    const a = attrsOf(html.slice(hit - back.length + lt + 1, end));
    const name = String(a.itemprop ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/)[0];
    if ('itemscope' in a) {
      if (NAMED_SCOPES.has(name)) scope = name;
      continue;
    }
    if (!MICRO.has(name)) continue;
    const linked = name === 'availability' || name === 'itemcondition' ? a.href : null;
    const value = a.content ?? linked ?? decodeEntities(html.slice(end + 1, end + 201).split('<')[0]).trim();
    if (name === 'name') {
      const key = scope === 'brand' || scope === 'manufacturer' ? 'brand' : scope ? null : 'name';
      scope = null;
      if (key && value && !props.has(key)) props.set(key, value);
      continue;
    }
    if (name === 'price' || name === 'lowprice' ? price(value) == null : !value) continue;
    if (!props.has(name)) props.set(name, value);
  }
  const p = price(props.get('price')) ?? price(props.get('lowprice'));
  if (p == null) return [];
  return [{
    price: p,
    currency: code(props.get('pricecurrency')),
    shipping: null,
    availability: availabilityOf(props.get('availability')),
    condition: conditionOf(props.get('itemcondition')),
    titles: [str(props.get('name')) ?? pageTitle].filter(Boolean),
    brand: str(props.get('brand')),
    gtin: str(props.get('gtin') ?? props.get('gtin14') ?? props.get('gtin13') ?? props.get('gtin12') ?? props.get('gtin8')),
    mpn: str(props.get('mpn')),
    sku: str(props.get('sku')),
    variant: null,
  }];
}

// The page's currency, for a price that came without one.
function pageCurrency(html, meta) {
  return code(meta.get('product:price:currency') ?? meta.get('og:price:currency') ?? meta.get('pricecurrency'))
    ?? code(/Shopify\.currency\s*=\s*\{\s*"active"\s*:\s*"([A-Za-z]{3})"/.exec(html)?.[1]);
}

// Every key is always present, so callers and logs never have to guess at the shape.
function blank(url, now) {
  let at = Date.now();
  try {
    const t = typeof now === 'function' ? now() : now;
    if (Number.isFinite(t) && Math.abs(t) < 8.64e15) at = t;
  } catch { /* keep the clock */ }
  return {
    ok: false, reason: null, reason_text: null,
    url: typeof url === 'string' ? url.trim().slice(0, MAX_URL) : url instanceof URL ? url.href.slice(0, MAX_URL) : null,
    domain: null, trusted_domain: false,
    price: null, currency: null, shipping: null, availability: null, condition: null,
    title: null, brand: null, gtin: null, mpn: null, sku: null,
    match_by: null, match_score: null, method: null,
    fetched_at: new Date(at).toISOString(),
  };
}

// product: mandate.product { title, brand, gtin, mpn, sku, list, currency }
// policy:  mandate.price_match { trusted_domains, blocked_domains, min_price_ratio }
// opts:    { fetchFn = fetch, now = Date.now(), ownHosts = [], allowLocal = false, timeoutMs = 8000, maxBytes = 1_500_000 }
// returns  { ok, reason, reason_text, url, domain, trusted_domain, price, currency, shipping, availability,
//            condition, title, brand, gtin, mpn, sku, match_by, match_score, method, fetched_at }
// method is 'json_ld', 'shopify_json', 'meta' or 'microdata'; the first that yields a price wins.
export async function verifyCompetingOffer(url, product, policy, opts = {}) {
  const o = isObj(opts) ? opts : {};
  const out = blank(url, o.now);
  const end = (reason, text) => ({ ...out, ok: reason === 'ok', reason, reason_text: text || TEXT[reason] });
  let timer;
  try {
    const p = isObj(product) ? product : {};
    const rules = isObj(policy) ? policy : {};
    const mine = { title: tokens(p.title), brand: tokens(p.brand), gtin: p.gtin, mpn: p.mpn, sku: p.sku, list: Number(p.list), currency: code(p.currency) };
    const trusted = names(rules.trusted_domains);
    const ratio = Number.isFinite(rules.min_price_ratio) && rules.min_price_ratio >= 0 ? rules.min_price_ratio : 0.5;
    const where = u => {
      const host = hostOf(u);
      out.url = u.href.slice(0, MAX_URL);
      out.domain = bare(host);
      out.trusted_domain = trusted.some(d => host === d || host.endsWith(`.${d}`));
    };

    const raw = typeof url === 'string' ? url.trim() : url instanceof URL ? url.href : '';
    if (!raw) return end('bad_url', 'no link was given');
    if (raw.length > MAX_URL) return end('bad_url', 'the link is too long');
    let first;
    try { first = new URL(raw); } catch { return end('bad_url', 'the link is not a valid web address'); }
    if (!mine.title.size && !digits(mine.gtin) && !codeKey(mine.mpn) && !codeKey(mine.sku)) return end('different_product', 'there is no product to compare that page with');

    const ctrl = new AbortController();
    const timeoutMs = Math.min(o.timeoutMs > 0 ? Number(o.timeoutMs) : 8000, 60000);
    timer = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), timeoutMs);
    // One clock for the whole check, redirects and follow-up requests included. A fetchFn may
    // ignore the signal, so every wait also races it.
    const late = new Promise((_, reject) => ctrl.signal.addEventListener('abort', () => reject(new Error('timeout')), { once: true }));
    late.catch(() => {});
    const cfg = {
      // Only a missing fetchFn means the real network; anything else that is not a function fails the check.
      fetchFn: o.fetchFn == null ? (input, init) => fetch(input, init) : o.fetchFn,
      allowLocal: o.allowLocal === true,
      own: names(o.ownHosts).map(ownEntry).filter(Boolean),
      blocked: names(rules.blocked_domains),
      maxBytes: Math.min(o.maxBytes > 0 ? Math.floor(Number(o.maxBytes)) : 1_500_000, 10_000_000),
      signal: ctrl.signal,
      race: promise => Promise.race([promise, late]),
    };

    const page = await get(first, cfg);
    where(page.url);
    if (page.fail) return end(...page.fail);
    const html = page.text;
    const low = lowerOf(html);
    const meta = metaTags(html, low);
    const pageTitle = str(meta.get('og:title')) ?? titleTag(html, low);
    const asked = page.url.searchParams.get('variant') ?? first.searchParams.get('variant');
    const variant = /^\d{1,20}$/.test(asked ?? '') ? asked : null;

    let method = 'json_ld';
    const ld = jsonLd(html, low);
    // A product page that describes one product: the page's own title is another name for it.
    // Some shops put a short model name in the data and the full name in the title, or the reverse.
    if (ld.items === 1 && pageTitle && /product/i.test(meta.get('og:type') ?? '')) for (const c of ld.list) c.titles = [...c.titles, pageTitle];
    let best = choose(ld.list, mine, variant);
    const shop = best ? null : shopifyRoot(page.url);
    if (shop) {
      method = 'shopify_json';
      const js = await get(new URL(`${shop.root}/products/${shop.handle}.js`), cfg);
      best = js.fail ? null : choose(shopifyVariants(parseJson(js.text)), mine, variant);
    }
    if (!best) { method = 'meta'; best = choose(openGraph(meta, pageTitle), mine, variant); }
    if (!best) { method = 'microdata'; best = choose(microdata(html, low, pageTitle), mine, variant); }
    if (!best) return end('no_price_found', page.cut ? 'no price could be read from the first part of that page, and the page is too large to read in full' : null);

    const { c, id } = best;
    let currency = c.currency ?? pageCurrency(html, meta);
    if (!currency && method === 'shopify_json') {
      // The place Shopify documents for asking a storefront which currency it is showing.
      // https://shopify.dev/docs/api/ajax/reference/cart
      const cart = await get(new URL(`${shop.root}/cart.js`), cfg);
      currency = cart.fail ? null : code(parseJson(cart.text)?.currency);
    }
    Object.assign(out, {
      method, price: r2(c.price), currency, shipping: c.shipping, availability: c.availability, condition: c.condition,
      title: id.title, brand: c.brand, gtin: c.gtin, mpn: c.mpn, sku: c.sku, match_by: id.by, match_score: id.score,
    });

    if (!currency) return end('currency_mismatch', 'the page does not say which currency its price is in');
    if (currency !== mine.currency) return end('currency_mismatch', `the price on that page is in ${currency}, not in ${mine.currency ?? 'this store\'s currency'}`);
    if (NOT_BUYABLE.has(c.availability)) return end('out_of_stock', NOT_BUYABLE.get(c.availability));
    if (c.condition && c.condition !== 'new') return end('not_new', ['used', 'refurbished', 'damaged'].includes(c.condition) ? `that offer is for a ${c.condition} item, not a new one` : null);
    if (!id.by) return end('different_product');
    // A price far under ours is more likely a different item, a part or a mistake than a real offer.
    if (!(mine.list > 0) || c.price < ratio * mine.list - 1e-9) return end('implausible_price');
    return end('ok', `${out.domain} lists ${id.by === 'title' ? 'a product with a matching name' : 'the same product'} at ${out.price} ${currency}`);
  } catch {
    return end('fetch_failed', 'the page could not be checked');
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}
shopify/offers/src/worker.js
// The worker: routing and wiring, nothing else. It builds the offer desk
// (service.js) on the Durable Object store, works out which shop a request is
// for and where that shop's links should point, and hands the request to a
// door: MCP (mcp.js), the JSON API (the same calls over plain HTTP), the HTML
// pages (pages.js) or the order webhook. Every route is served twice: at the
// root, and under /apps/offerad, which is where Shopify's app proxy puts the
// desk on a store's own domain.

import { createService } from './lib/service.js';
import { doStore } from './lib/store.js';
import { verifyCompetingOffer } from './lib/verify.js';
import { dryAdapter, shopifyAdapter } from './lib/settle.js';
import { draftAdapter } from './lib/draft.js';
import { SHOPS } from './lib/mandates.js';
import { handleMcp, callTool, publicReply, notEnrolled, readBody, readBytes, CORS, MAX_BODY } from './lib/mcp.js';
import {
  offerForm, offerResult, offerAccepted, demoHome, demoProduct, demoCart, demoCheckout, demoPolicies,
  rivalProduct, adminLog, llmsTxt, offersJson, openapiJson,
} from './lib/pages.js';

export { Offers } from './lib/store.js';

const PREFIX = '/apps/offerad';
const DEMO = 'demo';
const HOOKS = ['box', 'desc', 'jsonld', 'webmcp', 'policy'];
// The rival shop's pages are served by this worker but stand for a shop on its
// own domain, the one the mandates list among the shops whose prices count.
const RIVAL_HOST = 'peakboards.demo';
const MYSHOPIFY = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\.myshopify\.com$/;
const HOSTNAME = /^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)+$/;
// What the proxy adds to a query. None of it is the visitor's, and each appears once.
const PROXY_PARAMS = ['shop', 'path_prefix', 'timestamp', 'signature', 'logged_in_customer_id'];
const PROXY_PATH = /^(\/[\w-]{1,40}){1,3}$/;
const PROXY_SECONDS = 90;
const MAX_WEBHOOK = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

// The JSON API: each path is one tool of the MCP door, or the status lookup.
const API = {
  '/api/offers/options': ['GET', 'get_offer_options'],
  '/api/offers/request': ['POST', 'request_offer'],
  '/api/offers/accept': ['POST', 'accept_offer'],
  '/api/offers/status': ['GET', null],
};

// The pages, by the path that is left once the proxy prefix is off.
const PAGES = [
  ['GET', /^\/offer$/, offerForm],
  ['POST', /^\/offer$/, offerResult],
  ['POST', /^\/offer\/accept$/, offerAccepted],
  ['GET', /^\/llms\.txt$/, llmsTxt],
  ['GET', /^\/\.well-known\/offers\.json$/, offersJson],
  ['GET', /^\/openapi\.json$/, openapiJson],
  ['GET', /^\/demo$/, demoHome],
  ['GET', /^\/demo\/products\/[^/]+$/, demoProduct],
  ['GET', /^\/demo\/cart(\/[^/]*)?$/, demoCart],
  ['GET', /^\/demo\/checkout$/, demoCheckout],
  ['GET', /^\/demo\/policies$/, demoPolicies],
  ['GET', /^\/rival\/products\/[^/]+$/, rivalProduct],
  ['GET', /^\/admin\/log$/, adminLog],
];

const enc = new TextEncoder();
const text = x => (typeof x === 'string' ? x.trim() : '');
const parseUrl = x => { try { return new URL(x); } catch { return null; } };
// Own keys only: a shop named "constructor" is not a shop.
const known = shop => typeof shop === 'string' && Object.hasOwn(SHOPS, shop);

const json = (data, status = 200, headers = {}) => Response.json(data, { status, headers: { ...CORS, 'cache-control': 'no-store', ...headers } });
const notAllowed = allow => json(
  { status: 'invalid_request', error: `This address takes ${allow.join(' or ')} requests.` },
  405, { Allow: [...allow, 'OPTIONS'].join(', ') },
);

const fromHex = s => (/^(?:[0-9a-f]{2})+$/i.test(s) ? Uint8Array.from(s.match(/../g), b => parseInt(b, 16)) : null);
const fromBase64 = s => { try { return Uint8Array.from(atob(s), c => c.charCodeAt(0)); } catch { return null; } };

// HMAC-SHA256 checked by the platform, which compares in constant time.
async function hmacOk(secret, data, mac) {
  if (!secret || !mac) return false;
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', enc.encode(secret), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['verify']);
  return crypto.subtle.verify('HMAC', key, mac, typeof data === 'string' ? enc.encode(data) : data);
}

async function digest(value) {
  const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', enc.encode(value));
  return [...new Uint8Array(hash)].slice(0, 12).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

// Two secrets compared over their digests, so the time taken says nothing about where they differ.
async function sameSecret(a, b) {
  const [x, y] = await Promise.all([a, b].map(async s => new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', enc.encode(String(s))))));
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) diff |= x[i] ^ y[i];
  return diff === 0;
}

// Shopify signs what its app proxy forwards: every query parameter except
// `signature`, written key=value with repeated values joined by commas, the
// pairs sorted and joined with nothing between them, then HMAC-SHA256 with the
// app's client secret, in hex.
// https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/online-store/app-proxies/authenticate-app-proxies
// Shopify's own library adds two rules the page leaves out, and they are kept
// here: a proxy parameter appears once, and a signature is good for 90 seconds.
// https://github.com/Shopify/shopify-app-js/blob/main/packages/apps/shopify-api/lib/utils/hmac-validator.ts
// Returns the shop the signature vouches for, or null.
async function proxyShop(url, secret, now = Date.now()) {
  const q = url.searchParams;
  if (PROXY_PARAMS.some(k => q.getAll(k).length > 1)) return null;
  const shop = (q.get('shop') || '').toLowerCase();
  const stamp = Number(q.get('timestamp'));
  if (!MYSHOPIFY.test(shop) || !Number.isFinite(stamp) || Math.abs(now / 1000 - stamp) > PROXY_SECONDS) return null;
  const message = [...new Set(q.keys())].filter(k => k !== 'signature').map(k => `${k}=${q.getAll(k).join(',')}`).sort().join('');
  return (await hmacOk(secret, message, fromHex(q.get('signature') || ''))) ? shop : null;
}

// The Admin API token for a shop that settles through Shopify. One set by
// hand wins. Otherwise the app trades its client id and secret for a token,
// which works for a store in the app's own organization and lasts a day.
// https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/authentication-authorization/client-credentials-grant
// Kept between requests on purpose: the token is the shop's, not a caller's.
const tokens = new Map();
async function adminToken(env, shop) {
  if (env.SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN) return env.SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN;
  if (!env.SHOPIFY_API_KEY || !env.SHOPIFY_API_SECRET || !MYSHOPIFY.test(shop)) return null;
  const held = tokens.get(shop);
  if (held && held.until > Date.now()) return held.token;
  const res = await fetch(`https://${shop}/admin/oauth/access_token`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded', Accept: 'application/json' },
    body: new URLSearchParams({ grant_type: 'client_credentials', client_id: env.SHOPIFY_API_KEY, client_secret: env.SHOPIFY_API_SECRET }).toString(),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000),
  });
  const reply = await res.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!res.ok || !reply?.access_token) throw new Error(`the token exchange for ${shop} answered ${res.status}`);
  // Renewed a minute early, so a token is never used in its last seconds.
  tokens.set(shop, { token: reply.access_token, until: Date.now() + (Number(reply.expires_in) || 3600) * 1000 - 60000 });
  return reply.access_token;
}

const offPrefix = (pathname, prefixes) => {
  const hit = prefixes.find(p => p && (pathname === p || pathname.startsWith(`${p}/`)));
  return hit ? pathname.slice(hit.length) || '/' : pathname;
};

// The desk for one request: the store, the adapters that turn offers into
// codes, and the service on top. `origin` and `prefix` are where the request's
// shop is reached from outside; `hosts` are the names this worker answers to.
function wire(env, { origin, prefix, hosts, front }) {
  const store = doStore(env);
  const dry = dryAdapter(store, { storefront: `${origin}${prefix}/demo`, shop: DEMO });
  const adapterFor = shop => {
    if (!known(shop) || SHOPS[shop].settle !== 'shopify') return dry;
    const config = { shop, token: () => adminToken(env, shop), ...(env.SHOPIFY_API_VERSION ? { apiVersion: env.SHOPIFY_API_VERSION } : {}) };
    // A quote invoice can carry the whole offer before a Function is deployed.
    // Native codes remain available when explicitly selected, with preflight
    // restrictions; a deployed Function keeps offers on ordinary carts.
    return !env.SHOPIFY_FUNCTION_HANDLE && env.SHOPIFY_SETTLEMENT !== 'native'
      ? draftAdapter(config)
      : shopifyAdapter({ ...config, functionHandle: env.SHOPIFY_FUNCTION_HANDLE || null });
  };

  // A link to the rival's pages here is checked as a link to the rival's own
  // domain and read in process: a worker cannot fetch its own address, and a
  // name ending in .demo resolves nowhere.
  const standIn = link => {
    const u = parseUrl(text(link));
    const m = u && hosts.includes(u.host.toLowerCase()) && /^\/rival(\/products\/[^/]+)\/?$/.exec(offPrefix(u.pathname, [prefix, PREFIX]));
    return m ? `https://${RIVAL_HOST}${m[1]}${u.search}` : link;
  };
  const fetchFn = async (input, init) => {
    const u = parseUrl(String(input));
    if (u?.hostname !== RIVAL_HOST) return fetch(input, init);
    if (!/^\/products\/[^/]+$/.test(u.pathname)) return new Response('Not found', { status: 404, headers: { 'content-type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' } });
    const at = new URL(`/rival${u.pathname}${u.search}`, origin);
    return rivalProduct({ url: at, request: new Request(at), env, shop: DEMO, service: null, hooks: [], origin, prefix });
  };
  // The stand-in storefront shares its host with the rival, so only its own
  // paths count as "this store". A real store's public domain counts whole.
  const own = [...hosts.flatMap(h => [...new Set(['', PREFIX, prefix])].map(p => `${h}${p}/demo`)), ...(front ? [front] : [])];
  const verify = (link, product, policy, opts = {}) => {
    const demo = opts.shop === DEMO;
    const original = parseUrl(text(link));
    const mapped = standIn(link);
    // Fixture pages are proof only for the fixture shop. They must never
    // change a real merchant's quote, even when reached on this worker.
    if (!demo && (mapped !== link || original?.hostname === RIVAL_HOST)) {
      return Promise.resolve({ ok: false, reason: 'blocked_domain', reason_text: 'Demonstration competitor pages cannot support an offer from a real store.' });
    }
    return verifyCompetingOffer(demo ? mapped : link, product, policy, {
      ...opts, ownHosts: [...(opts.ownHosts || []), ...own],
      fetchFn: demo ? fetchFn : fetch,
    });
  };

  return { store, dry, adapterFor, service: createService({ store, adapterFor, verify }) };
}

// A posted body as plain fields: a JSON object, or a form's pairs. JSON is
// also known by its first character, because agents often post it unlabelled.
async function readFields(request) {
  const raw = await readBody(request);
  if (raw === null) return { tooLarge: true };
  const type = (request.headers.get('content-type') || '').toLowerCase();
  if (type.includes('json') || (!type.includes('urlencoded') && /^\s*[[{]/.test(raw))) {
    try {
      const v = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v)) return { values: v };
    } catch { /* answered by the caller */ }
    return { values: {}, bad: true };
  }
  return { values: Object.fromEntries(new URLSearchParams(raw)) };
}

// Which discovery hooks the demo shop shows: ?hooks= when the request has one
// (an empty one is the control arm), DEMO_HOOKS otherwise.
function hooksFor(q, env) {
  const names = String((q.has('hooks') ? q.get('hooks') : env.DEMO_HOOKS) ?? '').toLowerCase().split(/[\s,]+/);
  return names.includes('all') ? [...HOOKS] : HOOKS.filter(h => names.includes(h));
}

// Who called, for the merchant's log: the product names in a User-Agent say
// more than the browser boilerplate around them.
const BOILERPLATE = /^(mozilla|applewebkit|khtml|gecko|safari|version|mobile)\//i;
function agentName(ua) {
  const all = ua.match(/[A-Za-z][\w.-]*\/\d[\w.-]*/g) || [];
  const own = all.filter(t => !BOILERPLATE.test(t));
  return ((own.length ? own : all.slice(-1)).join(' ') || ua).trim().slice(0, 48) || 'unknown';
}

// The log is open unless ADMIN_KEY is set; then that is its password, with any user name.
async function logAllowed(request, env) {
  if (!env.ADMIN_KEY) return true;
  const [scheme = '', value = ''] = (request.headers.get('authorization') || '').trim().split(/\s+/);
  let given = '';
  if (/^bearer$/i.test(scheme)) given = value;
  else if (/^basic$/i.test(scheme)) { try { given = atob(value).split(':').slice(1).join(':'); } catch { /* not a password */ } }
  return sameSecret(given, env.ADMIN_KEY);
}

async function offerStatus(door, args) {
  if (!known(door.shop)) return notEnrolled(door.shop);
  const offer_id = text(args.offer_id);
  const code = text(args.code);
  if (!offer_id && !code) return { status: 'invalid_request', error: 'offer_id is needed: the offer_id of an offer from a request. A code issued for an offer works too, as code.' };
  return publicReply(await door.service.status({ shop: door.shop, offer_id, code, session: door.session, client: door.client }));
}

// What an order owes because of the codes it used: the parts of an offer that
// checkout could not show as money are written on the order. Every step can
// run twice, because Shopify sends a failed delivery again.
async function settleOrder({ store, adapterFor }, shop, order) {
  const id = text(order.admin_graphql_api_id) || (Number.isSafeInteger(order.id) ? `gid://shopify/Order/${order.id}` : text(order.id) || text(order.name));
  const list = x => (Array.isArray(x) ? x : []);
  const codes = [...new Set([
    ...list(order.discount_codes).map(d => d?.code),
    ...list(order.discount_applications).filter(a => a?.type === 'discount_code').map(a => a.code),
  ].map(c => text(c).toUpperCase()).filter(Boolean))].slice(0, 20);
  if (!id) return { handled: [] };

  // The codes of one offer carry the same promises, so an offer is written on
  // the order once, however many of its codes the order used.
  const owed = new Map();
  for (const code of codes) {
    const rec = await store.getCode(code);
    if (!rec?.offer_id || rec.shop !== shop) continue;
    if (!rec.used) await store.updateCode(code, { used: true, used_at: new Date().toISOString(), order_id: id });
    const entry = owed.get(rec.offer_id) || { codes: [], deferred: [] };
    entry.codes.push(code);
    if (Array.isArray(rec.deferred) && rec.deferred.length) entry.deferred = rec.deferred;
    owed.set(rec.offer_id, entry);
  }

  // Order attributes identify a candidate quote; only the Admin API's
  // draft→order relationship proves that this order redeemed that invoice.
  const draftIds = list(order.note_attributes).filter(a => a?.name === 'offerad_offer_id' || a?.key === 'offerad_offer_id').map(a => text(a.value)).filter(v => /^of_[0-9a-f]{20}$/.test(v)).slice(0, 3);
  for (const offer_id of draftIds) {
    const rec = await store.getOffer(offer_id);
    if (rec?.shop !== shop || rec.mode !== 'draft' || rec.status !== 'accepted' || !rec.draft_order_id) continue;
    if (rec.order_id && rec.order_id !== id) continue;
    const adapter = adapterFor(shop);
    if (typeof adapter.confirmOrder !== 'function') continue;
    const linked = await adapter.confirmOrder(id, { draft_order_id: rec.draft_order_id, offer_id });
    if (linked?.ok !== true) continue;
    if (!rec.order_id) await store.updateOffer(offer_id, { order_id: id });
    owed.set(offer_id, { codes: [], deferred: rec.mint_result?.deferred || [] });
  }

  const handled = [];
  for (const [offer_id, { codes: used, deferred }] of owed) {
    if (!deferred.length) continue;
    const offer = await store.getOffer(offer_id);
    // An offer's promises are kept once: on the first order that used one of its codes.
    if (offer?.order_id && offer.order_id !== id) continue;
    if (offer && !offer.order_id) await store.updateOffer(offer_id, { order_id: id });
    // The same code names the offer on every delivery, so the adapter can tell a repeat.
    const out = await adapterFor(shop).annotateOrder(id, { code: offer?.codes?.[0] || used[0], offer_id, currency: text(order.currency) || null, deferred });
    if (out?.ok === false) throw new Error(`the order could not be annotated: ${out.reason || 'no reason given'}`);
    handled.push({
      terms: list(out?.terms).map(t => t?.label).filter(Boolean),
      later_codes: list(out?.codes).map(c => ({ code: c.code, amount: c.amount ?? null, expires_at: c.expires_at ?? null })),
    });
  }
  // The log has a public page, so it names no code and no order.
  await store.log({ type: 'order', shop, status: handled.length ? 'annotated' : 'nothing_owed', offers: owed.size, kept: handled.flatMap(h => h.terms) });
  return { handled };
}

// Shopify's order webhook. Each delivery is signed: X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256 is
// the base64 HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body, keyed with the app's client
// secret. The bytes are checked as they arrived and parsed only afterwards.
// https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/webhooks/verify-deliveries
async function orderWebhook(request, env, ctx, desk) {
  const secret = env.SHOPIFY_API_SECRET;
  const mac = request.headers.get('x-shopify-hmac-sha256') || '';
  if (secret && !mac) return json({ ok: false, error: 'This delivery is not signed.' }, 401);
  const bytes = await readBytes(request, MAX_WEBHOOK);
  if (bytes === null) return json({ ok: false, error: 'The body is too large.' }, 413);
  if (secret && !(await hmacOk(secret, bytes, fromBase64(mac)))) return json({ ok: false, error: 'The signature does not match the body.' }, 401);

  let order = null;
  try { order = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes)); } catch { /* answered below */ }
  if (!order || typeof order !== 'object' || Array.isArray(order)) return json({ ok: false, error: 'The body is not a JSON order.' }, 400);

  const shop = (text(request.headers.get('x-shopify-shop-domain')) || (secret ? '' : text(order.shop) || DEMO)).toLowerCase();
  // Taken and dropped: answering an error would only make Shopify send it again.
  if (!known(shop)) return json({ ok: true, handled: [], note: 'This store does not use the offer desk.' });
  // Without the secret nobody vouches for a delivery, so it can only play an
  // order on the stand-in shop: nothing unsigned writes to a real store.
  if (!secret && SHOPS[shop].settle === 'shopify') return json({ ok: false, error: 'Deliveries for this store are signed, and no secret is configured to check them.' }, 401);

  // Shopify hangs up after five seconds; the work is finished all the same.
  const work = settleOrder(desk, shop, order);
  ctx?.waitUntil?.(work.catch(() => {}));
  return json({ ok: true, ...(await work) });
}

async function route(request, env, ctx) {
  if (request.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: CORS });
  const url = new URL(request.url);
  const q = url.searchParams;
  const header = name => request.headers.get(name) || '';
  const proxied = url.pathname === PREFIX || url.pathname.startsWith(`${PREFIX}/`);
  const path = (proxied ? url.pathname.slice(PREFIX.length) : url.pathname).replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/';
  const method = request.method === 'HEAD' ? 'GET' : request.method;

  // A request that carries the proxy's signature has to pass it once the
  // secret is configured: a signed request that fails is refused, never
  // quietly treated as an unsigned one.
  let via = null;
  if (env.SHOPIFY_API_SECRET && ['shop', 'timestamp', 'signature'].every(k => q.has(k))) {
    via = await proxyShop(url, env.SHOPIFY_API_SECRET);
    if (!via) return json({ status: 'error', error: 'The Shopify app-proxy signature on this request does not check out.' }, 401);
  }

  // Through the proxy the desk lives on the store's own domain, under the path
  // the merchant gave the proxy. Only a verified request is believed about
  // either, or about the visitor's address: the proxy sends it in X-Forwarded-For.
  const forwarded = via ? header('x-forwarded-host').split(',')[0].trim().toLowerCase() : '';
  const front = via ? (HOSTNAME.test(forwarded) ? forwarded : via) : null;
  const origin = front ? `https://${front}` : url.origin;
  const prefix = via ? (PROXY_PATH.test(q.get('path_prefix') || '') ? q.get('path_prefix') : PREFIX) : proxied ? PREFIX : '';
  const ip = via ? header('x-forwarded-for').split(',')[0].trim() : header('cf-connecting-ip');
  const self = url.host.toLowerCase();

  const desk = wire(env, { origin, prefix, hosts: front ? [self, front] : [self], front });
  const { store, service, dry } = desk;
  if (path === '/webhooks/orders') return method === 'POST' ? orderWebhook(request, env, ctx, desk) : notAllowed(['POST']);

  // A stable id for the rate limits when the door has none of its own: address
  // and browser, hashed with a secret and the date, so no address is stored
  // and yesterday's id cannot be tied to today's.
  const ua = header('user-agent').slice(0, 300);
  const salt = `${env.SESSION_SALT || env.SHOPIFY_API_SECRET || 'offerad'}|${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`;
  const address = ip ? `h${await digest(`${salt}|${ip}`)}` : null;
  const session = `web:${await digest(`${salt}|${ip}|${ua}`)}`;
  const caller = name => ({ ip: address, name: `${name}: ${agentName(ua)}` });

  // The cross-store door knows a store by its domain. This worker's own host
  // is the stand-in shop; a store's public domain is known once its proxy vouched for it.
  const hosted = u => (u.host.toLowerCase() === self ? DEMO : front && u.host.toLowerCase() === front ? via : null);
  const door = { service, session, hosted, relaxHeaders: !!via };
  if (path === '/connect/mcp') return handleMcp(request, { ...door, connect: true, client: caller('connect') });

  const api = API[path];
  const pages = PAGES.filter(([, pattern]) => pattern.test(path));
  let fields = null;
  if (method === 'POST' && (api?.[0] === 'POST' || pages.some(([verb]) => verb === 'POST'))) {
    fields = await readFields(request);
    if (fields.tooLarge) return json({ status: 'invalid_request', error: `The body is larger than ${MAX_BODY} bytes.` }, 413);
  }

  // Which shop: the proxy's signature, then a shop field in the query or the
  // body, then the stand-in shop. The demo and rival pages are always that shop.
  const named = (/^\/(demo|rival)(\/|$)/.test(path) ? DEMO : via || text(q.get('shop')) || text(fields?.values.shop) || DEMO).toLowerCase();

  if (path === '/mcp') return handleMcp(request, { ...door, shop: named, client: caller('mcp') });

  if (api) {
    const [verb, tool] = api;
    if (method !== verb) return notAllowed([verb]);
    if (fields?.bad) return json({ status: 'invalid_request', error: 'The body could not be read. Send a JSON object, for example {"product":"<handle or page URL>","priority":"lowest_price"}.' }, 400);
    const call = { ...door, shop: named, client: caller('api') };
    const args = verb === 'GET' ? Object.fromEntries(q) : fields.values;
    const reply = tool ? await callTool(call, tool, args) : await offerStatus(call, args);
    // Whatever the desk answered is the answer, so it goes out as 200 with its
    // own `status`, as a tool result does on the MCP door: an agent's fetch
    // tool often shows the model nothing but a number for anything else, and
    // the words are what let it correct the request. Only a desk that broke says so in HTTP.
    return json(reply, reply.status === 'error' ? 500 : 200);
  }

  if (pages.length) {
    const page = pages.find(([verb]) => verb === method);
    if (!page) return notAllowed(pages.map(([verb]) => verb));
    if (page[2] === adminLog && !(await logAllowed(request, env))) {
      return new Response('The log needs its password.', { status: 401, headers: { 'www-authenticate': 'Basic realm="OfferAd log", charset="UTF-8"', 'content-type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8', 'cache-control': 'no-store' } });
    }
    // The pages see the path without the prefix and a query without the proxy's additions.
    const clean = new URL(url);
    clean.pathname = path;
    for (const k of PROXY_PARAMS) if (via || k !== 'shop') clean.searchParams.delete(k);
    return page[2]({
      url: clean, request, env, origin, prefix, session,
      shop: known(named) ? named : null,
      hooks: hooksFor(q, env),
      client: caller('page'),
      // The demo cart asks what its codes are worth; the dry adapter knows, and takes the delivery method by this name.
      service: { ...service, evaluateCart: ({ codes, cart }) => dry.evaluate(codes, { ...cart, shipping_method: cart?.shipping_method || cart?.shipping?.handle }) },
      store: { recent: store.recent },
      ...(fields ? { body: fields.values } : {}),
    });
  }

  if (method === 'GET' && path === '/') {
    const hooks = q.has('hooks') ? `?hooks=${encodeURIComponent(q.get('hooks'))}` : '';
    return new Response(null, { status: 302, headers: { location: `${prefix}${named === DEMO ? '/demo' : '/offer'}${hooks}`, 'cache-control': 'no-store' } });
  }
  // Static files sit at the root; under the prefix they are fetched from there.
  if (method === 'GET' && proxied && env.ASSETS) {
    const asset = await env.ASSETS.fetch(new Request(new URL(path, url.origin), { headers: request.headers }));
    if (asset.status !== 404) return asset;
  }
  return json({ status: 'not_found', error: 'There is nothing at this address.', see: `${origin}${prefix}/llms.txt` }, 404);
}

export default {
  async fetch(request, env, ctx) {
    try {
      const res = await route(request, env, ctx);
      return request.method === 'HEAD' ? new Response(null, { status: res.status, headers: res.headers }) : res;
    } catch (e) {
      // The query stays out of the log: it can carry a signature.
      const ref = crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
      console.error(JSON.stringify({ at: 'worker', ref, method: request.method, url: request.url.split('?')[0], error: String(e?.stack || e) }));
      return json({ status: 'error', error: `The desk could not answer just now (ref ${ref}). Nothing was bought or charged, and asking again is safe.` }, 500);
    }
  },
};

// Offline checks only: no network, dependency or test framework.
// Run: node shopify/scripts/check-draft.mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { draftAdapter } from '../offers/src/lib/draft.js';
import { decide, PRIORITIES, r2 } from '../offers/src/lib/policy.js';
import { listProducts, mandateFor } from '../offers/src/lib/mandates.js';
import { SettleError, offerTerms } from '../offers/src/lib/settle.js';

const SHOP = 'mustafa-test-dev.myshopify.com';
const NOW = Date.parse('2026-10-13T12:00:00Z');
const mandate = mandateFor(SHOP, 'the-complete-snowboard');
const clone = structuredClone;
const bag = (value, currencyCode = 'USD') => ({ presentmentMoney: { amount: Number(value).toFixed(2), currencyCode } });
function fullOffer(quantity = 2, free = false) {
  const components = [
    { type: 'price', source: 'sponsored_discount', label: '$40 off', amount_off: 40, seller_cost: 40, buyer_value: 40 },
    { type: 'gift', label: 'Free ski wax', variant_id: mandate.concessions.gift.variant_id, seller_cost: 8, buyer_value: 24.95 },
    { type: 'express_upgrade', label: 'Express 2-day delivery at the standard rate', ship_days: 2, seller_cost: 14.1, buyer_value: 20 },
    { type: 'extended_returns', label: '60-day returns', days: 60, seller_cost: 6, buyer_value: 0 },
    { type: 'next_order_credit', label: '$40 credit on your next order', amount: 40, valid_days: 90, seller_cost: 18, buyer_value: 40 },
  ];
  if (free) components.push({ type: 'free_shipping', label: 'Free shipping', seller_cost: 19.9, buyer_value: 19.9 });
  const items_total = r2(699.95 * quantity - 40), shipping_total = free ? 0 : 19.9;
  return { components, quantity, currency: 'USD', headline: components.map(c => c.label).join(' + '), items_total, shipping_total, total: r2(items_total + shipping_total), ship_days: 2, seller_cost: components.reduce((n, c) => n + c.seller_cost, 0) };
}
function fakeAdmin() {
  const calls = [], drafts = [], scripts = {};
  function financial(input) {
    const currency = input.presentmentCurrencyCode;
    const subtotal = input.lineItems.reduce((n, l) => n + (l.appliedDiscount?.value === 100 ? 0 : Number(l.priceOverride.amount) * l.quantity), 0);
    const shipping = Number(input.shippingLine.priceWithCurrency.amount);
    return { presentmentCurrencyCode: currency, acceptAutomaticDiscounts: input.acceptAutomaticDiscounts, discountCodes: input.discountCodes, appliedDiscount: null,
      lineItemsSubtotalPrice: bag(subtotal, currency), totalShippingPriceSet: bag(shipping, currency), totalPriceSet: bag(subtotal + shipping, currency), totalTaxSet: bag(0, currency), taxesIncluded: false, warnings: [], shippingLine: { title: input.shippingLine.title, custom: true } };
  }
  function makeDraft(input) {
    return { id: `gid://shopify/DraftOrder/${drafts.length + 1}`, status: 'OPEN', ready: true, invoiceUrl: `https://${SHOP}/invoices/verified-${drafts.length + 1}`, reserveInventoryUntil: input.reserveInventoryUntil,
      allowDiscountCodesInCheckout: input.allowDiscountCodesInCheckout, customAttributes: clone(input.customAttributes), order: null, tags: clone(input.tags), ...financial(input),
      lineItems: { nodes: input.lineItems.map(l => ({ variant: { id: l.variantId }, custom: false, quantity: l.quantity, priceOverride: l.priceOverride || { amount: '24.95', currencyCode: input.presentmentCurrencyCode }, components: [], discountedTotalSet: bag(l.appliedDiscount ? 0 : Number(l.priceOverride.amount) * l.quantity, input.presentmentCurrencyCode) })), pageInfo: { hasNextPage: false } } };
  }
  const responders = {
    draftOrders: ({ variables }) => ({ data: { draftOrders: { nodes: clone(drafts.filter(d => d.tags.includes(variables.query.slice(4)))), pageInfo: { hasNextPage: false } } } }),
    draftOrder: ({ variables }) => ({ data: { draftOrder: clone(drafts.find(d => d.id === variables.id) || null) } }),
    draftOrderCalculate: ({ variables }) => ({ data: { draftOrderCalculate: { calculatedDraftOrder: financial(variables.input), userErrors: [] } } }),
    draftOrderCreate: ({ variables }) => { const d = makeDraft(variables.input); drafts.push(d); return { data: { draftOrderCreate: { draftOrder: clone(d), userErrors: [] } } }; },
  };
  const fetchFn = async (url, init) => {
    const sent = JSON.parse(init.body), operation = sent.query.match(/^(?:query|mutation) (\w+)/)[1];
    const call = { url, init, ...sent, operation }; calls.push(call);
    assert.equal(url, `https://${SHOP}/admin/api/2026-10/graphql.json`);
    assert.equal(init.headers['X-Shopify-Access-Token'], 'offline-test-token');
    assert.equal(init.redirect, 'error');
    assert.ok(['draftOrders', 'draftOrder', 'draftOrderCalculate', 'draftOrderCreate'].includes(operation), 'no invoice sends, completion or mutation other than create');
    const reply = await (scripts[operation]?.shift() || responders[operation])(call);

function publicOnly(value) {

const offer = fullOffer();
const admin = fakeAdmin();
const adapter = admin.adapter();
assert.deepEqual(adapter.inspect(offer, mandate), { supported: true, alternatives: [], not_included: [] });
const out = await adapter.mint({ ...offer, seller_secret: 'do-not-send', components: offer.components.map(c => ({ ...c, private_reason: 'do-not-send' })) }, mandate, { offer_id: 'of_full', ttl_minutes: 25 });
assert.equal(out.mode, 'draft');
assert.deepEqual(out.codes, []);
assert.equal(out.invoice_url, out.cart_url);
assert.equal(out.expires_at, null);
assert.equal(out.reservation_expires_at, '2026-10-13T12:25:00.000Z');
assert.match(out.warnings.join(' '), /no automatic offer expiry/);
assert.match(out.warnings.join(' '), /merchant must fulfill/);
assert.equal(out.deferred.length, 2);
assert.deepEqual(out.terms, offerTerms(offer, mandate));
assert.deepEqual(admin.operations(), ['draftOrders', 'draftOrderCalculate', 'draftOrderCreate']);
const input = admin.calls[2].variables.input;
assert.deepEqual(input.lineItems, [
  { variantId: mandate.product.variant_id, quantity: 2, priceOverride: { amount: '679.95', currencyCode: 'USD' } },
  { variantId: mandate.concessions.gift.variant_id, quantity: 1, generatePriceOverride: true, appliedDiscount: { title: 'Free ski wax', valueType: 'PERCENTAGE', value: 100 } },
]);
assert.deepEqual(input.shippingLine, { title: 'OfferAd Express (2-day delivery)', priceWithCurrency: { amount: '19.90', currencyCode: 'USD' }, shippingRateHandle: null });
assert.equal(input.presentmentCurrencyCode, 'USD');
assert.equal(input.acceptAutomaticDiscounts, false);
assert.equal(input.allowDiscountCodesInCheckout, false);
assert.deepEqual(input.discountCodes, []);
assert.equal(input.reserveInventoryUntil, '2026-10-13T12:25:00.000Z');
assert.equal(input.customAttributes[0].key, 'offerad_offer_id');
assert.equal(input.customAttributes[0].value, 'of_full');
assert.match(input.customAttributes[1].value, /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
assert.match(input.tags[1], /^offerad-[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
assert.ok(input.note.includes('60-day returns') && input.note.includes('credit on your next order'));
assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(input).includes('do-not-send'));
assert.deepEqual(admin.calls[1].variables.input, input, 'calculate exact same final basket before create');
publicOnly(out); publicOnly(input);

// A new adapter (simulated process restart) recovers exactly the same invoice.
const again = await admin.adapter({ now: () => NOW + 3600000 }).mint(offer, mandate, { offer_id: 'of_full', ttl_minutes: 1, reconcile_only: true });
assert.equal(again.draft_order_id, out.draft_order_id);
assert.equal(again.reservation_expires_at, out.reservation_expires_at);
assert.equal(admin.drafts.length, 1);
assert.equal(admin.operations().at(-1), 'draftOrders');

// Non-divisible total savings preserve every cent across quantity > 1.
const odd = fakeAdmin();
await odd.adapter().mint(fullOffer(3, true), mandate, { offer_id: 'of_odd' });
const oddInput = odd.calls.find(c => c.operation === 'draftOrderCreate').variables.input;
assert.deepEqual(oddInput.lineItems.slice(0, 2), [
  { variantId: mandate.product.variant_id, quantity: 1, priceOverride: { amount: '686.61', currencyCode: 'USD' } },
  { variantId: mandate.product.variant_id, quantity: 2, priceOverride: { amount: '686.62', currencyCode: 'USD' } },
]);
assert.equal(oddInput.shippingLine.priceWithCurrency.amount, '0.00');
assert.equal(odd.drafts[0].lineItemsSubtotalPrice.presentmentMoney.amount, '2059.85');

// A lost create response is recovered, never followed by another create.
const lost = fakeAdmin();
lost.scripts.draftOrderCreate = [call => { lost.responders.draftOrderCreate(call); throw new TypeError('connection lost after commit'); }];
const recovered = await lost.adapter().mint(offer, mandate, { offer_id: 'of_lost' });
assert.ok(recovered.invoice_url);
assert.deepEqual(lost.operations(), ['draftOrders', 'draftOrderCalculate', 'draftOrderCreate', 'draftOrders']);
assert.equal(lost.drafts.length, 1);

uncertain.scripts.draftOrderCreate = [() => { throw new TypeError('unknown commit'); }];

await assert.rejects(uncertainAdapter.mint(offer, mandate, { offer_id: 'of_uncertain' }), e => e.reason === 'uncertain_mint' && e.cause_reason === 'fetch_failed');
await assert.rejects(uncertainAdapter.mint(offer, mandate, { offer_id: 'of_uncertain' }), e => e.reason === 'uncertain_mint');
await assert.rejects(uncertain.adapter().mint(offer, mandate, { offer_id: 'of_uncertain', reconcile_only: true }), e => e.reason === 'uncertain_mint');

const concurrent = fakeAdmin(), concurrentAdapter = concurrent.adapter();
const simultaneous = await Promise.all([1, 2, 3].map(() => concurrentAdapter.mint(offer, mandate, { offer_id: 'of_concurrent' })));
assert.equal(new Set(simultaneous.map(x => x.draft_order_id)).size, 1);

for (const [name, mutate, reason] of [
