  ['stacking', a => { a.drafts[0].allowDiscountCodesInCheckout = true; }, 'terms_mismatch'],
  ['identity', a => { a.drafts[0].lineItems.nodes[0].variant.id = 'gid://shopify/ProductVariant/999'; }, 'terms_mismatch'],
  ['quantity', a => { a.drafts[0].lineItems.nodes[0].quantity = 1; }, 'terms_mismatch'],
  ['bundle', a => { a.drafts[0].lineItems.nodes[0].components = [{ quantity: 1 }]; }, 'terms_mismatch'],
  ['custom', a => { a.drafts[0].lineItems.nodes[0].custom = true; }, 'terms_mismatch'],
  ['gift', a => { a.drafts[0].lineItems.nodes[1].discountedTotalSet = bag(1); }, 'terms_mismatch'],
  ['not-ready', a => { a.drafts[0].ready = false; }, 'uncertain_mint'],
]) {
  const a = fakeAdmin(); await a.adapter().mint(offer, mandate, { offer_id: 'of_test' }); mutate(a);
  await assert.rejects(a.adapter().mint(offer, mandate, { offer_id: 'of_test', reconcile_only: true }), e => e.reason === reason, name);
  assert.equal(a.operations().filter(op => op === 'draftOrderCreate').length, 1, name);
}

// Errors propagate with a reason; unsafe calculations never create a draft.
for (const [name, operation, handler, reason] of [
  ['user errors', 'draftOrderCreate', () => ({ data: { draftOrderCreate: { draftOrder: null, userErrors: [{ field: ['lineItems'], message: 'Variant unavailable' }] } } }), 'user_errors'],
  ['unauthorized', 'draftOrderCreate', () => new Response('{}', { status: 401 }), 'http_error'],
  ['calculation GraphQL', 'draftOrderCalculate', () => ({ errors: [{ message: 'Access denied', extensions: { code: 'ACCESS_DENIED' } }] }), 'graphql_errors'],
  ['calculation network', 'draftOrderCalculate', () => { throw new Error('offline'); }, 'fetch_failed'],
  ['malformed search', 'draftOrders', () => ({ data: {} }), 'uncertain_mint'],
]) {
  const a = fakeAdmin(); a.scripts[operation] = [handler];
  await assert.rejects(a.adapter().mint(offer, mandate, { offer_id: 'of_error' }), e => e instanceof SettleError && e.reason === reason, name);
  if (operation !== 'draftOrderCreate') assert.equal(a.operations().includes('draftOrderCreate'), false, name);
}
const tax = fakeAdmin();
tax.scripts.draftOrderCalculate = [call => { const r = tax.responders.draftOrderCalculate(call); r.data.draftOrderCalculate.calculatedDraftOrder.totalTaxSet = bag(20); r.data.draftOrderCalculate.calculatedDraftOrder.totalPriceSet = bag(offer.total + 20); return r; }];
await tax.adapter().mint(offer, mandate, { offer_id: 'of_tax' });
const wrong = fakeAdmin();
wrong.scripts.draftOrderCalculate = [call => { const r = wrong.responders.draftOrderCalculate(call); r.data.draftOrderCalculate.calculatedDraftOrder.lineItemsSubtotalPrice = bag(1); return r; }];
await assert.rejects(wrong.adapter().mint(offer, mandate, { offer_id: 'of_wrong' }), e => e.reason === 'terms_mismatch');
assert.equal(wrong.operations().includes('draftOrderCreate'), false);
for (const options of [{ shop: 'evil.example' }, { shop: `${SHOP}.evil.example` }, { token: '' }, { apiVersion: '../other' }]) {
  const a = fakeAdmin(); await assert.rejects(a.adapter(options).mint(offer, mandate, { offer_id: 'of_config' }), e => e.reason === 'config'); assert.equal(a.calls.length, 0);
}
for (const change of [o => { o.total = 1; }, o => { o.items_total = NaN; }, o => { o.quantity = 1.5; }, o => { o.components[0].amount_off = -4; }, o => { o.components[1].variant_id = 'gid://shopify/ProductVariant/999'; }, o => { o.components[2].ship_days = 1; }]) {
  const a = fakeAdmin(), invalid = clone(offer); change(invalid);
  assert.equal(a.adapter().inspect(invalid, mandate).supported, false);
  await assert.rejects(a.adapter().mint(invalid, mandate, { offer_id: 'of_invalid' }), SettleError);
  assert.equal(a.calls.length, 0);
}

// A paid webhook's copied offer attribute is not proof of purchase. Read the
// real link from Shopify, without completing or editing either record.
const proof = fakeAdmin(), proofAdapter = proof.adapter();
const proofDraft = await proofAdapter.mint(offer, mandate, { offer_id: 'of_proof' });
const reference = { offer_id: 'of_proof', draft_order_id: proofDraft.draft_order_id };
assert.deepEqual(await proofAdapter.confirmOrder('gid://shopify/Order/7', reference), { ok: false, reason: 'order_not_linked' });
proof.drafts[0].order = { id: 'gid://shopify/Order/7' };
assert.deepEqual(await proofAdapter.confirmOrder('gid://shopify/Order/7', reference), { ok: true });
assert.deepEqual(await proofAdapter.confirmOrder('gid://shopify/Order/8', reference), { ok: false, reason: 'order_mismatch' });
assert.deepEqual(await proofAdapter.confirmOrder('gid://shopify/Order/7', { ...reference, offer_id: 'of_forged' }), { ok: false, reason: 'offer_mismatch' });
assert.deepEqual(await proofAdapter.confirmOrder('gid://shopify/Order/7', { ...reference, draft_order_id: 'gid://shopify/DraftOrder/99' }), { ok: false, reason: 'draft_not_found' });
const beforeInvalid = proof.calls.length;
assert.deepEqual(await proofAdapter.confirmOrder('invalid', reference), { ok: false, reason: 'invalid_order_reference' });
assert.equal(proof.calls.length, beforeInvalid);
proof.scripts.draftOrder = [() => { throw new Error('offline'); }];
await assert.rejects(proofAdapter.confirmOrder('gid://shopify/Order/7', reference), e => e.reason === 'fetch_failed');
proof.scripts.draftOrder = [() => ({ errors: [{ message: 'Access denied' }] })];
await assert.rejects(proofAdapter.confirmOrder('gid://shopify/Order/7', reference), e => e.reason === 'graphql_errors');
assert.equal(proof.operations().filter(op => op === 'draftOrderCreate').length, 1);

// All current product/priority/quantity alternatives survive composite checkout.
let count = 0;
for (const m of listProducts(SHOP)) for (const priority of Object.keys(PRIORITIES)) for (const quantity of [1, 2, 5]) for (const candidate of decide(m, { priority, quantity }).offers) {
  const a = fakeAdmin();
  assert.equal(a.adapter().inspect(candidate, m).supported, true, `${m.product.handle} ${priority} x${quantity}`);
  const r = await a.adapter().mint(candidate, m, { offer_id: `of_matrix_${++count}` });
  assert.equal(r.terms.total, candidate.total);
  assert.equal(r.terms.components.length, candidate.components.length);
  publicOnly(r); a.calls.forEach(c => publicOnly(c.variables));
}
console.log(`draft checks passed: ${count} full policy offers, exact quantity arithmetic, schema inputs, gift/express/benefits, replay/concurrency, ambiguous writes, checkout mismatches and authenticated draft-to-order links; no network used`);
shopify/scripts/check-function.mjs
// Checks the Discount Function without Shopify. Runs both targets on sample
// carts for every shape of offer and holds each result to the output rules of
// the Discount Function API, then checks what the CLI would only complain about
// at build or deploy time: the input queries against the schema, and the wiring
// between the toml files, the exports and the embed block.
// Run: node shopify/scripts/check-function.mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import * as fn from '../app/extensions/offer-discount/src/index.js';
import { decide, publicOffer, r2 } from '../offers/src/lib/policy.js';
import { SHOPS, listProducts, mandateFor } from '../offers/src/lib/mandates.js';

const app = new URL('../app/', import.meta.url);
const ext = new URL('extensions/offer-discount/', app);
const read = (base, path) => readFileSync(new URL(path, base), 'utf8');

// First the schema and the input queries. This reads just enough SDL to know
// every type's fields, their arguments and what they return.
function readSchema(sdl) {
  const text = sdl.replace(/"""[\s\S]*?"""/g, '').replace(/^directive .*$/gm, '').replace(/@\w+(\([^)]*\))?/g, '');
  // The built-in scalars are not declared in a schema file.
  const types = Object.fromEntries(['Int', 'Float', 'String', 'Boolean', 'ID'].map(name => [name, { leaf: true }]));
  for (const [, name, members] of text.matchAll(/^union (\w+) = (\w+(?: \| \w+)*)$/gm)) types[name] = { members: members.split(' | ') };
  for (const [, name] of text.matchAll(/^(?:scalar|enum) (\w+)/gm)) types[name] = { leaf: true };
  for (const [, name, impl, body] of text.matchAll(/^(?:type|interface) (\w+)(?: implements ([\w &]+?))? \{([^}]*)\}/gm)) {
    const fields = {};
    for (const [, field, args, type] of body.matchAll(/(\w+)\s*(?:\(([^)]*)\))?\s*:\s*([\w[\]!]+)/g)) {
      fields[field] = { type: type.replace(/[[\]!]/g, ''), args: [...(args ?? '').matchAll(/(\w+)\s*:/g)].map(a => a[1]) };
    }
    types[name] = { fields, interfaces: impl ? impl.split(/\s*&\s*/) : [] };
  }
  return types;
}

// An input query as a tree of selections. Covers what these queries use:
// fields, arguments with plain values, aliases and inline fragments.
function readQuery(text) {
  const tokens = text.replace(/#.*$/gm, '').match(/\.\.\.|[{}():]|"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"|[^\s{}():,]+/g);
  let i = 0;
  const take = want => {
    const t = tokens[i++];
    if (want) assert.equal(t, want, `input query: expected ${want}, got ${t}`);
    return t;
  };
  const selectionSet = () => {
    const out = [];
    take('{');
    while (tokens[i] !== '}') {
      if (tokens[i] === '...') {
        take();
        take('on');
        out.push({ on: take(), selection: selectionSet() });
        continue;
      }
      let field = take();
      if (tokens[i] === ':') {
        take();
        field = take();
      }
      const args = [];
      if (tokens[i] === '(') {
        take();
        while (tokens[i] !== ')') {
          args.push(take());
          take(':');
          take();
        }
        take();
      }
      out.push({ field, args, selection: tokens[i] === '{' ? selectionSet() : null });
    }
    take('}');
    return out;
  };
  take('query');
  const name = take();
  const selection = selectionSet();
  assert.equal(i, tokens.length, 'input query: nothing after the closing brace');
  return { name, selection };
}

// Every selection exists on its type; returns the cost Shopify charges the query.
// https://shopify.dev/docs/api/functions/latest#input-query-limits
function checkSelection(types, selection, typeName, path) {
  const type = types[typeName];
  let cost = 0;
  for (const node of selection) {
    if (node.on) {
      const possible = node.on === typeName || type.members?.includes(node.on) || types[node.on]?.interfaces?.includes(typeName);
      assert.ok(possible, `${path}: "... on ${node.on}" cannot match ${typeName}`);
      cost += checkSelection(types, node.selection, node.on, path);
      continue;
    }
    if (node.field === '__typename') continue;
    const def = type.fields?.[node.field];
    assert.ok(def, `${path}.${node.field}: no such field on ${typeName}`);
    for (const arg of node.args) assert.ok(def.args.includes(arg), `${path}.${node.field}: no argument ${arg}`);
    const returns = types[def.type];
    assert.ok(returns, `${path}.${node.field}: unknown type ${def.type}`);
    if (returns.leaf) {
      assert.equal(node.selection, null, `${path}.${node.field} is a ${def.type} and takes no selection`);
      cost += typeName === 'Metafield' ? 0 : 1;
    } else {
      assert.ok(node.selection?.length, `${path}.${node.field} is a ${def.type} and needs a selection`);
      cost += (def.type === 'Metafield' ? 3 : 0) + checkSelection(types, node.selection, def.type, `${path}.${node.field}`);
    }
  }
  return cost;
}

// A sample input may only hold what its query selects, or a check would pass
// on data the function never gets from Shopify.
function conforms(value, selection, path) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.forEach((v, i) => conforms(v, selection, `${path}[${i}]`));
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return;
  const flat = sel => sel.flatMap(n => (n.on ? flat(n.selection) : [n]));
  const fields = new Map(flat(selection).map(n => [n.field, n]));
  for (const [key, v] of Object.entries(value)) {
    assert.ok(fields.has(key), `${path}.${key} is in the sample input but not in the input query`);
    if (fields.get(key).selection) conforms(v, fields.get(key).selection, `${path}.${key}`);
  }
}

const schemaText = read(ext, 'schema.graphql');
const types = readSchema(schemaText);
const QUERY = { cart: 'src/cart_lines_discounts_generate_run.graphql', delivery: 'src/cart_delivery_options_discounts_generate_run.graphql' };
const queries = {};
for (const [target, path] of Object.entries(QUERY)) {
  const text = read(ext, path);
  queries[target] = readQuery(text);
  const cost = checkSelection(types, queries[target].selection, 'Input', 'Input');
  assert.ok(cost <= 30, `${path}: query cost ${cost} is over 30`);
  assert.ok(Buffer.byteLength(text) <= 3000, `${path}: over 3000 bytes`);
  console.log(`${path}: every field is in schema.graphql, cost ${cost} of 30`);
}
// The reader has to be able to fail, or the lines above prove nothing.
assert.throws(() => checkSelection(types, readQuery('query Q { cart { lines { price } } }').selection, 'Input', 'Input'), /no such field/);
assert.throws(() => checkSelection(types, readQuery('query Q { cart { lines { merchandise { ... on Product { id } } } } }').selection, 'Input', 'Input'), /cannot match/);
assert.throws(() => checkSelection(types, readQuery('query Q { cart { lines } }').selection, 'Input', 'Input'), /needs a selection/);

// The output rules: https://shopify.dev/docs/api/functions/latest/discount#validations
// and the result types in schema.graphql. A code-owned function may add discounts
// but not accept or reject codes, so each target has exactly one operation to use.
const DECIMAL = /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/;
const OPERATION = { cart: 'productDiscountsAdd', delivery: 'deliveryDiscountsAdd' };
const STRATEGIES = { cart: ['ALL', 'FIRST', 'MAXIMUM'], delivery: ['ALL'] };
const only = (object, keys, what) => assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(object).filter(k => !keys.includes(k)), [], `${what}: unexpected keys`);

function checkValue(target, value, what) {
  assert.equal(Object.keys(value).length, 1, `${what}: a value is a percentage or a fixed amount, not both`);
  if (value.percentage) {
    only(value.percentage, ['value'], what);
    // Decimal is serialized as a string.
    assert.equal(typeof value.percentage.value, 'string', `${what}: percentage is a decimal string`);
    assert.match(value.percentage.value, DECIMAL, what);
    assert.ok(Number(value.percentage.value) > 0 && Number(value.percentage.value) <= 100, `${what}: percentage within 0 to 100`);
    return;
  }
  assert.ok(value.fixedAmount, `${what}: unknown kind of value`);
  // appliesToEachItem exists on product candidates only.
  only(value.fixedAmount, target === 'cart' ? ['amount', 'appliesToEachItem'] : ['amount'], what);
  assert.equal(typeof value.fixedAmount.amount, 'string', `${what}: amount is a decimal string`);
  assert.match(value.fixedAmount.amount, DECIMAL, what);
  assert.ok(Number(value.fixedAmount.amount) > 0, `${what}: amount above zero`);
  if ('appliesToEachItem' in value.fixedAmount) assert.equal(typeof value.fixedAmount.appliesToEachItem, 'boolean', what);
}

function checkResult(target, input, result) {
  assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(result)), result, 'the result is plain JSON');
  only(result, ['operations'], 'result');
  assert.ok(Array.isArray(result.operations), 'operations is a list');
  assert.ok(Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(result)) <= 20000, 'output under 20 kB');
  assert.ok(result.operations.length <= 1, 'one of each operation at most, and each target has one to use');
  for (const operation of result.operations) {
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(operation), [OPERATION[target]], `${target}: the operation is ${OPERATION[target]}`);
    const { candidates, selectionStrategy, ...rest } = operation[OPERATION[target]];
    assert.deepEqual(rest, {});
    assert.ok(STRATEGIES[target].includes(selectionStrategy), `${target}: selection strategy ${selectionStrategy}`);
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(candidates) && candidates.length, 'an operation has candidates');
    const lines = new Map((input.cart.lines ?? []).map(l => [l.id, l]));
    const handles = new Set((input.cart.deliveryGroups ?? []).flatMap(g => g.deliveryOptions.map(o => o.handle)));
    candidates.forEach((candidate, n) => {
      const what = `${target} candidate ${n}`;
      // No associatedDiscountCode: for a code discount Shopify overwrites it with the triggering code.
      only(candidate, ['message', 'targets', 'value'], what);
      assert.ok(typeof candidate.message === 'string' && candidate.message.trim() && candidate.message.length <= 100, `${what}: a short message`);
      assert.ok(Array.isArray(candidate.targets) && candidate.targets.length, `${what}: targets present`);
      const seen = new Set();
      for (const t of candidate.targets) {
        assert.equal(Object.keys(t).length, 1, `${what}: a target is one thing`);
        if (target === 'cart') {
          only(t.cartLine, ['id', 'quantity'], what);
          const line = lines.get(t.cartLine.id);
          assert.ok(line, `${what}: targets a line that is in the cart`);
          // Shopify reads a missing quantity as the whole line. The function always says how many.
          assert.ok(Number.isInteger(t.cartLine.quantity) && t.cartLine.quantity > 0 && t.cartLine.quantity <= line.quantity, `${what}: quantity within the line`);
          seen.add(t.cartLine.id);
        } else {
          only(t.deliveryOption, ['handle'], what);
          assert.ok(handles.has(t.deliveryOption.handle), `${what}: targets an option the cart has`);
          seen.add(t.deliveryOption.handle);
        }
      }
      assert.equal(seen.size, candidate.targets.length, `${what}: no target twice`);
      checkValue(target, candidate.value, what);
    });
  }
}
// Same here: the rules have to be able to fail.
const lineTarget = { cartLine: { id: 'l', quantity: 1 } };
const oneLine = { cart: { lines: [{ id: 'l', quantity: 1 }] } };
const productResult = (candidate, more = {}) => ({ operations: [{ productDiscountsAdd: { candidates: [{ message: 'm', targets: [lineTarget], value: { percentage: { value: '10' } }, ...candidate }], selectionStrategy: 'ALL', ...more } }] });
checkResult('cart', oneLine, productResult({}));
assert.throws(() => checkResult('cart', oneLine, productResult({ value: { percentage: { value: 10 } } })), /decimal string/);
assert.throws(() => checkResult('cart', oneLine, productResult({ targets: [] })), /targets present/);
assert.throws(() => checkResult('cart', oneLine, productResult({ targets: [{ cartLine: { id: 'x', quantity: 1 } }] })), /in the cart/);
assert.throws(() => checkResult('cart', oneLine, productResult({ targets: [{ cartLine: { id: 'l', quantity: 2 } }] })), /within the line/);
assert.throws(() => checkResult('cart', oneLine, productResult({}, { selectionStrategy: 'BEST' })), /selection strategy/);
assert.throws(() => checkResult('cart', oneLine, { operations: [...productResult({}).operations, ...productResult({}).operations] }), /one of each operation/);
assert.throws(() => checkResult('delivery', oneLine, productResult({})), /deliveryDiscountsAdd/);

// Sample inputs, shaped like the two input queries.
const CODE = 'OFFER-7K2M9Q';
const TODAY = '2026-10-13';
const gid = n => `gid://shopify/ProductVariant/${n}`;
const board = mandateFor('demo', 'the-complete-snowboard');
const BOARD = board.product.variant_id;
const WAX = board.concessions.gift.variant_id;
const OTHER = gid('45900666077347');

// What the service writes on the discount: the public offer plus the variant it was made for.
const config = (m, offer, extra = {}) => ({ ...publicOffer(offer), variant_id: m.product.variant_id, code: CODE, expires_at: `${TODAY}T18:00:00.000Z`, ...extra });
const line = (n, variant, quantity, price, currencyCode = 'USD') => ({
  id: `gid://shopify/CartLine/${n}`,
  quantity,
  cost: { amountPerQuantity: { amount: String(price), currencyCode } },
  merchandise: variant ? { id: variant } : {},
});
const option = (handle, title, amount, deliveryMethodType = 'SHIPPING') => ({ handle, title, deliveryMethodType, cost: { amount: String(amount) } });
const group = (lines, options) => ({ cartLines: lines.map(l => ({ merchandise: l.merchandise })), deliveryOptions: options });
const STANDARD = option('standard-1', 'Standard', '19.9');
const EXPRESS = option('express-1', 'Express', '39.9');

const shared = (jsonValue, o) => ({
  discount: { discountClasses: o.classes ?? ['PRODUCT', 'SHIPPING'], metafield: jsonValue === undefined ? null : { jsonValue } },
  shop: { localTime: { date: o.date ?? TODAY } },
  triggeringDiscountCode: 'code' in o ? o.code : CODE,
});
const cartInput = (jsonValue, lines, o = {}) => ({ cart: { lines }, ...shared(jsonValue, o) });
const deliveryInput = (jsonValue, lines, groups, o = {}) => ({
  cart: { lines: lines.map(({ quantity, merchandise }) => ({ quantity, merchandise })), deliveryGroups: groups ?? [group(lines, [STANDARD, EXPRESS])] },
  ...shared(jsonValue, o),
});

const freeze = x => {
  if (x && typeof x === 'object') Object.values(x).forEach(freeze);
  return Object.freeze(x);
};
const RUN = { cart: fn.cartLinesDiscountsGenerateRun, delivery: fn.cartDeliveryOptionsDiscountsGenerateRun };
function run(target, input) {
  conforms(input, queries[target].selection, target);
  // Frozen: a function that edits its input would throw here.
  const result = RUN[target](freeze(structuredClone(input)));
  assert.deepEqual(RUN[target](input), result, 'same input, same result');
  checkResult(target, input, result);
  return result;
}
const runCart = (jsonValue, lines, o) => run('cart', cartInput(jsonValue, lines, o));
const runDelivery = (jsonValue, lines, groups, o) => run('delivery', deliveryInput(jsonValue, lines, groups, o));
const candidates = result => result.operations[0]?.[Object.keys(result.operations[0])[0]].candidates ?? [];
const NOTHING = { operations: [] };

const show = (title, result) => {
  console.log(`\n== ${title}`);
  if (!result.operations.length) console.log('   no operations');
  for (const c of candidates(result)) {
    const what = c.value.percentage ? `${c.value.percentage.value}% off` : `${c.value.fixedAmount.amount} off`;
    const where = c.targets.map(t => (t.cartLine ? `${t.cartLine.id.split('/').pop()} x${t.cartLine.quantity}` : t.deliveryOption.handle)).join(', ');
    console.log(`   ${what} on ${c.targets[0].cartLine ? 'line' : 'option'} ${where} | "${c.message}"`);
  }
};

// The cart target.
const boardLine = (quantity = 1, n = 1) => line(n, BOARD, quantity, 699.95);
const waxLine = (quantity = 1, n = 2) => line(n, WAX, quantity, 24.95);

// Price only.
const priceOffer = decide(board, { priority: 'lowest_price' }).offers[0];
assert.deepEqual(priceOffer.components.map(c => c.type), ['price']);
const price = config(board, priceOffer);
let result = runCart(price, [boardLine()]);
show('price only, one unit in the cart', result);
assert.deepEqual(result, {
  operations: [{
    productDiscountsAdd: {
      candidates: [{ message: '$112 off', targets: [{ cartLine: { id: 'gid://shopify/CartLine/1', quantity: 1 } }], value: { fixedAmount: { amount: '112.00', appliesToEachItem: false } } }],
      selectionStrategy: 'ALL',
    },
  }],
});
assert.deepEqual(runDelivery(price, [boardLine()]), NOTHING, 'a price offer leaves shipping alone');
// Other things in the cart are not touched, and a third unit is not discounted.
result = runCart(price, [line(7, OTHER, 1, 885.95), line(8, null, 1, 10), boardLine(3)]);
assert.deepEqual(candidates(result)[0].targets, [{ cartLine: { id: 'gid://shopify/CartLine/1', quantity: 1 } }]);
assert.deepEqual(runCart(price, [line(7, OTHER, 1, 885.95)]), NOTHING, 'the product is not in the cart');
assert.deepEqual(runCart(price, []), NOTHING, 'empty cart');
assert.deepEqual(runCart({ ...price, items_total: undefined }, [{ ...boardLine(), quantity: undefined }]), NOTHING, 'a line without a quantity counts for nothing');
assert.deepEqual(runCart(price, [boardLine()], { classes: ['SHIPPING'] }), NOTHING, 'the discount has no PRODUCT class');

// Two price components (bulk tier plus discount), priced for two units.
const twoOffer = decide(board, { priority: 'lowest_price', quantity: 2 }).offers[0];
assert.deepEqual(twoOffer.components.map(c => c.type), ['price', 'price']);
const two = config(board, twoOffer);
result = runCart(two, [boardLine(3)]);
show('two price components for two units, three in the cart', result);
assert.deepEqual(candidates(result), [{ message: '5% off for 2 or more + $42 off', targets: [{ cartLine: { id: 'gid://shopify/CartLine/1', quantity: 2 } }], value: { fixedAmount: { amount: '112.00', appliesToEachItem: false } } }]);
result = runCart(two, [boardLine(1, 1), boardLine(2, 3)]);
show('the same, the units on two lines', result);
assert.deepEqual(candidates(result)[0].targets, [{ cartLine: { id: 'gid://shopify/CartLine/1', quantity: 1 } }, { cartLine: { id: 'gid://shopify/CartLine/3', quantity: 1 } }]);
assert.deepEqual(runCart(two, [boardLine(1)]), NOTHING, 'priced for two units, one in the cart');

// The offer is a price: a lower shelf price shrinks the amount, never the agreed total.
result = runCart(price, [line(1, BOARD, 1, 649.95)]);
show('shelf price dropped to 649.95 since the offer', result);
assert.equal(candidates(result)[0].value.fixedAmount.amount, '62.00');
assert.equal(r2(649.95 - 62), priceOffer.items_total);
assert.deepEqual(runCart(price, [line(1, BOARD, 1, 580)]), NOTHING, 'shelf price already under the agreed price');
assert.equal(candidates(runCart(price, [line(1, BOARD, 1, 749.95)]))[0].value.fixedAmount.amount, '112.00', 'a higher shelf price does not raise the amount');
assert.deepEqual(runCart(price, [line(1, BOARD, 1, 699.95, 'CAD')]), NOTHING, 'an amount in USD is not applied to a cart in CAD');
assert.equal(candidates(runCart({ ...price, currency: undefined, items_total: undefined }, [boardLine()]))[0].value.fixedAmount.amount, '112.00', 'currency and items_total are optional');

assert.deepEqual(matchOffer.components.map(c => c.type), ['free_shipping', 'price']);

result = runDelivery(match, [boardLine()]);

  operations: [{

});

// Free add-on, in the cart and not.
const giftOffer = decide(board, { priority: 'extras' }).offers[0];
assert.deepEqual(giftOffer.components.map(c => c.type), ['gift', 'free_shipping']);

assert.deepEqual(candidates(result).map(c => c.targets[0].cartLine.id.split('/').pop()), ['1', '2']);
// An add-on that is the product itself cannot be told apart from the unit bought.
assert.deepEqual(runCart({ ...gift, components: [{ type: 'gift', label: 'Second one free', variant_id: BOARD }] }, [boardLine(2)]), NOTHING);
// The same add-on listed twice is still one free unit.
assert.equal(candidates(runCart({ ...gift, components: [...giftOffer.components, ...giftOffer.components] }, [boardLine(), waxLine(3)])).length, 1);
// Messages come from the offer's labels, cut to size, with a plain one when a label is missing.
const labels = { ...full, components: [{ type: 'price', amount_off: 100, label: 'y'.repeat(80) }, { type: 'price', amount_off: 12, label: 'z'.repeat(80) }, { type: 'gift', variant_id: WAX, label: 'x'.repeat(300) }, { type: 'free_shipping', label: 42 }, { type: 'express_upgrade' }] };

assert.deepEqual(candidates(runDelivery(labels, [boardLine(), waxLine()])).map(c => c.message), ['Free standard shipping', 'Express delivery at the standard rate']);

// Unknown or missing config.
for (const [why, jsonValue] of [
  ['no metafield', undefined],

}
// Without a variant nothing is the product, not even a line that has no variant of its own.
assert.deepEqual(runCart({ ...price, variant_id: undefined }, [line(8, null, 1, 699.95)]), NOTHING, 'no variant, a custom line in the cart');
console.log('\n== unknown or missing config: no operations from either target');
// The same offer written in the other ways the function reads.
for (const jsonValue of [
  JSON.stringify(price),
  { offer: publicOffer(priceOffer), variant_id: BOARD },

}
console.log('== expired or malformed config: no operations from either target');
// The date check is a backstop with a day of slack, because the Function only
// gets the shop's local date. Inside the slack it is the discount's endsAt that ends the offer.
const applies = (change, why) => assert.equal(candidates(runCart({ ...full, ...change }, [boardLine(), waxLine()])).length, 2, why);
applies({ expires_at: '2026-10-12T23:00:00.000Z' }, 'expired yesterday: inside the slack');
assert.deepEqual(runCart({ ...full, expires_at: '2026-10-11T23:59:59.000Z' }, [boardLine(), waxLine()]), NOTHING, 'two days past: outside the slack');
applies({ expires_at: Date.parse(`${TODAY}T18:00:00Z`) }, 'an expiry in epoch milliseconds');
applies({ expires_at: Date.parse(`${TODAY}T18:00:00Z`) / 1000 }, 'an expiry in epoch seconds');
applies({ expires_at: undefined }, 'no expiry in the config');
applies({ code: undefined }, 'no code in the config: the entered one is enough');

// The delivery target.

// A cart in two shipments: the offer covers the one that carries its product.
result = runDelivery(expressFree, [boardLine(), line(7, OTHER, 1, 885.95)], [
  group([line(7, OTHER, 1, 885.95)], [option('standard-b', 'Standard', '19.9'), option('express-b', 'Express', '39.9')]),
  group([boardLine()], [STANDARD, EXPRESS]),

assert.deepEqual(candidates(result).flatMap(c => c.targets.map(t => t.deliveryOption.handle)), ['standard-1', 'express-1']);
result = runDelivery(freeOnly, [boardLine(1, 1), boardLine(1, 3)], [group([boardLine(1, 1)], [STANDARD]), group([boardLine(1, 3)], [option('standard-b', 'Standard', '12')])]);

assert.deepEqual(runDelivery(expressFree, [boardLine()], undefined, { classes: ['PRODUCT'] }), NOTHING, 'the discount has no SHIPPING class');
assert.deepEqual(runDelivery(expressFree, [line(7, OTHER, 1, 885.95)]), NOTHING, 'the product is not in the cart');
assert.deepEqual(runDelivery(expressFree, [boardLine()], []), NOTHING, 'no delivery groups yet: no address');

// Every offer the policy makes, end to end: what the buyer pays once Shopify
// applies both results to the cart the offer was made for. It has to be the
// total the service quoted.
function checkoutTotal(m, offer, cfg = config(m, offer), o = {}) {
  const has = type => offer.components.some(c => c.type === type);
  const lines = [line(1, m.product.variant_id, offer.quantity, m.product.list)];
  const add = offer.components.find(c => c.type === 'gift');
  if (add) lines.push(line(2, add.variant_id, 1, m.concessions.gift.value));
  const options = [option('standard', 'Standard', m.shipping.standard.price), option('express', 'Express', m.shipping.express.price)];

  let total = lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + Number(l.cost.amountPerQuantity.amount) * l.quantity, 0);
  for (const c of candidates(runCart(cfg, lines, o))) {
    if (c.value.fixedAmount) total -= Number(c.value.fixedAmount.amount);
    else for (const t of c.targets) total -= Number(lines.find(l => l.id === t.cartLine.id).cost.amountPerQuantity.amount) * t.cartLine.quantity * Number(c.value.percentage.value) / 100;
  }
  // The buyer picks express when the offer upgrades it, standard otherwise.
  const picked = options[has('express_upgrade') ? 1 : 0];
  let shipping = Number(picked.cost.amount);
  for (const c of candidates(runDelivery(cfg, lines, [group(lines, options)], o))) {
    if (!c.targets.some(t => t.deliveryOption.handle === picked.handle)) continue;
    shipping -= c.value.fixedAmount ? Number(c.value.fixedAmount.amount) : shipping * Number(c.value.percentage.value) / 100;
  }
  return r2(total + shipping);
}

// The service's own writer of the metafield, when it is there to ask. A broken
// settle.js is check-settle's to report, so here it only means this part is skipped.
const settleFile = new URL('../offers/src/lib/settle.js', import.meta.url);
const settle = existsSync(settleFile) ? await import(settleFile.href).catch(e => ({ missing: `does not load (${e.message})` })) : { missing: 'is not there' };
const classesFor = offer => {
  const has = type => offer.components.some(c => c.type === type);
  return [(has('price') || has('gift')) && 'PRODUCT', (has('free_shipping') || has('express_upgrade')) && 'SHIPPING'].filter(Boolean);
};

let offers = 0;
const proofs = [null, { ok: true, domain: 'evo.com', trusted_domain: true, match_by: 'gtin', price: 629.95, shipping: 0 }, { ok: true, domain: 'shop.example', trusted_domain: false, match_by: 'title', price: 600, shipping: null }];
for (const shop of Object.keys(SHOPS)) {
  for (const m of listProducts(shop)) {
    for (const priority of [undefined, 'lowest_price', 'fast_delivery', 'easy_returns', 'extras', 'repeat_purchase']) {
      for (const quantity of [1, 2, 5]) {
        for (const need_by_days of [undefined, 2, 5]) {
          for (const proof of proofs) {
            for (const offer of decide(m, { priority, quantity, need_by_days }, proof).offers) {
              const what = `${shop} ${m.product.handle} ${priority} x${quantity} in ${need_by_days} days: ${offer.headline}`;
              assert.equal(checkoutTotal(m, offer), offer.total, what);
              offers++;
              if (!settle.offerTerms) continue;
              // As the metafield holds it, and with no more classes than a discount for this offer is given.
              const written = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({ offer_id: 'of_1', ...settle.offerTerms(offer, m) }));
              assert.equal(checkoutTotal(m, offer, written, { classes: classesFor(offer) }), offer.total, `${what}, as settle.js writes it`);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
console.log(`\n== ${offers} offers from the policy: the cart each was made for checks out at the quoted total`);
console.log(settle.offerTerms ? '   and at the same total from the metafield settle.js writes' : `   not checked against the metafield the service writes: settle.js ${settle.missing ?? 'has no offerTerms'}`);

// Last, the wiring between the files. This reads the part of TOML they use:
// tables, lists of tables and one-line values.
function readToml(text) {
  const root = {};
  let at = root;
  const walk = keys => keys.reduce((o, k) => {
    o[k] ??= {};
    return Array.isArray(o[k]) ? o[k].at(-1) : o[k];
  }, root);
  for (const raw of text.split('\n')) {
    const row = raw.trim();
    if (!row || row.startsWith('#')) continue;
    const list = row.match(/^\[\[(.+)\]\]$/);
    const table = row.match(/^\[(.+)\]$/);
    if (list) {
      const keys = list[1].split('.');
      const parent = walk(keys.slice(0, -1));
      (parent[keys.at(-1)] ??= []).push(at = {});
    } else if (table) {
      at = walk(table[1].split('.'));
    } else {
      const [, key, value] = row.match(/^([\w-]+)\s*=\s*(.+)$/) ?? assert.fail(`toml line not understood: ${row}`);
      at[key] = JSON.parse(value);
    }
  }
  return root;
}

const extension = readToml(read(ext, 'shopify.extension.toml'));
const [func] = extension.extensions;
assert.equal(extension.api_version, schemaText.match(/^# api_version: (\S+)/)[1], 'schema.graphql is the schema of this api_version');
assert.equal(func.type, 'function');
assert.equal(func.handle, 'offer-discount');
assert.deepEqual(func.targeting.map(t => t.target), ['cart.lines.discounts.generate.run', 'cart.delivery-options.discounts.generate.run']);
assert.deepEqual(func.targeting.map(t => t.input_query), Object.values(QUERY));
for (const t of func.targeting) {
  // The CLI maps a kebab-case export in the toml to the camelCase export of src/index.js.
  assert.match(t.export, /^[a-z0-9-]+$/);
  assert.equal(typeof fn[t.export.replace(/-(\w)/g, (_, c) => c.toUpperCase())], 'function', `src/index.js exports ${t.export}`);
}
const locale = JSON.parse(read(ext, 'locales/en.default.json'));
for (const key of ['name', 'description']) assert.ok(func[key] === `t:${key}` && locale[key], `${key} is in the locale file`);
const pkg = JSON.parse(read(ext, 'package.json'));
assert.equal(pkg.type, 'module');
assert.ok(pkg.dependencies['@shopify/shopify_function'], 'the CLI builds JavaScript functions with this library');
assert.ok(existsSync(new URL(pkg.codegen.schema, ext)));

const config_ = readToml(read(app, 'shopify.app.toml'));
assert.equal(config_.name, 'OfferAd agent offers');
assert.equal(config_.embedded, false);
for (const scope of ['write_discounts', 'read_products', 'read_orders', 'write_orders', 'write_app_proxy']) assert.ok(config_.access_scopes.scopes.split(',').includes(scope), `scope ${scope}`);
assert.deepEqual([config_.app_proxy.prefix, config_.app_proxy.subpath], ['apps', 'offerad']);
assert.ok(config_.webhooks.subscriptions.some(s => s.topics.includes('orders/create') && s.uri === '/webhooks/orders'));
const urls = { application_url: config_.application_url, 'app_proxy.url': config_.app_proxy.url, 'auth.redirect_urls': config_.auth.redirect_urls[0] };

assert.equal(new URL(config_.app_proxy.url).pathname, '/apps/offerad', 'the worker serves the proxied routes under the same path');

const theme = readToml(read(app, 'extensions/agent-offers/shopify.extension.toml'));
assert.equal(theme.type, 'theme');
const block = read(app, 'extensions/agent-offers/blocks/agent-offers.liquid');

const blockSchema = JSON.parse(block.match(/{% schema %}([\s\S]*?){% endschema %}/)[1]);
assert.equal(blockSchema.target, 'body');
assert.ok(blockSchema.name.length <= 25, 'the name fits the theme editor');
const settings = blockSchema.settings.map(s => s.id);
assert.deepEqual([...new Set([...block.matchAll(/block\.settings\.(\w+)/g)].map(m => m[1]))].sort(), [...settings].sort(), 'every setting is used, every setting used exists');
assert.equal(blockSchema.settings.find(s => s.id === 'proxy_path').default, new URL(config_.app_proxy.url).pathname.replace(/^\/apps\/offerad$/, `/${config_.app_proxy.prefix}/${config_.app_proxy.subpath}`));
assert.match(block, /src="\{\{ endpoint \| escape \}\}\/embed\.js"/);
for (const attribute of ['data-endpoint', 'data-shop', 'data-product', 'data-webmcp', 'data-box', 'data-box-target', 'data-jsonld']) assert.ok(block.includes(`${attribute}="`), attribute);

console.log('== wiring: toml targets, exports, input queries, locale, app config and embed block agree');
if (unfilled.length) console.log(`   still placeholders in shopify.app.toml: ${unfilled.join(', ')}`);

shopify/scripts/check-pages.mjs
// Checks the HTML doors, the stand-in storefront and the storefront script.
// Run: node shopify/scripts/check-pages.mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import vm from 'node:vm';
import * as pages from '../offers/src/lib/pages.js';
import { decide, publicOffer, PRIORITIES } from '../offers/src/lib/policy.js';
import { mandateFor, listProducts } from '../offers/src/lib/mandates.js';

// A promise nobody caught is a bug in the script under test, so it fails the run.
process.on('unhandledRejection', e => { throw e; });

const ORIGIN = 'https://shop.test';
const DESK = /offer|agent|negoti|price[\s-]*match/i;
const EVIL = '"\'><script>alert(1)</script><img src=x onerror=alert(2)>';
const BOARD = mandateFor('demo', 'the-complete-snowboard');
const WAX = mandateFor('demo', 'selling-plans-ski-wax');
const V = BOARD.product.variant_numeric_id;
const W = WAX.product.variant_numeric_id;

// --- a stand-in for service.js, with the reply shapes of the build spec -------

// What the verifier would say about the test links, without fetching anything.
const EVIDENCE = {
  cheaper: { ok: true, reason: 'ok', domain: 'peakboards.demo', trusted_domain: true, match_by: 'gtin', price: 629.95, shipping: 0 },
  hostile: { ok: false, reason: 'different_product', reason_text: `the page shows ${EVIL}`, domain: 'evil.example' },
};

function fakeService({ shippingInAmount = true, unknown = 'that code is not known', base = ORIGIN } = {}) {
  const open = new Map();
  const minted = new Map();
  const calls = [];
  let n = 0;
  return {
    calls,
    async options({ shop, product }) { return { status: 'ok', shop, product }; },
    async request(input) {
      calls.push(['request', input]);
      const m = mandateFor(input.shop, input.product);
      if (!m) return { status: 'unknown_product', offers: [], notes: [], reason: 'This store does not sell that product.' };
      const evidence = input.competing_offer_url ? EVIDENCE[new URL(input.competing_offer_url).searchParams.get('variant')] ?? EVIDENCE.hostile : null;
      const d = decide(m, input, evidence);
      return {
        status: d.status,
        product: { title: m.product.title, handle: m.product.handle },
        list: m.product.list,
        question: d.question,
        offers: d.offers.map(o => {
          const offer_id = `of_${++n}`;
          open.set(offer_id, { m, o });
          return { offer_id, ...publicOffer(o), expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 60000).toISOString() };
        }),
        notes: d.notes,
        proof: evidence ? { accepted: evidence.ok, domain: evidence.domain, their_price: evidence.price ?? null, compared: 'delivered price' } : null,
        next: 'Show these offers to the user. accept_offer turns the one they choose into a code.',
      };
    },
    async accept(input) {
      calls.push(['accept', input]);
      const hit = open.get(input.offer_id);
      if (!hit) return { status: 'not_found', reason: 'That offer is not open any more.' };
      if (input.user_approved !== true) return { status: 'needs_approval', reason: 'A code is issued only when the user has seen this offer and agreed to it.' };
      hit.code ||= `OFFER-${String(open.size + minted.size).padStart(2, '0')}K2M9Q`.slice(0, 14);
      minted.set(hit.code, hit);
      const gift = hit.o.components.find(c => c.type === 'gift');
      const lines = `${hit.m.product.variant_numeric_id}:${hit.o.quantity}${gift ? `,${gift.variant_id.split('/').pop()}:1` : ''}`;
      return {
        status: 'accepted',
        codes: [hit.code],
        cart_url: `${base}/demo/cart/${lines}?discount=${hit.code}`,
        apply: { ucp: `Send ${hit.code} in discounts.codes.`, webmcp: `Pass ${hit.code} to update_checkout.`, link: 'Open the cart link.' },
        terms: publicOffer(hit.o).components.map(c => c.label),
        expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60000).toISOString(),
        after_purchase: hit.o.components.filter(c => ['extended_returns', 'delivery_guarantee', 'next_order_credit'].includes(c.type)).map(c => c.label),
      };
    },
    async status() { return { status: 'open' }; },
    // The dry adapter's evaluate in miniature. A shipping saving is counted
    // either in the code's amount or in the shipping total: the cart page has
    // to add up both ways.
    async evaluateCart({ codes, cart }) {
      calls.push(['evaluateCart', { codes, cart }]);
      const applied = [], rejected = [];
      let off = 0;
      let method = cart.shipping_method || 'standard';
      let rate = BOARD.shipping[method].price;
      let shipping = rate;
      for (const code of codes) {
        const hit = minted.get(code);
        const line = hit && cart.lines.find(l => l.variant_numeric_id === hit.m.product.variant_numeric_id);
        if (!hit) { rejected.push({ code, reason: unknown }); continue; }
        if (!line || line.quantity < hit.o.quantity) { rejected.push({ code, reason: `needs ${hit.o.quantity} of ${hit.m.product.title} in the cart` }); continue; }
        if (!cart.shipping_method && hit.o.components.some(c => c.type === 'express_upgrade')) method = 'express';
        rate = hit.m.shipping[method].price;
        shipping = rate;
        let amount = hit.o.components.filter(c => c.type === 'price').reduce((a, c) => a + c.amount_off, 0);
        const gift = hit.o.components.find(c => c.type === 'gift');
        const giftLine = gift && cart.lines.find(l => l.variant_id === gift.variant_id);
        if (giftLine) amount += giftLine.price;
        const express = method === 'express' && hit.o.components.some(c => c.type === 'express_upgrade') ? rate - hit.m.shipping.standard.price : 0;
        const free = hit.o.components.some(c => c.type === 'free_shipping') ? Math.min(rate - express, hit.m.shipping.standard.price) : 0;
        if (shippingInAmount) amount += express + free;
        else shipping -= express + free;
        amount = Math.round(amount * 100) / 100;
        off += amount;
        applied.push({ code, title: hit.o.headline, amount });
      }
      shipping = Math.round(shipping * 100) / 100;
      return { applied, rejected, totals: { shipping_method: method, items_total: cart.items_total, shipping_total: shipping, total: Math.round((cart.items_total + shipping - off) * 100) / 100 } };
    },
  };
}

// --- calling a page ----------------------------------------------------------

function ctxFor(path, { hooks = [], prefix = '', method = 'GET', form, cookie, service = fakeService(), shop = 'demo', ...extra } = {}) {
  const url = new URL(prefix + path, ORIGIN);
  const headers = { 'user-agent': 'check-pages', 'cf-connecting-ip': '203.0.113.9' };
  if (cookie) headers.cookie = cookie;
  if (form) headers['content-type'] = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded';
  const request = new Request(url, { method: form ? 'POST' : method, headers, body: form ? new URLSearchParams(form).toString() : undefined });
  return { url, request, env: {}, shop, service, hooks: new Set(hooks), origin: ORIGIN, prefix, ...extra };
}

async function get(name, path, options) {
  const res = await pages[name](ctxFor(path, options));
  assert.ok(res instanceof Response, `${name} returns a Response`);
  return { res, status: res.status, body: await res.text(), headers: Object.fromEntries(res.headers.entries()) };
}

// The attributes of the first tag in a piece of markup.
const attrsOf = tag => Object.fromEntries([...tag.slice(0, tag.indexOf('>')).matchAll(/([a-z-]+)(?:="([^"]*)")?/g)].slice(1).map(m => [m[1], m[2] ?? '']));
const tags = (html, name) => [...html.matchAll(new RegExp(`<${name}\\b[^>]*>`, 'g'))].map(m => attrsOf(m[0]));
const unescape = s => s.replace(/&quot;/g, '"').replace(/&#39;/g, "'").replace(/&lt;/g, '<').replace(/&gt;/g, '>').replace(/&amp;/g, '&');
const jsonLd = html => [...html.matchAll(/<script type="application\/ld\+json">([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/g)].map(m => JSON.parse(m[1]));
const visible = html => html.replace(/<script\b[\s\S]*?<\/script>/g, '').replace(/<style\b[\s\S]*?<\/style>/g, '');

// What every page has to be: light only, no outside assets, one h1, labelled controls.
function wellFormed(name, html, { prefix = '' } = {}) {
  assert.ok(html.startsWith('<!doctype html>\n<html lang="en">'), `${name}: doctype and language`);
  assert.equal(tags(html, 'meta').filter(m => m.name === 'color-scheme' && m.content === 'light only').length, 1, `${name}: light only meta`);
  assert.match(html, /:root\{color-scheme:light only/, `${name}: light only in CSS`);
  assert.doesNotMatch(html, /prefers-color-scheme/, `${name}: no dark media query`);
  assert.equal((html.match(/<h1[\s>]/g) || []).length, 1, `${name}: one h1`);
  assert.equal((html.match(/<main[\s>]/g) || []).length, 1, `${name}: one main`);
  assert.match(html, /<title>[^<]+<\/title>/, `${name}: a title`);
  assert.doesNotMatch(html, /<(link|img|iframe|object|embed|video|audio|base)\b/, `${name}: no outside assets`);
  assert.doesNotMatch(html, /@import|url\(/, `${name}: no assets from CSS`);
  for (const s of tags(html, 'script')) assert.ok(s.type === 'application/ld+json' || s.src === `${prefix}/embed.js`, `${name}: only data blocks and the storefront script`);
  assert.doesNotMatch(html, /\son[a-z]+="/, `${name}: no inline handlers`);
  const labelled = new Set(tags(html, 'label').map(l => l.for).filter(Boolean));
  const wrapped = new Set([...html.matchAll(/<label\b[^>]*>\s*(<input\b[^>]*>)/g)].map(m => m[1]));
  for (const m of html.matchAll(/<(?:input|select)\b[^>]*>/g)) {
    const a = attrsOf(m[0]);
    if (a.type === 'hidden') continue;
    assert.ok(labelled.has(a.id) || wrapped.has(m[0]), `${name}: control ${a.name} has a label`);
  }
  for (const m of html.matchAll(/<button\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/button>/g)) assert.ok(m[1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim(), `${name}: a button says what it does`);
  const ids = tags(html, '[a-z0-9]+').map(t => t.id).filter(Boolean);
  assert.equal(new Set(ids).size, ids.length, `${name}: ids are unique`);
  // Every address the page points at stays under the proxy prefix or leaves the site on purpose.
  for (const t of [...tags(html, 'a'), ...tags(html, 'form'), ...tags(html, 'script')]) {
    const target = t.href ?? t.action ?? t.src;
    if (target === undefined) continue;
    assert.ok(/^https:\/\//.test(target) || target.startsWith(`${prefix}/`), `${name}: ${target} respects the prefix`);
  }
}

// Nothing a request sent may come back as markup.
function harmless(name, text) {
  assert.ok(!text.includes(EVIL), `${name}: the payload is not echoed as it came`);
  assert.doesNotMatch(text, /<script>alert|<img\b|"'>/, `${name}: no markup from a request`);
  assert.doesNotMatch(text, /href="javascript:/i, `${name}: no script addresses`);
}

// Runs something that is meant to log a failure, and hands back what it logged.
async function logged(run) {
  const { error, warn } = console;
  const lines = [];
  console.error = console.warn = (...args) => lines.push(args.map(String).join(' '));
  try { return { out: await run(), lines }; } finally { Object.assign(console, { error, warn }); }
}

const seen = [];
const page = async (name, path, options = {}) => {
  const out = await get(name, path, options);
  wellFormed(`${name} ${path}`, out.body, options);
  seen.push(out.body);
  return out;
};

// --- the exports -------------------------------------------------------------

const NAMES = ['offerForm', 'offerResult', 'offerAccepted', 'demoHome', 'demoProduct', 'demoCart', 'demoCheckout', 'demoPolicies', 'rivalProduct', 'adminLog', 'llmsTxt', 'offersJson', 'openapiJson'];
assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(pages).sort(), [...NAMES].sort(), 'pages.js exports one function per page and nothing else');
for (const name of NAMES) assert.equal(typeof pages[name], 'function');

// --- the control arm -----------------------------------------------------------

const HANDLES = listProducts('demo').map(m => m.product.handle);
const storefront = [
  ['demoHome', '/demo'],
  ...HANDLES.map(h => ['demoProduct', `/demo/products/${h}`]),
  ['demoProduct', '/demo/products/no-such-board'],
  ['demoCart', '/demo/cart/empty'],
  ['demoCart', '/demo/cart'],
  ['demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1`],
  ['demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:2,${W}:3?ship=express`],
  ['demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1?discount=SAVE10`],
  ['demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1?discount=not%20a%20code!`],
  ['demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:50,toaster:1`],
  ['demoCheckout', `/demo/checkout?cart=${V}:1`],
  ['demoCheckout', `/demo/checkout?cart=${V}:1,${W}:2&ship=express&discount=SAVE10`],
  ['demoCheckout', '/demo/checkout'],
  ['demoPolicies', '/demo/policies'],
];
const control = {};
for (const [name, path] of storefront) {
  const out = await page(name, path, { cookie: `pl_cart=${encodeURIComponent(`${W}:1||`)}` });
  assert.equal(out.status, path.includes('no-such') ? 404 : 200, `${name} ${path}`);
  assert.doesNotMatch(out.body, DESK, `control arm ${path} says nothing about the desk`);
  assert.doesNotMatch(JSON.stringify(out.headers), DESK, `control arm ${path} headers`);
  control[path] = (await get(name, path)).body;
}
assert.match(control[`/demo/cart/${V}:1?discount=SAVE10`], /<code>SAVE10<\/code> is not applied[.:]\s+[tT]hat code is not known\./);
// A refusal the desk worded in its own terms does not reach the control arm; with a hook on it does.
{
  const service = fakeService({ unknown: 'unknown offer code' });
  const quiet = await get('demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1?discount=SAVE10`, { service });
  assert.match(quiet.body, /<code>SAVE10<\/code> is not applied[.:]\s+[iI]t cannot be used on this cart\./);
  assert.doesNotMatch(quiet.body, DESK);
  assert.match((await get('demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1?discount=SAVE10`, { service, hooks: ['box'] })).body, /is not applied[.:]\s+[uU]nknown offer code\./);
}
// An arm switched off in the URL stays off on the next click.
for (const hooks of ['', 'none']) {
  const out = await page('demoProduct', `/demo/products/${HANDLES[0]}?hooks=${hooks}`, { hooks: hooks ? [hooks] : [] });
  assert.doesNotMatch(out.body, DESK);
  for (const a of tags(out.body, 'a')) assert.ok(a.href.endsWith(`hooks=${hooks}`), `${a.href} keeps the switch`);
  assert.ok(tags(out.body, 'input').some(i => i.type === 'hidden' && i.name === 'hooks' && i.value === hooks), 'the add-to-cart form keeps the switch');
}
console.log(`control arm: ${storefront.length} storefront pages say nothing about offers`);

// --- each hook adds its own element and nothing else ------------------------------

const productPath = `/demo/products/${HANDLES[0]}`;
const ELEMENT = {
  box: /<aside class="callout" data-hook="box"[\s\S]*?<\/aside>\n/g,
  desc: /<p data-hook="desc">[\s\S]*?<\/p>\n/g,
  jsonld: /<script type="application\/ld\+json">[\s\S]*?<\/script>\n/g,
  webmcp: /<script src="[^"]*\/embed\.js"[^>]*><\/script>\n/g,
  policy: /<section data-hook="policy"[\s\S]*?<\/section>\n/g,
};
const only = async (hook, name, path) => {
  const { body } = await page(name, path, { hooks: [hook] });
  const found = body.match(ELEMENT[hook]) || [];
  assert.equal(found.length, 1, `${hook} adds one element to ${path}`);
  assert.equal(body.replace(ELEMENT[hook], ''), control[path], `${hook} adds nothing else to ${path}`);
  return found[0];
};
const box = await only('box', 'demoProduct', productPath);
assert.match(box, /Ask this store for an offer/);
assert.deepEqual(tags(box, 'a').map(a => a.href), [`/offer?product=${HANDLES[0]}`]);
const desc = await only('desc', 'demoProduct', productPath);
assert.ok(desc.includes(`${ORIGIN}/offer?product=${HANDLES[0]}`), 'the description names the offer address in full');
const [product] = jsonLd(await only('jsonld', 'demoProduct', productPath));
assert.equal(product['@type'], 'Product');
assert.equal(product.offers.price, '699.95');
assert.equal(product.offers.shippingDetails.shippingRate.value, '19.90');
assert.equal(product.gtin13, BOARD.product.gtin);
assert.deepEqual(product.potentialAction.target.map(t => [t.httpMethod, t.urlTemplate]), [['GET', `${ORIGIN}/offer?product=${HANDLES[0]}`], ['POST', `${ORIGIN}/api/offers/request`]]);
const embedTag = attrsOf(await only('webmcp', 'demoProduct', productPath));
assert.deepEqual(embedTag, { src: '/embed.js', defer: '', 'data-hook': 'webmcp', 'data-endpoint': ORIGIN, 'data-shop': 'demo', 'data-product': HANDLES[0] });
const policy = await only('policy', 'demoPolicies', '/demo/policies');
assert.ok(policy.includes(`${ORIGIN}/offer`));
// The storefront script loads on every shop page but checkout, as an app embed would.
for (const [name, path] of [['demoHome', '/demo'], ['demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1`], ['demoPolicies', '/demo/policies']]) {
  assert.equal(attrsOf(await only('webmcp', name, path))['data-product'], undefined, `${path} has no product to name`);
}
// A hook changes only the page it belongs to.
for (const [name, path] of storefront) {
  const inert = name === 'demoProduct' && !path.includes('no-such') ? ['policy'] : name === 'demoPolicies' ? ['box', 'desc', 'jsonld'] : name === 'demoCheckout' ? ['box', 'desc', 'jsonld', 'policy', 'webmcp'] : ['box', 'desc', 'jsonld', 'policy'];
  assert.equal((await get(name, path, { hooks: inert })).body, control[path], `${inert} leave ${path} alone`);
}
const all = (await page('demoProduct', productPath, { hooks: ['box', 'desc', 'jsonld', 'webmcp', 'policy'] })).body;
for (const hook of ['box', 'desc', 'jsonld', 'webmcp']) assert.equal((all.match(ELEMENT[hook]) || []).length, 1, `${hook} with the others on`);
console.log('hooks: box, desc, jsonld, webmcp and policy each add one element');

// --- the offer desk: forms post where the routes expect ---------------------------

const formsOf = html => tags(html, 'form').map(f => `${f.method} ${f.action}`);
for (const prefix of ['', '/apps/offerad']) {
  const service = fakeService({ base: ORIGIN + prefix });
  const at = path => `${prefix}${path}`;

  const form = await page('offerForm', `/offer?product=${HANDLES[0]}`, { prefix, service });
  assert.deepEqual(formsOf(form.body), [`post ${at('/offer')}`]);
  const fields = tags(form.body, 'input');
  assert.deepEqual(fields.filter(i => i.type === 'hidden').map(i => [i.name, i.value]), [['shop', 'demo'], ['product', HANDLES[0]]]);
  assert.deepEqual(fields.filter(i => i.type === 'radio').map(i => i.value), ['', ...Object.keys(PRIORITIES)]);
  assert.deepEqual(fields.filter(i => !['hidden', 'radio'].includes(i.type)).map(i => [i.name, i.type]), [['quantity', 'number'], ['need_by_days', 'number'], ['competing_offer_url', 'url']]);
  assert.match(form.body, /Listed price \$699\.95\. Standard delivery in 6 days for \$19\.90\./);
  assert.match(form.body, /Asking is free, nothing is bought or reserved/);
  // With no product named the form asks for one.
  const chooser = await page('offerForm', '/offer', { prefix, service });
  assert.deepEqual(tags(chooser.body, 'option').map(o => o.value), ['', ...HANDLES]);

  const result = await page('offerResult', '/offer', { prefix, service, form: { shop: 'demo', product: HANDLES[0], priority: 'lowest_price', quantity: '1' } });
  const asked = service.calls.at(-1)[1];
  assert.deepEqual({ shop: asked.shop, product: asked.product, quantity: asked.quantity, priority: asked.priority }, { shop: 'demo', product: HANDLES[0], quantity: 1, priority: 'lowest_price' });
  assert.match(asked.session, /^page:[0-9a-f]{24}$/, 'the door supplies a stable session');
  assert.equal(asked.client.ip, '203.0.113.9');
  const offers = [...result.body.matchAll(/name="offer_id" value="([^"]+)"/g)].map(m => m[1]);
  assert.equal(offers.length, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(formsOf(result.body), [`post ${at('/offer/accept')}`, `post ${at('/offer/accept')}`, `post ${at('/offer')}`]);
  assert.equal(tags(result.body, 'input').filter(i => i.name === 'user_approved' && i.type === 'checkbox' && i.value === 'true' && 'required' in i).length, 2);
  assert.match(result.body, /<h3 id="offer-1">\$112 off<\/h3>/);
  assert.match(result.body, /<dt class="total">Total<\/dt><dd class="total">\$607\.85<\/dd>/);
  assert.match(result.body, /Accept this offer<span class="vh">: \$112 off<\/span>/);

  // Accepting needs the box ticked; ticked, it gives the code and the cart link.
  const unticked = await page('offerAccepted', '/offer/accept', { prefix, service, form: { shop: 'demo', offer_id: offers[0] } });
  assert.equal(service.calls.at(-1)[1].user_approved, false);
  assert.doesNotMatch(unticked.body, /OFFER-/);
  assert.deepEqual(formsOf(unticked.body), [`post ${at('/offer/accept')}`]);
  for (const sloppy of ['yes', 'on', '1']) {
    await get('offerAccepted', '/offer/accept', { prefix, service, form: { offer_id: offers[0], user_approved: sloppy } });
    assert.equal(service.calls.at(-1)[1].user_approved, false, `"${sloppy}" is not approval`);
  }
  const accepted = await page('offerAccepted', '/offer/accept', { prefix, service, form: { shop: 'demo', offer_id: offers[0], user_approved: 'true' } });
  const code = accepted.body.match(/<code>(OFFER-[A-Z0-9]+)<\/code>/)[1];
  const cartLink = tags(accepted.body, 'a').find(a => a.href.includes('/demo/cart/')).href;
  assert.equal(cartLink, `${ORIGIN}${at(`/demo/cart/${V}:1`)}?discount=${code}`);
  assert.match(accepted.body, /<li>\$112 off<\/li>/);
  assert.match(accepted.body, /Valid until <time datetime="[^"]+">[^<]+ UTC<\/time> \(in about 60 minutes\)/);
  const again = await get('offerAccepted', '/offer/accept', { prefix, service, form: { offer_id: offers[0], user_approved: 'true' } });
  assert.ok(again.body.includes(code), 'accepting twice shows the same code');

  // The storefront's own forms.
  const shop = await page('demoProduct', productPath, { prefix, service });
  assert.deepEqual(formsOf(shop.body), [`get ${at(`/demo/cart/${V}:1`)}`]);
  const cart = await page('demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1,${W}:2`, { prefix, service });
  assert.deepEqual(formsOf(cart.body), [`get ${at(`/demo/cart/${V}:1,${W}:2`)}`, `get ${at(`/demo/cart/${V}:1,${W}:2`)}`, `get ${at('/demo/checkout')}`]);
  assert.deepEqual(tags(cart.body, 'input').filter(i => i.type !== 'hidden').map(i => i.name), [`q_${V}`, `q_${W}`, 'ship', 'ship', 'discount']);
}
console.log('offer desk: the form, the offer cards and the accept step post to /offer and /offer/accept, with and without the proxy prefix');

// --- the desk says what the service said ---------------------------------------

{
  const service = fakeService();
  const rival = `${ORIGIN}/rival/products/${HANDLES[0]}?variant=cheaper`;
  const matched = await page('offerResult', '/offer', { service, form: { product: HANDLES[0], priority: 'lowest_price', competing_offer_url: rival } });
  assert.equal(service.calls.at(-1)[1].competing_offer_url, rival);
  assert.match(matched.body, /<h1>The price is matched<\/h1>/);
  assert.match(matched.body, /<li>Checked peakboards\.demo: their delivered price is \$629\.95\. We match it\.<\/li>/);
  assert.match(matched.body, /<li>Shop checked: peakboards\.demo\.<\/li><li>Their price: \$629\.95\.<\/li>/);
  assert.match(matched.body, /<dd class="total">\$629\.95<\/dd>/);
  // No priority: the reply's question is put to the reader, above the same form.
  const open = await page('offerResult', '/offer', { service, form: { product: HANDLES[0] } });
  assert.equal(service.calls.at(-1)[1].priority, undefined);
  assert.match(open.body, /What matters most to your user for this purchase\?/);
  // A bad field never reaches the service.
  const before = service.calls.length;
  const bad = await page('offerResult', '/offer', { service, form: { product: HANDLES[0], quantity: 'two', competing_offer_url: 'javascript:alert(1)' } });
  assert.equal(bad.status, 400);
  assert.equal(service.calls.length, before);
  assert.match(bad.body, /Quantity is a whole number, 1 or more\./);
  assert.match(bad.body, /The link to the other shop starts with https:\/\/\./);
  assert.equal((await page('offerResult', '/offer', { service, form: {} })).status, 400);
  // Out of stock, an unknown product, an unknown shop, a service that throws.
  assert.match((await page('offerResult', '/offer', { service, form: { product: HANDLES[0], quantity: '99' } })).body, /<li>Only 10 in stock\.<\/li>/);
  assert.match((await page('offerResult', '/offer', { service, form: { product: 'toaster' } })).body, /This store does not sell that product\./);
  assert.equal((await page('offerForm', '/offer', { shop: 'nobody.myshopify.com' })).status, 404);
  const { out: broken, lines } = await logged(() => page('offerResult', '/offer', { service: { request: async () => { throw new Error('floor is 545'); } }, form: { product: HANDLES[0] } }));
  assert.equal(broken.status, 502);
  assert.doesNotMatch(broken.body, /545/, 'what broke stays in the log');
  assert.match(lines.join('\n'), /floor is 545/);
  assert.ok(broken.body.includes(`Reference ${lines[0].match(/offerad page (\w+)/)[1]}.`), 'the page and the log share a reference');
  assert.equal((await page('offerAccepted', '/offer/accept', { service, form: {} })).status, 400);
  assert.match((await page('offerAccepted', '/offer/accept', { service, form: { offer_id: 'of_gone', user_approved: 'true' } })).body, /That offer is not open any more\./);
  // A worker that already read the body hands it over.
  await get('offerResult', '/offer', { service, method: 'POST', body: { product: HANDLES[1], priority: 'extras' } });
  assert.deepEqual([service.calls.at(-1)[1].product, service.calls.at(-1)[1].priority], [HANDLES[1], 'extras']);
  // And one that supplies the session keeps it.
  await get('offerResult', '/offer', { service, form: { product: HANDLES[0] }, session: 'mcp:abc', client: { ip: '198.51.100.7' } });
  assert.deepEqual([service.calls.at(-1)[1].session, service.calls.at(-1)[1].client.ip], ['mcp:abc', '198.51.100.7']);
}
console.log('offer desk: notes, proof, the question, refusals and failures are shown as the service gave them');

// --- the cart really applies a code -------------------------------------------

for (const shippingInAmount of [true, false]) {
  const service = fakeService({ shippingInAmount });
  const total = html => Number(tags(html, 'dd').find(d => 'data-total' in d)['data-total']);
  const dollars = s => Number(s.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, ''));
  // The rows of the summary, as numbers: they have to add up to the total shown.
  const rows = html => {
    const list = html.match(/<dl class="sums">([\s\S]*?)<\/dl>/)[1];
    const values = [...list.matchAll(/<dd[^>]*>([^<]*)<\/dd>/g)].map(m => (m[1] === 'Free' ? 0 : dollars(m[1])));
    return { sum: Math.round(values.slice(0, -1).reduce((a, x) => a + x, 0) * 100) / 100, total: values.at(-1) };
  };
  for (const priority of Object.keys(PRIORITIES)) {
    const reply = await service.request({ shop: 'demo', product: HANDLES[0], priority });
    for (const offer of reply.offers) {
      const { cart_url: link, codes: [code] } = await service.accept({ offer_id: offer.offer_id, user_approved: true });
      const cart = await page('demoCart', link, { service });
      assert.equal(total(cart.body), offer.total, `${priority}: the cart charges what "${offer.headline}" promised`);
      assert.deepEqual(rows(cart.body), { sum: offer.total, total: offer.total }, `${priority}: the rows add up`);
      assert.ok(cart.body.includes(`<code>${code}</code> is applied.`));
      const checkout = await page('demoCheckout', `/demo/checkout?cart=${link.split('/').pop().replace('?', '&')}`, { service });
      assert.equal(total(checkout.body), offer.total, `${priority}: checkout shows the same total`);
      assert.match(checkout.body, /The order would be placed here\./);
      // Express chosen in the cart: an upgrade in the offer brings it back to the standard rate.
      const express = await page('demoCart', `${link}&ship=express`, { service });
      const upgraded = offer.components.some(c => c.type === 'express_upgrade');
      assert.equal(total(express.body), Math.round((offer.total + (upgraded ? 0 : 20)) * 100) / 100, `${priority}: express costs ${upgraded ? 'nothing more' : 'the difference'}`);
      assert.equal(rows(express.body).sum, total(express.body));
    }
  }
  // A code for the board does nothing for a cart of wax, and the cart says why.
  const [offer] = (await service.request({ shop: 'demo', product: HANDLES[0], priority: 'lowest_price' })).offers;
  const { codes: [code] } = await service.accept({ offer_id: offer.offer_id, user_approved: true });
  const wrong = await page('demoCart', `/demo/cart/${W}:1?discount=${code}`, { service, hooks: ['box'] });
  assert.equal(total(wrong.body), 44.85);
  assert.match(wrong.body, /is not applied[.:]\s+[nN]eeds 1 of The Complete Snowboard in the cart\./);
  // Removing the code is one link away.
  const withCode = await page('demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1?discount=${code}`, { service });
  assert.ok(tags(withCode.body, 'a').some(a => a.href === `/demo/cart/${V}:1`), 'a link takes the code off');
}
{
  // No evaluator wired, or one that throws: the code is refused and the cart charges list price.
  for (const service of [{}, { evaluateCart: async () => { throw new Error('down'); } }]) {
    const { out: cart, lines } = await logged(() => page('demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1?discount=OFFER-7K2M9Q`, { service, hooks: ['box'] }));
    assert.match(cart.body, /<code>OFFER-7K2M9Q<\/code> is not applied[.:]\s+[iI]t could not be checked just now\./);
    assert.match(cart.body, /data-total="719\.85"/);
    assert.equal(lines.length, service.evaluateCart ? 1 : 0, 'a failing evaluator is logged');
  }
  // The two-argument form of the adapter's evaluate works as well.
  let got = null;
  const service = { evaluateCart(codes, cart) { got = { codes, cart }; return { applied: [{ code: 'OFFER-7K2M9Q', title: '$70 off', amount: 70 }], rejected: [], totals: { total: 649.85 } }; } };
  assert.match((await page('demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1?discount=offer-7k2m9q`, { service })).body, /data-total="649\.85"/);
  assert.deepEqual(got.codes, ['OFFER-7K2M9Q']);
  assert.deepEqual(got.cart.lines, [{ variant_id: BOARD.product.variant_id, variant_numeric_id: V, handle: HANDLES[0], title: 'The Complete Snowboard', quantity: 1, price: 699.95 }]);
  assert.equal(got.cart.shipping_method, undefined); // No explicit selection: the evaluator may choose the offer's rate.
  assert.deepEqual([got.cart.items_total, got.cart.currency, got.cart.shop], [699.95, 'USD', 'demo']);
  // An evaluation whose total cannot be right is not believed.
  const wild = { evaluateCart: async () => ({ applied: [{ code: 'OFFER-7K2M9Q', title: 'x', amount: 70 }], totals: { total: 1 } }) };
  const { out: doubted, lines: doubts } = await logged(() => page('demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1?discount=OFFER-7K2M9Q`, { service: wild }));
  assert.match(doubted.body, /data-total="649\.85"/);
  assert.match(doubts[0], /do not add up/);
  // A code the evaluation did not name is not applied.
  const silent = { evaluateCart: async () => ({ applied: [{ code: 'OTHER', amount: 500 }], rejected: [] }) };
  assert.match((await page('demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1?discount=OFFER-7K2M9Q`, { service: silent })).body, /data-total="719\.85"/);
}
console.log('cart: codes are checked through the service and the totals add up, whichever way a shipping saving is counted');

// --- the cart behaves like a cart ---------------------------------------------

{
  const hop = async (path, cookie) => {
    const res = await pages.demoCart(ctxFor(path, { cookie }));
    return { status: res.status, location: res.headers.get('location'), cookie: (res.headers.get('set-cookie') || '').split(';')[0], setCookie: res.headers.get('set-cookie') };
  };
  const first = await hop(`/demo/cart/${V}:1?quantity=2`);
  assert.deepEqual([first.status, first.location], [302, `/demo/cart/${V}:2`]);
  assert.match(first.setCookie, /^pl_cart=[^;]+; Path=\/demo; SameSite=Lax; HttpOnly; Secure$/);
  // The next product joins the cart the visitor already has.
  const second = await hop(`/demo/cart/${W}:1?quantity=3`, first.cookie);
  assert.equal(second.location, `/demo/cart/${V}:2,${W}:3`);
  assert.equal((await hop(`/demo/cart/${V}:1?quantity=1`, second.cookie)).location, `/demo/cart/${W}:3,${V}:3`);
  // The header link on any page leads back to it.
  assert.ok(tags((await get('demoHome', '/demo', { cookie: second.cookie })).body, 'a').some(a => a.href === `/demo/cart/${V}:2,${W}:3`));
  assert.match((await get('demoHome', '/demo', { cookie: second.cookie })).body, /Cart \(5\)/);
  // Update and remove.
  assert.equal((await hop(`/demo/cart/${V}:2,${W}:3?q_${V}=1&q_${W}=0&ship=express&discount=SAVE10`)).location, `/demo/cart/${V}:1?discount=SAVE10&ship=express`);
  const emptied = await hop(`/demo/cart/${V}:2?q_${V}=0`);
  assert.equal(emptied.location, '/demo/cart/empty');
  assert.match(emptied.setCookie, /Max-Age=0/);
  // A cart link replaces what was there, as a Shopify cart permalink does.
  const linked = await get('demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1`, { cookie: second.cookie });
  assert.match(linked.body, /Cart \(1\)/);
  assert.match(linked.headers['set-cookie'], new RegExp(`^pl_cart=${V}%3A1`));
  // More than the shop has, and things it does not sell.
  const over = await get('demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:50,toaster:1`);
  assert.match(over.body, /The Complete Snowboard: quantity set to 10, the most we have\./);
  assert.match(over.body, /One item in this link is not sold here and was left out\./);
  assert.match(over.body, /data-total="7,?019\.40"|data-total="7019\.40"/);
  // A handle works where a variant id does.
  assert.match((await get('demoCart', `/demo/cart/${HANDLES[0]}:2`)).body, /data-total="1419\.80"/);
  // Under the proxy prefix the cookie and the redirect stay under it.
  const proxied = await pages.demoCart(ctxFor(`/demo/cart/${V}:1?quantity=1&hooks=box`, { prefix: '/apps/offerad' }));
  assert.equal(proxied.headers.get('location'), `/apps/offerad/demo/cart/${V}:1?hooks=box`);
  assert.match(proxied.headers.get('set-cookie'), /Path=\/apps\/offerad\/demo;/);
}

// --- Peak Boards ----------------------------------------------------------------

for (const m of listProducts('demo')) {
  const { handle, list, gtin, title } = m.product;
  const at = async variant => {
    const out = await page('rivalProduct', `/rival/products/${handle}${variant ? `?variant=${variant}` : ''}`);
    const [data] = jsonLd(out.body);
    assert.equal(data['@type'], 'Product');
    assert.equal(data.offers.itemCondition, 'https://schema.org/NewCondition');
    assert.equal(data.offers.priceCurrency, 'USD');
    assert.equal(data.offers.seller.name, 'Peak Boards');
    assert.ok(out.body.includes(`<p class="price">$${Number(data.offers.price).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}</p>`), 'the page shows the price its data states');
    assert.match(out.body, /Peak Boards/);
    assert.match(out.body, /peakboards\.demo/);
    assert.doesNotMatch(visible(out.body), DESK, 'the other shop knows nothing of the desk');
    assert.doesNotMatch(out.body, /Powder Lab|\/demo|<form|<button/, 'and is a shop of its own with nothing to order');
    return data;
  };
  const cheaper = await at('cheaper');
  assert.deepEqual([cheaper.name, cheaper.gtin, cheaper.offers.availability, cheaper.offers.shippingDetails.shippingRate.value], [title, gtin, 'https://schema.org/InStock', '0.00']);
  assert.ok(Number(cheaper.offers.price) < list);
  const much = await at('much-cheaper');
  assert.ok(Number(much.offers.price) < Number(cheaper.offers.price) && Number(much.offers.price) >= list * 0.5, 'far below, yet above the half-price line a verifier calls implausible');
  assert.equal(much.offers.shippingDetails, undefined, 'no shipping stated: item prices are compared');
  const gone = await at('out-of-stock');
  assert.deepEqual([gone.offers.availability, gone.offers.price], ['https://schema.org/OutOfStock', cheaper.offers.price]);
  const other = await at('different-product');
  assert.ok(other.name !== title && other.gtin !== gtin && other.mpn !== m.product.mpn);
  assert.ok(Number(other.offers.price) >= list * 0.5);
  const plain = await at('');
  assert.ok(Number(plain.offers.price) > list, 'the plain page is not cheaper');
  assert.deepEqual(await at('much_cheaper'), much, 'the variant may be spelled with an underscore');
  if (handle === HANDLES[0]) {
    assert.deepEqual([cheaper.offers.price, much.offers.price], ['629.95', '459.00']);
    assert.equal(cheaper.url, `${ORIGIN}/rival/products/${handle}?variant=cheaper`);
  }
}

  assert.deepEqual(api.components.schemas.OfferRequest.properties.priority.enum, Object.keys(PRIORITIES));

// --- nothing a request sends becomes markup ------------------------------------------

{
  const e = encodeURIComponent(EVIL);
  const hostile = {
    request: async () => ({
      status: EVIL, reason: EVIL, next: EVIL, notes: [EVIL, { text: EVIL }], question: { text: EVIL }, product: { title: EVIL }, currency: EVIL,
      proof: { accepted: false, domain: EVIL, their_price: EVIL, compared: EVIL },
      offers: [{ offer_id: EVIL, kind: EVIL, headline: EVIL, components: [{ label: EVIL }, { label: EVIL }], quantity: EVIL, unit_price: EVIL, total: EVIL, currency: EVIL, expires_at: EVIL }],
    }),
    accept: async () => ({ status: 'accepted', codes: [EVIL], cart_url: 'javascript:alert(1)', terms: { [EVIL]: EVIL }, after_purchase: [EVIL], apply: { ucp: EVIL, webmcp: EVIL, link: EVIL }, expires_at: EVIL }),
    evaluateCart: async ({ codes }) => ({ applied: [{ code: codes[0], title: EVIL, amount: EVIL }], rejected: [{ code: codes[1], reason: EVIL }], totals: { total: EVIL } }),
  };
  const refuses = { accept: async () => ({ status: 'needs_approval', reason: EVIL }) };
  const everywhere = { product: EVIL, quantity: EVIL, priority: EVIL, need_by_days: EVIL, competing_offer_url: EVIL, shop: EVIL, offer_id: EVIL, user_approved: EVIL, note: EVIL };
  const tries = [
    ['offerForm', `/offer?product=${e}&quantity=${e}&priority=${e}&need_by_days=${e}&competing_offer_url=${e}&hooks=${e}`],
    ['offerForm', `/offer?hooks=${e}`, { shop: EVIL }],
    ['offerResult', `/offer?hooks=${e}`, { form: everywhere }],
    ['offerResult', '/offer', { form: { ...everywhere, quantity: '1', need_by_days: '', competing_offer_url: `https://x.example/?q=${EVIL}` }, service: hostile }],
    ['offerResult', '/offer', { form: { product: HANDLES[0] }, service: hostile, hooks: ['box'] }],
    ['offerAccepted', `/offer/accept?hooks=${e}`, { form: everywhere, service: hostile }],
    ['offerAccepted', '/offer/accept', { form: everywhere, service: refuses }],
    ['offerAccepted', '/offer/accept', { form: everywhere, service: fakeService() }],
    ['demoHome', `/demo?hooks=${e}`, { cookie: `pl_cart=${e}` }],
    ['demoProduct', `/demo/products/${e}?hooks=${e}`],
    ['demoProduct', `${productPath}?hooks=${e}&quantity=${e}`, { hooks: ['box', 'desc', 'jsonld', 'webmcp'] }],
    ['demoCart', `/demo/cart/${e}?discount=${e}&ship=${e}&quantity=${e}&hooks=${e}`, { cookie: `pl_cart=${e}` }],
    ['demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1?discount=${e}&ship=${e}&hooks=${e}`, { service: hostile, hooks: ['box'] }],
    ['demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1?discount=AAA111,BBB222&hooks=${e}`, { service: hostile, hooks: ['box'] }],
    ['demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1?quantity=${e}&hooks=${e}`],
    ['demoCart', `/demo/cart/${V}:1?q_${V}=${e}&discount=${e}&hooks=${e}`],
    ['demoCheckout', `/demo/checkout?cart=${e}&discount=${e}&ship=${e}&hooks=${e}`],
    ['demoCheckout', `/demo/checkout?cart=${V}:1&discount=AAA111,BBB222,${e}`, { service: hostile }],
    ['demoPolicies', `/demo/policies?hooks=${e}`, { hooks: ['policy', 'webmcp'] }],
    ['rivalProduct', `/rival/products/${e}?variant=${e}`],
    ['rivalProduct', `/rival/products/${HANDLES[0]}?variant=${e}`],
    ['llmsTxt', `/llms.txt?hooks=${e}&product=${e}`],
    ['offersJson', `/.well-known/offers.json?hooks=${e}`],
    ['openapiJson', `/openapi.json?hooks=${e}`],
  ];
  let echoed = 0;
  for (const [name, path, options] of tries) {
    const out = await get(name, path, options);
    harmless(`${name} ${path.slice(0, 40)}`, out.body);
    harmless(`${name} headers`, JSON.stringify(out.headers).replace(/\\"/g, ''));
    if (out.body.startsWith('<!doctype')) {
      // The legitimate script elements are the only ones, and nothing new opened a tag.
      for (const s of tags(out.body, 'script')) assert.ok(s.type === 'application/ld+json' || s.src === '/embed.js');
      for (const f of tags(out.body, 'form')) assert.match(f.action, /^\/(offer|demo)\b/);
      if (unescape(out.body).includes(EVIL)) echoed++;
    }
  }
  assert.ok(echoed >= 8, `the payload was echoed, escaped, on ${echoed} pages, so the check has teeth`);
  // The service's cart link is a link only when it is an address.
  const linkless = await get('offerAccepted', '/offer/accept', { form: { offer_id: 'x', user_approved: 'true' }, service: hostile });
  assert.doesNotMatch(linkless.body, /Open the cart/);
  // Redirects carry request text only as an encoded address.
  const bounced = await pages.demoCart(ctxFor(`/demo/cart/${V}:1?quantity=1&hooks=${e}`));
  assert.equal(bounced.headers.get('location'), `/demo/cart/${V}:1?hooks=${e}`);
  assert.doesNotMatch(bounced.headers.get('location'), /[<>"\s]/);
}
